We got our drinks put order in for appetizers then didn't see her to put in our main order till we got that. Usually I enjoy the food but even the pickles tasted off. I decided to try a sandwich I hadn't tried before the pulled pork since I usually enjoy them and it has those onion bits and sauce I like but I barely had any taste as well as the montanas fry dip ( probably not exact name but regardless that's what I call it) but that was tasteless as well. After awhile frys were hard. All around disappointing experience as the 2 others I was with were disappointed as well. We didn't get a rib bucket either or extra wet naps. Idk maybe go back one day but for now no
Excellent bistro! A gem hidden away in Campbell business park. Great food- fresh, tasty and reasonably priced. We're definitely going back!

After the first visit, I couldn't wait to get here again. Their soups were some of the best, especially the chowder and the tomato bisque. I also had an outstanding chipotle Chicken Club. Well worth the visit.
Had another great pedicure today at True Balance with Lea.   The staff are very professional and it is a relaxing atmosphere.

Hi, we were at Montana's on May 5th in the evening, and I just wanted to say that they have stopped automatically giving you a straw, which is fine, thier choice.  So, if you ask for one, the waitress is supposed bring you one.  Well we asked for straws and then we received a lecture from a 26 year old on how they are bad for the environment and we shouldn't be using them and we should carry a glass straw with us everywhere we go to prevent the need for a plastic straw.  She is entitled of her opinion but p, I did not ask for it nor did I want to hear it after I had had a long day and just wanted to enjoy my dinner.

Great fast service , they lined up a tow truck , good job
Counter staff were very polite, clean store.

Visited this walk in Jan 2016 and March 2016, will not return the doctors want you in and out don't show any real concerns and made me feel quite uncomfortable. You should feel comfortable talking to a doctor but when they say see your family doctor instead because "how am I suppose to know what you need if you don't know the exact name of prescription" after explaining exactly what it was for. FYI I am new to town and don't have a family doctor but will go somewhere else.

What a great little hidden treasure for this side of St. Albert.  All fresh, made in house and delicious with a daily special and now supper to go.  Cinnamon Bun Thursday for soft, sweet treat.  Homemade soups too!

Ribs are usually good; not so recently. My server said it was a bad batch, had others complain too. The sides are quite terrible though. The creaky wood floors can be annoyingly shaky on a busy day as servers keep walking by. Seating towards the back of the restaurant will land you either next to the washrooms and kitchen. Somewhat pricey for its class.
This place seems to be short on staff and we always wait a long time. Inevitably something gets forgotten. The food is good love their apps.

Loved it.
I went there on a recommendation.

Tip: Go early. Dinner is epic busy. We went early and it was definitely worth it.

Since it was my first visit, I went for Smokehouse ribs. They were perfect and generous. I barely touched them before the meat began to fall off the bone. The service was great. Our server was Luc M, and if you get him, he's pretty awesome. 

We sat in the lounge instead of the dining room. The lounge is all ages so it wasn't necessarily to avoid noisy children. 

I would recommend the Southwest Potato Skins as a starter. They are almost a meal in themselves, if you aren't sharing with someone else. Or you are just insanely hungry. They are fully loaded with toppings as well as taste. Just enough kick to let you know it is there without making it uncomfortable to eat.

There was no room for dessert sadly. Next time for sure!

I got a facial there a month ago which at the time I was ok until 2 days later then I started to break out and my skin was warm too touch.
I was told to keep in touch with the gal who did my facial if any thing happens so I did.
She did email me back but to use the samples for a bit longer which I could not.
3 weeks after calmed down I emailed her due to the reaction I had if possible to credit me for other services I had no reply.
Not impressed at all now.

Mediocre at best is how my husband described the lunch we just had at Montana's. Our server was nice and the atmosphere was pleasant enough but that is where the warm fuzzies stop.

I ordered steak fajitas for $18.99 and they were basically flavorless. The salsa lacked anything resembling spice and I don't think the veggies and steak were seasoned either. The sizzling platter wasn't sizzling and my food was lukewarm at best.

My husband ordered the Texas BBQ Beef Brisket Sandwich for $11.99. We have been watching a lot of Diners Drive-Ins & Dives on the food network lately so this sounded really good... Unfortunately, that is where the similarity stopped. The meat was lean but was boring and I swear missing BBQ sauce! For side, my husband chose Sweet Potato Fries which tasted like they had spent the last hour under a lamp - also lukewarm.

The meal was boring...  The food lukewarm at best... And the price? $40 plus tip.

We did not have a good experience.  We arrived at 5.00pm when it was very slow. We were seated quickly and were offered our drinks and our order was  taken.  We both ordered a steak and had it delivered to our table in good time.  That's where things went south.  I cut into the edge of the steak and found it to be tough and overlooked. I then tried to cut into the centre and it took all my strength to cut through it.  My wife really could not cut through hers.  We called  a waiter over and he said he would let our server know. Five minutes later we still had our inedible food in front of us with no sign of our server or any indication that our concerns were going to be addressed. We had no choice but to walk out.

Service was excellent we lucked out and had a really quick and nice server
We went on a Wednesday
Which is all you can eat ribs
The flavours really sucked I found the sauces were spicy( I don't like spicy anything)
The ribs were meaty enough so that was great
Found it a bit expensive since its 30$ I think but I can't even eat more then one rack to myself 
So only go if you can really eat your money's worth
Nice atmosphere 
Little crowded but decent place to go for supper or whatever 
We have the summer alcoholic drink
The lemonade with hickory flavour don't try that
Ew!
The other ones were awesome!
Such a great dining experience. From the cleanliness and style of the room, to the exceptional and friendly service to the delicious, fresh food!  Highly recommend.

I had sworn off Montana's many years ago because their customer service was just atrocious.  But I couldn't stay away.  They make a great steak and I'm obsessed with their baked beans.

So I actually find myself at Montana's quite often now, and am happy to say that the service has greatly improved!  On busy nights, you can wait up to 35 minutes, but they are really efficient about turning over tables.

I almost always get steak when I come here.  They season them really well and they are usually cooked perfectly.

On my last visit, both of our steaks were a little over, but the taste was still phenomenal, so we didn't even bring it to anyone's attention.

The thing I love most at Montana's is the baked beans.  No matter what I order, I always make sure there's a side of baked beans.

Three of us went for supper at the St. Albert Montana's 3 weeks ago. The food was about average, and the service was just average.
One thing I found irritating was the "white noise", where one hears different noises from all over the restaurant. It has something to do with the acoustics, but it made me get out of there quicker than usual. Maybe that's their point?
As for the food, none of us were thrilled with what we had, and it was all lukewarm when served to us.
I may go back, but only if it's convenient, and not on a Friday or Saturday evening.

Love the small town feel of this casino.  I used to bring my Mom here a lot more when they had a poker room.  Still have a good variety of slots and courteous staff.  Several times here I've witnessed someone forget to take their winnings slip or cash out and been able to get the staff to help find the rightful owner.

Located just 2 minutes off the Henday next to Campbell Liquor.

Haven't come here in a long time as I was disappointed in poor service last year. What a change!! Great work to Gemma and her supporting staff. Meal was fast even in a packed restaurant! Clean place that's very family friendly! Give it another chance people!

I must admit that I am a regular at the True Balance in Sherwood Park, so was not expecting to visit St. Albert's True Balance.  However, I was invited to a girls day out and was surprised to find we were booked into the St. Albert True Balance.

After being treated to a coffee and a choice of services, from Micro dermabrasion (my favourite procedure!) or manicure, pedicure, facial...   choices seemed to be extensive.  So  I picked a pedicure for some pampering.  

And boy, did I get pampered.   As most of us know a foot massage is heavenly and this one was great.  After my esthetician took care of my nails and my rough feet, she worked my legs with a scrub and then an awesome massage.  She was nice enough to say that my feet weren't so bad and would I like an extra few minutes of massage...   YAY!

Could have fallen asleep in that chair and would definitely go back.  Loved that I was not rushed out of the chair or made to feel like a number.  The atmosphere was friendly, professional and above all relaxing.

Quite enjoyed my day out...  will definitely look at booking something there again when I visit St. Albert.

Went on a pretty busy Saturday night had to wait maybe 40 minutes for a table. The waiting staff is amazing. Kodos on a packed house but I never had to wait for refills or our appetizer. The decor is unique, I like it (as well as drawing on the table shh it's not just for the kids) loved the deep fried pickles. My steak was meh! Nothing to special I definitely wouldn't get it again as it was probably the most tasteless steak I've had. Wish I'd stuck with my usual never had any complaints about the burgers. Altho I will say I did try my bf's ribs (unlimited) they were GREAT!!! I'm not usually a rib person so that's saying a lot. All in all not a too bad experience but we did come late.. Around 8 I believe thinking it wouldn't be to busy. Wrong!!! But I would go back just probably go early but definitely for supper since their supper menu are best. Oh and almost forgot to add that bf never had to wait for more ribs out waiter was always right there at the right time even though they were super busy

Chelsey was fabulous!  I have also been to a clinic downtown for botox for my frown lines - supposedly one of the best botox places in Edmonton - and they were snobby, elitist, and put a lot of pressure on me by continually suggesting that I try other products and services. Chelsey was straightforward,  recommended the minimum, preformed the procedure with less pain than the doctor from the other clinic,  and asked if I had questions instead of forcing "answers" on me. It was really appreciated and I will be definitely coming back!
Good food, friendly staff and nice interior (log cabin style). Good place for ribs!

Went to Montana's  what happened to them. There wings used to be the best in the city they were fat plump juicy now they're like all the other places small little wings how disappointing. And a beer special 599 for a Budweiser in a glass last night and 2/3 of a full beer what a rip off

We came here for an event in the ballroom and we parked in the lot that was furthest away from the ballroom. There was ample parking in the parking lot though. The casino layout is just very long and can get busy with people playing the machines around you.

We kept walking as we didn't see any signs for the ballroom. We ended up at the other side of the casino where the restaurant was. It was a little awkward to walk through the restaurant to get to the ballroom.  The ballroom isn't large but there was a bar and tables set up. There are washrooms just outside the ballroom. 

The casino was busier after our event and it seemed the clientele were mostly older in the restaurant and playing slots. More people were playing the table games but there were still empty spots. 

I wouldn't consider this one of the more fun casinos to play at with the atmosphere feeling a bit boring. But if you are feeling lucky and in St. Albert, check it out.

Took my car to Big Kev's about 2 weeks ago in need of an emergency repair - the back window cable snapped and wouldn't roll up!  We don't have a garage and snow was in the forecast so this was a MUST quick fix!  Or at least - get it to safety!

My next door neighbours have recommended Big Kev's to me for several years now and swears by them.

I went ahead and gave it a gamble!  Left them  voicemail (7pm at night) and phone them first thing in the morning.  They were polite and friendly on the phone!  Big thumbs up!

Brought the car down and left it with them and told them, no rush, as we have a second vehicle and I'm currently on mat leave.  They got back to me the next day and had the parts couriered over and it was ready the next day!  Car ended up needed a little more work and I thought they were very fair in explaining to me what my car needed now and what it would likely need in the upcoming year or two as it is a 2001 with over 160k on it!  

Very happy with Big Kev's!  They do car repairs, oil changes, tire changes, windshield replacements - you name it!  And they do it with a smile :-)  Maybe it helps that they have a woman who works at the front desk but it certainly made it feel less intimidating for me as a girl who doesn't speak, "car."  Bonnie (a guy - I'm probably spelling this wrong), one of their mechanics, was super friendly and really great at explaining things to me over the phone!

I will DEFINITELY go to Big Kev's again and will be recommending them to all my friends!

If you're in St. Albert, give them a try & support a local business owner!

Two thumbs WAAAAAAY Up!

This place seems to consistently have some kind of issues going on. Sometimes their Scene points system is down, so you can't earn or redeem them. Today was just ridiculous though. I took my kids there to have lunch and watch the Oilers game. There were several empty unreserved tables with a good view of the lounge TV's, but the hostess refused to seat us in at any of them saying that there was no server for that section, even though there were already two families seated in that section. I politely explained that the reason we came there was to watch the hockey game. She completely ignored me and seated us at the other side of the restaurant where we couldn't see the game at all. We sat down for a minute then decided to leave. Our server came and I told her why we were leaving. All she had to say was "sorry about that!" This restaurant clearly cares more about keeping things easy for their staff instead of accommodating their customers. Common sense isn't so common. We will gladly take our business elsewhere from now on.

Came here for our niece's 6th birthday dinner. Our food took 45 minutes to come out. When it did come out, most of it was cold but we were so hungry, we ate it anyways. Our waitress however, was very friendly and professional, and took some of our food items back to replace with hot items. Took some of my food home as it was a big serving, and was very disappointed when I realized (at home) that none of my sauces or sides had been included with my take home meal.

I checked out Juntos Bistro for the first time this week, and I have to tell you - I think I'm hooked!

This bright, open space makes you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. The many aromas of fresh, home cooked meals tingle your senses and make your mouth water. The smiling faces of the people working here make you feel like you've walked into a friends home rather than a restaurant. 

All the food here is made here, from your meal to any of the delicious desserts you have to choose from. They have a small menu, but everyone can find something they like on it. Hot and cold sandwiches, salads, soups - they have it all!

I was lucky enough to come on a day where their special was Praline Chicken and Waffles, and OMG! It was delicious! Chicken and waffles is always a good choice, but when you too that with a maple praline sauce with a hint of Cajun seasoning, you feel like you've been transported to the south. We topped off our meal with a giant cinnamon bun with cream cheese icing which was also delectable!

It's too bad that they are only open during the week for breakfast and lunch, but I guess it will be one of those spots to go when you really want to treat yourself!
Service was fast but Dr came in and called me a different name. Asked to see a specific Dr and did not happen. Went for test and never recieved a call about results.

Reviewed this under previous management, and still enjoying it as often as I can manage it :-)  Admittedly on the small side, that is equally as much a part of its charm.  There are enough slot machines to let you wander until you find that lucky one, and you can usually find a seat at the table games most evenings.  I notice the hours are now open until 3 a.m. seven days a week, which should be late enough for anyone.  I like the employees here - there's always a smile for you, the attendants all seem genuinely happy to pay out a jackpot, security is super helpful, bathrooms are clean, lots of parking - all around, a nice small-town casino vibe.

I don't know why we keep wasting our hard earned dollars here when we could have paid the same price for a good meal down the street. Ugh.

Well we were seated immediately by a friendly hostess who asked for our drinks.  We had questions about the drink menu which she was unable to answer and just told us to look on the menu for a slush in drink because she didn't know . We also asked about the appetizer menu and was left more confused because she didn't know how to answer those questions either.

We ordered drinks and waters from a different waitress who forgot the water. No biggie. Did I mention it was about 10 degrees in the restaurant ? I had to get a Hoodie from the car to stop from shivering. The women's washroom was better than last time but not great at all.

We ordered our meals and I got the chicken dish on the attached photo which looked like vomit....but I gave it a shot anyway. I wiped my cutlery with my single napkin to remove the residue and dug in when I noticed part of the dish was missing...the rice. But the waitress somehow got the impression that I ordered double veggies and no rice....umm ya, I didn't even mention veggies or rice I just ordered the dish without any special instructions. So I have no clue what she was talking about?? Anyway, I got a small bowl of rice on the side a few minutes later. The mushrooms were horribly soggy and I couldn't even tell what was on top of the chicken so I just started eating things I recognized. It was terrible. The veggies that were edible were fine, the rest was a soggy mess. Our waters finally came at the end of the meal.

The men's washroom did not have any paper towel so, there was toilet paper all over the floor. 

When it came time to pay it took about 10 minutes to track a waitress down to pay, who said she needed to find our waitress because she couldn't process our payment, so more waiting. We tried to use our scene card but of course the machine malfunctioned and they gave us a number to call to resolve the issue. Just an absolute terrible experience. We have been here before and had a not so great time then to but we gave them another shot. We decided we won't be spending another penny here again. 

It's too bad because they have decent steak.

Cheers.
Went to True Balance for the first time for a Brazilian wax. Lea was knowledgeable and made me feel super comfortable. She did a real job! Thank you!!

Food is exceptional and the diversity of options is alright. The choices are all amazing and diverse, the daily specials can be fantastic but are hit and miss at best. Sometimes the daily specials do not make sense ex: 35 degree weather and the special was pot roast and Yorkshire puddings when it should be something a little lighter for a more enjoyable experience.

What a little gem! This little casino is tucked away just off Anthony Henday, so it's a nice easy drive for me. 

The casino is on the smaller side, but has a pretty big variety of games and lots of slots! It's nice and quiet here, good background music and no smelly cigarette smoke to be found! 

There are lots of helpful employees around to answer any questions. My impression is that their players club rewards seem to be geared towards food rewards which is fine with me, but it sounds like they're looking at making changes to include merchandise. The nice lady at the players club desk also suggested I come back in a few weeks to get a gift pack on my birthday! I think I just might do that. 

I'm off to check out the restaurant And Yelp about that too! Cheers!

Mark Valcourt is the main reason I visit True Balance. He gives the best deep tissue massage! He is patient, professional and each appointment is specialized to target my problem areas. Additionally, Mark goes above and beyond and provides tips on how to stretch to prevent getting as sore in the future. 

The only improvement I would recommend is for True Balance to start direct billing benefits. This would vastly increase your clientele by making your services available to more individuals. Overall, the establishment is clean, the staff are professional and I would highly recommend.

My last visit to a Montana's was many years ago in Calgary International for nachos and beer while waiting for a flight back to Edmonton.  That sealed my impression of Montana's as just another watering hole while traveling.  So, I was surprised when friends came back from an out-of-town visit to their daughter raving about this great family restaurant called Montana's.  So we arranged to go together for a Saturday night outing.

Fortunately, we had a reservation so we were seated in a booth immediately, ahead of the full crowd in the lobby.  There was some noise because of family birthday parties but quietened down when the kids cleared out.  We were served immediately for drinks and after a reasonable wait, our orders were taken.  One of our friends ordered fajitas and the other ribs and wings.  The fussy eater of the two praised her meal as well as the value.  My wife ordered the striploin steak and house salad with blue cheese dressing.  Instead, she got sirloin steak and some indeterminate white glop on the salad.  Also, her house salad seemed to be merely iceberg lettuce free of tomatoes whereas my salad had plenty of tomatoes and a variety of greens, no kale.  I think the problem in getting the order correct is because the server has some sort of caterpillar in her left ear that probably is a communication device between the kitchen and other staff.  My wife was seated on the server's left in the far seat of the booth.  This doesn't excuse the server from not repeating the order back in cases where the caterpillar interferes with the customer.

I ordered the Smokehouse plate with salad, which someone should do only if they don't feel guilty about the herds of animals that were decimated to make up this dish.  Everything on the plate was delcious, although the individual ribs were slightly tough.  The chorizo sausage was spicy enough for my taste.  The brisket was tender but the smoking gave it an odd flavour.  Call me a traditionalist, but I prefer Jewish-style brisket that emphasizes the meat rather than additional spice or smoked flavours.

Other than my wife's mixed up order, everyone enjoyed their meal.  That's the only reason I've downgraded my rating to a four.  We will return but next time we will get the server to confirm each order.

Been busy last few years on Wednesday nights.sooo After waiting 2 years to hit up there all you can eat rib night, I finally made it. I thought pho sure I could order and max out there limit. One plate in and I brought containers. Loaded one full put in my friends purse they all fell out bbq sauce everywhere really great sauce though.Anyways paid $30 for just over a rack when I could have just ordered the rack for $20 some and the waitress came and seen me with my containers and all these ribs dough(homer forehead hit). Was decent food tonight

Hello, I just had an appointment for a wax hair removal of my back and front for an upcoming trip. Lucy the lady who did it for me and did a wonderful job, as well kept things light and happy with great conversation. It was expensive as these things go, but worth it for a nice clean, comforting, and relaxing time. As a guy in a salon like this, even I found it to be no stress.

Haven't been back in a while. It may be a lot longer before I venture back. Service was "trip them up" as they strolled past you on some vague mission. Wife's fish and chips was barely on the right side of cooked, my chicken under some mix of onions and mushrooms was cooked, probably many times over. Coffee was yesterday's lukewarm brew, served without much enthusiasm 

We were there early before the rush, so the studious lack of interest was baffling. Best part was the potato skins, pretty good, and my wife's white wine mix. Adios Montana's , we'll stick with Fionn's in the future.

Worst food ever. Avoid like a plague !!

The staff in the kitchen have to be the worst cooks ever. Takes an hour to cook 2x meduim rare steaks and a an order of chicken Fajitas. The the steaks were brought to the table, steaks were over done and the potatoes were cold. The chicken fajitas were not even "sizzling" when brought to the table and the fajitas were cold and sticky. The side of mushrooms - NOT EVEN COOKED, seriously, they were brought to the table white / cold / and hard in the centre's. 

The only thing good - deep fried pickles

We FINALLY made it by here for lunch last week after a few failed attempts in the past few months. A friend raves about it so we were eager, and it didn't disappoint.

A little out of the way to find (in the industrial park up behind Servus Place) but worth the hunt. Juntos Bistro is quite the gem... serving up scratch made soup and sandwich options.

We started with a Tomato Basil Soup to start. I love soup... all soups... but Tomato Basil is in my Top 5. This one didn't disappoint. It was incredible. I ordered the Le French Onion Grilled Cheese which in reality is like some super morph of a Beef Dip and a Grilled Cheese sandwich that was absolutely delicious, served with a hot au jus. Heather went with The James Banh Mi... which was really tasty but not as good as my sandwich in both our opinions. Our criticism of the Bahn Mi was that it was a little "too busy" with toppings. Too much wasabi mayo and then the combo of cilantro, pickled vegetables and jalapenos took away from the delicious shredded pork and fresh bun. I would order this next time with half the toppings.

The potato wedges served as a side are addictive, as is the spicy ketchup they are served with. This spot is a must try in St. Albert... I look forward to working my way through the menu in the coming months!
This is my son's go to place for steak (he's 12 years old). It is close to our house so we go here regularly. Never had a bad meal. I ate the all-u-can eat ribs...yum!
Really good food and this Montana's is great I would highly recommend coming here.

I visited True Balance in St. Albert for the first time yesterday and I was very impressed. I'm a nurse so things like customer service and cleanliness are very important. Chelsea took care of me - she was professional, pleasant and knowledgeable. She washed her hands before the procedure and explained what she was doing. I had Botox and Juvederm (to my lips). The clinic is beautifully kept - Chelsea gave me a quick tour - clean, fresh and spacious. I'm very fussy about what I expect and I will certainly be recommending True Balance to friends and colleagues. The prices were what I expect to pay but they do a sliding scale for your Botox so it's cheaper if you use over a certain number of units. There was good printed information on after care and my follow-up appointment is booked. I'm giving True Balance a well-deserved five stars!

Service received was above and beyond! Kevin went out of his way to help me. He was honest, and pricing was very reasonable. He knew I was in a bind and fit me in the next day. Very happy and will be a returning customer!

Had not been to Montana's for many years. Have to say I am pretty impressed with how good it is now. Great variety on the menu, the $11 lunch special is a great deal and very tasty. Their BBQ is at least as good as what you get elsewhere in Edmonton. Brisket is moist and nicely smoked, ribs were very good. Don't get me wrong, this is not competition winning BBQ but neither is anything else in Edmonton and the other places are a bunch more expensive. They also had great corn bread and other sides. The sides were much better than Memphis Blue's, meat was about on par. 

Service was quick. They were a lot busier than they planned for, only one waitress, but 2 or 3 of the other staff jumped in to help out, so overall they got the job done pretty well and they were all very friendly. I will definitely go back.

So my friend's mom gave him a Montana's gift card a few months back and we found it in his car today. Naturally we invited some friends out for a nice late semester bite. Everything was going as planned until we realized Jordan's sour cream contained milk? A little backstory, Jordan has aggressive lactose intolerance. The experience went downhill fast after that point. 5/5 will be back.

Ordered dinner tonight and the order was accurate. Everything came out great. Overall quite impressed with the food. The rib sauce was yummy. Sent a cookie along with the meal and a cute note was left on the delivery bag. We will order again!

Horrible, horrible, horrible visit here with my daughter and granddaughter.

We were told the wait would be 15 minutes, which is fine, but it extended well beyond that.  Once at our table, waiting continued - it was actually more than an hour before food arrived.  While waiting, we were NOT entertained by the bugs and flies at and on our table, which the manager attributed to "needing" to leave the patio door open so servers could be speedier.  Well, if service is faster out there, I'd advise you to sit outside, as it was super spotty inside.  We finally were able to order, and my drink had another bug or UFO inside it, which is a pretty big turn-off for me.  (And just incidentally - I do not find drinking out of a mason jar to be charming, bug free or not).  

Our meal, when it finally finally finally arrived, was lukewarm and missing an item.  The manage informed us that item was no longer available to them and their policy was to replace it with garlic toast.  Okay folks, if it is no longer available, why is it still on the menu?  Why doesn't the wait staff TELL you it isn't available?  Why aren't you offered a substitution?  And by the way, we didn't even have garlic toast on the platter, so your "policy" has a few loopholes in it.  She also said, "Well, I see you ate most of it anyway....."   Well, yes, it's true - we waited an hour for it to come, then another 20 minutes after the waitress said she would get you - we were HUNGRY, darn it, and did keep picking at it.  

We were charged for the child's meal even though we told them in advance - THREE times - it was her birthday and she belonged to their club and had the notice with us about the free meal.   At the end of all the unpleasantness, the poor kid had to ASK for the horned hat birthday traditional salute, after watching others get it all evening, which really hurt her feelings.   And yes, they were well aware by then that it was her birthday.

The attitude of the manager needs major readjustment - it was condescending and it obvious she didn't like being bothered by us.   Maybe the company doesn't train how to help patrons resolve problems, maybe she didn't care, but whatever - we will not be going back to this location.  EVER.  This is only the second time I've done a 1 star review, and if zero had been an option, it would have the honour of being first.

I absolutely love True Balance! I have been seeing Lea for quite some time and every visit is a amazing. It's like seeing a friend who does the best eyebrows I've ever had. I always leave thrilled and looking better than when I came in. Looking forward to my next visit. See you soon Lea!

I walked in to get a medical for my Class 1.  From  the moment I walked in I was treated with respect and dignity.  They weren't concerned that I hadn't been a patient for many years, they were happy to help me out.  I will definitely come back again.  Thanks again.

I want to love places like this. Unfortunately, first impression over the phone at Big Kev's left a lot to be desired. If you have time to answer the phone, you should have time to give me a quote on winter tires. Here's how that conversation went: Me - "Hi can I get a quote on a set of winter tires?" Them - "You can when we have time." Me - "ummm ok." Maybe it was just the guy answering the phone, but I think I can find Blizzaks at a number of different places. Boo.

Not happy. My husband waited almost 30min for our take out order and it came wrong. I'm usually happy with the take out service at this location however this is the second time in a row our order has been wrong. Side note chicken was horribly burnt and not edible. Very disappointed

From a word of mouth referral I brought my truck in for what I thought was a power steering leak but ended up being a failing water pump.  I had always taken my vehicles to the dealer when I wasn't able to fix them myself but Big Kev and his team did a great job fixing it and also had a list of suggested things to do but gave me a realistic, meaningful assessment of what should be done vs. What could wait.  At all times they were great at communicating with me, did exactly what they said they would and even stayed late to fix something (for free) that the St. Albert Dodge service department had screwed up.  I highly recommend this honest business to take your vehicle to for service.  

Thank you Big Kev!

My family goes to Montana's from time to time when we go out to eat with our daughter. She loves that she can color on the table!

We do our best to support local business as much as we can. That sometimes means sitting down for a meal but also can mean sharing proven professional skills that can add value to the business.

I recently approached Montana's because our Firm identified opportunity to lower the cost of utility delivery on a number of Montana's locations. Considering we already helped a number of its competing restaurants like Boston Pizza, Canadian Brewhouse, Moxies and others, I figured Montana's would be extremely interested. Rather, I was brushed off by Montana's Regional Manager which suggests maybe they don't care that much about containing operating costs. 

Not many restaurant Owners are saying no to $4-5k per year per store in savings, so if you are the Owner seeing this, you may want to contact me.
Great steak 7 Oz hand carved 15.99 Ribs & wing combo 1/3 rack 19.99 are great as well. St. Albert location awesome service. Rice pilaf and baked Potato good sides to pick

Incredible service!  Had been going to Fountain Tire and got completely fed up with the lack of friendly timely service.  I decided to try Big Kev's and couldn't believe how Friendly the service was and the amazing quality of work.  Bonny provides service the good ol fashioned way and goes the extra mile - said he'd check in to something and call us right back and he did!  You feel they appreciate your business and want to make you happy.

Last evening we went to Montana's in St. Albert.  We arrived after 7pm and the wait to get a table was approx. 30 minutes.  When the hostess took us to the table the seats were still full of food from the last client (obviously had small children).  Our server was very pleasant and everything seemed fine until our food arrived.  My wife ordered the fish and chips. The fish came out burnt so she couldn't even eat the outside of the fish.  When quizzed about this our server simply said it should have not made it past quality control (so why did it, was someone not doing their job?)  I had ordered the BBQ beef brisket which is advertised as "so soft you can give your teeth a rest". I was really glad I had teeth to chew this as it definitely was not as advertised!  Hardly any BBQ sauce as well.  Our friend had the honkin' beef rib and shrimp combo.  Had 1 rib and 6 small shrimp for $26.95.  What a rip off!  On the positive side, the green fried tomatoes that we had as a starter were very tasty, but at  $6.99 for 5 small slices of tomato I felt a little pricey. All in all not a great experience for over $80 including tip (there was no offer to take the cost of my wife's meal off the bill nor and apology for the state of her food).  I doubt we will be going to this restaurant again.

Kind of a hidden gem, this one.
I never find this particular casino to be crowded, even during shows or events. Century Casino is sprawling enough to accommodate larger amounts of people. That said, the casino itself is still on the smaller side, unlike in other Edmonton casinos.
You will likely never find an issue with parking, as there is a parking lot surrounding the building. 

There are hoards of slot machines to choose from - anywhere from old to brand new. There are multiple tables to play some different games and usually an empty chair to sit down and join in. I played some Texas Holdem against the dealer(s) and everyone in my group was a little fuzzy with the rules, so each dealer we met assisted us in learning the game and gave us tips and tricks.

I've had multiple experiences at Vee Restaurant which is located within the casino. It is to my understanding that ownership or management of this restaurant has changed, which in turn usually means changes to quality or menu. So far, I haven't noticed anything too substantially different. The food is honest, simple, and comes at a decent price. I have come on several holidays (Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, etc.) and have found that they are never too busy. In fact, when my plans for Valentine's Day fell through last minute, I called to see if they had any availability for a date night. Vee Restaurant had ample space for my boyfriend and I to enjoy a date night out and even had a package that included a 3-course meal with wine and champagne.

Overall, I have really enjoyed my experiences with Century Casino and will definitely go here first for a games night.

We went to Montana's in St. Albert for our daughter's 5th birthday on a quiet Saturday afternoon. Kids were excited as we were seated right away and they went straight to work colouring on the tables. 20 minutes later and none of the servers had even stopped by our table to say hi, take drink orders etc. 

The servers seemed to be avoiding any eye contact and we couldn't get anyone's attention - so we got up and not so subtly got the kids together to leave. Still nothing from the servers or hostess. 

I had a word with the manager on the way out, who apologized and offered us a free appetizer. I politely declined - as we were skeptical about the service we would receive after our complaint. 

Won't be going back.

Giving this place 2 stars because quality is inconsistent (depends if they have good cooks on duty that day). I've had some of the *best* nachos ever here, whereas other times they completely screwed up the food and I had soap mixed in with my lemonade.

I would like to say that when they have competent staff on duty, it's great.

One time the bar tender was trying to pour a beer and every time it would froth up she'd pour out the froth, probably repeating this process a dozen times. Not necessarily a bad thing, but it shows that they weren't trained to even poor beer and end up dumping lots of money down the drain.

I have been in search of crispy, dusted chicken wings since Applebee's closed & Mary Browns discontinued them on their menu.

I cannot stand rubbery wings and I've tried far too many places where this is what I received.

I love crispy wings with a coating & hot sauce.

I saw this pic on the Montana's website and these are the wings I have been searching for.
I ordered the 8 pc medium wings for takeout and was not disappointed. Even with a 20 min drive, they were still crispy when I got home.
The sauce was medium spiced & I think I'll try the hot sauce next to take the heat up a kick.

And the restaurant added a complimentary chocolate chip cookie & lollipop to the order.

Now, I just need a restaurant closer to my home.

Awesome restaurant with paleo, keto and vegetarian smoothies, wraps, salads and bowls .  Had the breakfast burrito complete with fresh fruit. It was huge with egg and fresh vegetables.  Service was at counter and friendly and fast .  Highly recommend!

Hip Hip Hooray!  Today is the day!  Le Target has finally opened (Soft Opening)!

As a former Seattlelite, Le Target (as we affectionately called it back home) is my most missed American chain after moving to Canada over a decade ago!

But the day is finally here, my friends!  5 locations opened all around the greater Edmonton area today at 0800 hours!

I'll be heading there shortly and will add LOTS Of pictures and update this review!

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Yay!  Okay, here's the downlow of my visit last night:

Bright, clean, & modern!  The store gets 2 thumbs up BUT the new parking lot layout is the pits!  They blocked off some areas that you previously could drive through and they did add a 4 way stop which is probably a good thing.  Yesterday was an absolute zoo and with ALL the tills open they got us through the registers pretty fast.

I have been following the news articles and Target media for a couple years now: Target only has permission to bring certain lines into Canada because of Duty, Trade, etc.

My son lost his shoe there last night and they even took our name and phone number to phone us when/if they find it.

I like the 5% off purchases program that you can do with their credit cars OR their debit card that accesses your bank account.

I thought there were a couple really killer items for my kiddos: boys undershirts/underwear that are Oilers; Monster High underwear for my daughter; shoe dept. was pretty darn good - some Converse; great coloured denim section for women & girls; and a great soft opening in general!

I was disappointed that their toy department wasn't bigger but time will tell how it all settles after a few months (after all this is just the soft opening and they have to figure out what their demographics are looking for).

I really appreciated the items that were brought in specifically for our local demographics: Oilers clothing for all ages - onesies, shirts, undies; Oilers Man Cave Signs; Oilers stickers for the car (you know the mom, dad, kids, and pet ones you see on the back of vehicles - these stick figures had Oilers shirts on!).


And of course - LOVE the Starbucks inside!

Really tasty food that's actually healthy! This is such a life saver if you're like me and you diet during the week. They have all their macros on their website so if you use MyFitnessPal or any other calorie tracker that's incredibly helpful. Their portion sizes are surprisingly big - and I don't mean huge, just a good size if you're hungry! I was really happy with how tasty it was and that I left feeling full which is something that healthy food places kind of fall short on. Unfortunately I didn't get a picture but I ended up getting the chicken fajita wrap and shared the beef nachos with the boyfriend. Like I said, both were great, fresh and tasty! I'm definitely coming back on those days I'm just too tired to cook.
Amazing food that's good for the athlete ! Seriously good fast clean food. The only thing better than the food, is the couple that owns the place !! Super friendly and helpful.

I had a cake specially sculptured and needed it in a very short deadline. All was done over the phone and strongly suggest you do it in person to get a better idea of size. The outcome was awesome. I requested Carrot cake and I must say I have had better thus only giving a three star for the quality versus

This was my first time trying Ethiopian food and I am so impressed!  There were three ladies who wanted to try the same dish and the server recommended that we order three different dishes so that we could get a variety to try.  What a wonderful suggestion!  We were able to try the tips, shrimp and chacha.  The tibs were tender beef, the shrimp were large and served in a spicy tomato sauce, the chacha (beef) came with cooked onions and green peppers.  Each had a very delicious and unique taste. They also served romaine salad which was flavorful with garlic and an oil dressing.  My daughter and I used the injera to pick up our food, but my step-mom preferred a fork.  The owner is helpful and friendly. I would highly recommend Saviour's Cafe and Bistro.

I ordered 12 dozen macaroons for my wedding tomorrow. Half were supposed to be blue and the other half yellow to match my wedding colours (blueberry and  lemon) my mom arrives at the set up with a mix of purple and yellow macaroons! I am beyond livid that no one bothered to double check that they should have been blue for blueberry flavor. So everything in my reception matches expect for these purple macaroons. I went to over the top cakes because I thought they would do a good job; they've always come highly recommend; but how they could screw something so simple up is beyond me. If you want it done right for your wedding; go somewhere else.

Reply to Comment:That is true my Mom picked them up and paid for them; but I made the order and was with her when we both placed the order. I didn't have a specific shade of blue as we used different shades of blue in our decor. So I specifically asked "what flavor's do you have in the colour blue" and I was told 'Blueberry' was one of them; and I decided to order blueberry based on that. My Mom picked them up the day before my wedding and just doesn't have the type of personality to complain like that; she drove down to my venue on the South Side of Edmonton; where I obviously hit the roof..by that time is was noon the day before the wedding; and when she called to order more she absolutely did say the colour was wrong as everyone overheard; whoever was on the other end of the phone at your store said that nothing could be done. Obviously I would have preferred for you to fix your error; but its an hour drive to St.Albert from our venue and the person on the phone said nothing could be done at that point. I had enough stress the day before my wedding without my Mom having to stop helping me set up and drive essentially 2 hours to get new macaroon's. So we just left it; I mean what could we really do? My wedding was the next day? I asked what flavor options were in the blue tones and based on what we were told placed an order for blueberry; I don't appreciate the insinuation that this was somehow our fault or miscommunication on our part. I really don't see how we are to blame; I guess we should have kicked up a fuss earlier and wasted my wedding set up day waiting for new macaroons.

Very disappointing! Me and my friend went and each got a cupcake to bring home for that evening. She texted me and said hers was terribly dry. Mine was just as bad. Icing was disgusting too. I am a lover of cupcakes and this was one of the worst I've ever had!  Very dry cake . Would seem not fresh and at least a couple says old!

The cake looks good as it well decorated, But really the cake when I ate it is a big disappointment. I would rather go to Save-on-Food and get the red velvet cakes. I tried the other flavors too and none of them are good. Just like the other comment that the cake is too dry which is true.  I find it too rich and too sweet  Good thing that I tried their cup cakes first in the store before ordering the big cake for my son's birthday. 


The price is OVER THE TOP.  Though I don't mind paying for an expensive cake as long as it taste good, but their cake doesn't pass my taste.  I don't recommend this bakeshop. I will not go back there and would  go somewhere else.

Checked out over the top cakes today for some cupcakes. I'm a pastry chef myself so I like to see what the competition has to offer.  I got 4 different flavours. I like to eat the bottom first for flavour, density and consistency. It was good. Better then some of those cupcake places on whyte ave. They were pretty pricey. Four cupcakes were $15. If your looking for a yummy treat I would recommend them.
December 23 2015 - walked in at 1030am, quick efficient cut - great price, 15 minutes. Recommend to guys in St A and on Northside
Has to be one of my favourite places for pizza. They do a really good job. The pizza is cheesy , and delicious. Also, it's been just as good every time I order. Major points for consistency.

REVIEW UPDATE

So we are now in our 2nd year at Dance Co. and could not be any happier!

My daughter did 2 full year long classes last year, attended the summer camp including a pizza party and sleepover, and now both my daughter and son are enrolled again in year long classes.

Our experiences at Dance Co have been phenomenal!

The quality of instruction and teachers has been top notch, the facility is wonderful, and the staff always friendly and helpful.

The only thing I didn't like so much last year was the end of year format for recital time ended up requiring that we purchase tickets to two separate show times and it's through ticket master so you end up paying surcharges on the tickets so they ended up being about $15 each which for a family with grandparents, siblings, and 2 shows to attend ends up being more than a $150.  I'm not sure how they could rectify this other than maybe only selling tickets through them and then not having the ticket master surcharge which adds up being close to $40 when you are buying 8 tickets (4 tix for 2 show times).

One thing Dance Co. does to help support families with multiple dancers or a dancer that takes a lot of classes, is you pay by the number of hours taught per week.  So each subsequent class costs slightly less per hour than the previous class in any given year.  And this is the case that swayed me into signing my 3 year old son up for preschool dance this year because his sister is already taking 2 full one hour weekly classes, so why not add on a half hour preschool class on the same night as his big sis?

Dance Co. also has a little consignment section which is great for picking up a second hand pair of taps or ballet shoes for your chitlin.

They also offer a preschool program that always fills up and looks just marvellous (as I peek through the window).

I foresee a long relationship with Dance Co.

Two thumbs WAY UP!  

Oh and don't forget to attend their summer customer appreciation day with a free BBQ, bouncy castle, face painting, trial classes, and draws!

Dropped in to this Target specifically in search of a variety of nail polishes & as always ended up spending a good hour browsing.

This location is attached to the mall, so there is quite a bit of parking available. Product availability is slightly lacking as is employees availability to assist.  Cashier was fast & efficient which was nice.

If I'm in the area, I'd drop in again.

Came here based on the other Yelp review! I usually go to salon's because I'm particular about my hair, so I was skeptical in going in to this shop. Upon entering, it definitely felt like a barber shop. But the barber did a fantastic job and didn't cut it like a typical barber. So I'll definitely be back :)

This is the best and probably the only healthy fast food in town. It's quick and fresh, I love the breakfast burrito and the wraps. It's privately owned and they are there almost every time  I go in. Great place to grab a shake before or after the gym. They also do full meal prep and the prices are realistic, probably the same if I was buying the groceries myself.

Dispite having a car coming in to say hello to their shop, they still have the most delicious treats around. Very fancy, and literally over the top!  Thank you for being here OTTCDB!  Keep up the great work!

November 1st will mark DJ's 1 year anniversary, and it's a great addition to St. Albert.

I'm a little confused on the name though.  Their website says "DJ's Lounge and Café", their facebook page is "DJ's Lounge and Pizzaria", and on their menus it is "DJ's Lounge and Pizzeria".  No matter what you call it though, it's a good place to go.

It's a smaller place.  I would say 12 - 20 tables, though I didn't actually count them.  On one side of the restaurant is tall tables and chairs, and on the other side is booths.  But the booths are a little strange and hold 3 people comfortably... 4 if you don't mind hitting elbows.

Now, onto the food.  I attended a "cash mob" event, which was set up as a buffet, rather than order off the menu.  Items presented to us were Hummus, pita chips, Fatoush salad, lasagna, and MULTIPLE pizzas.  Although it was appreciated, I think they made waaaay too much food lol  But honestly, everything was really good.  

A couple of reasons that I knocked a star off.  The lasagna and pizza were both really tasty, BUT they were pretty greasy.  Also, there is only one female and one male washroom... which just seems silly for a place that sells alcohol.  But... the washrooms were clean, so that's good.

The owner came out and talked with us for a bit.  He explained his vision and why he loves his business.

From what I can see on facebook, they seem to do a LOT of business with Skip the Dishes.  So, check them out for delivery!

I didn't have a specific shade of blue as we used different shades of blue in our decor. So I specifically asked "what flavor's do you have in the colour blue" and I was told 'Blueberry' was one of them; and I decided to order blueberry based on that. My Mom picked them up the day before my wedding and just doesn't have the type of personality to complain like that; she drove down to my venue on the South Side of Edmonton; where I obviously hit the roof..by that time is was noon the day before the wedding; and when she called to order more she absolutely did say the colour was wrong as everyone overheard; whoever was on the other end of the phone at your store said that nothing could be done. Obvisouyly I would have perfered for you to fix your error; but its an hour drive to St.Albert from our venue and the person on the phone said nothing could be done at that point. I had enough stress the day before my wedding without my Mom having to stop helping me set up and drive essentially 2 hours to get new macaroon's. So we just left it; I mean what could we really do? My wedding was the next day? I asked what flavor options were in the blue tones and based on what we were told placed an order for blueberry; I don't apprechiate the insinuation that this was somehow our fault or miscommunication on our part. I really don't see how we are to blame; I guess we should have kicked up a fuss earlier and wasted my wedding set up day waiting for new macaroons.

Updating my review... How has 3 years flown by since my last review of Dance Co?

Still got 2 littles dancing a total of 4 classes here right now.

Love the variety here - ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, summer camps, 8 week courses, year round, for fun, competition, you name it - they likely have it.

I still can't speak highly enough of the folks here that teach preschool classes or the preschool age range classes.  So loving, so supportive, and so fun.  I think I'll forever think of them teaching the Crocodie Disney song and pointing toes so Tic Tock Croc doesn't eat them!

Dance Co has also opened up a Stony Plain location so they are now in St. Albert, Edmonton, and Stony Plain. 

Yay Dance Co!

PS You still pay your rate based on how many hours you take and each hour of dance is subsequently slightly less expensive so it's great for families!  Because my daughter takes 3 hours of classes my son's one class if pretty inexpensive.  Be mindful you will have costume fees, festival fees, and recital ticket fees so it's good to know in advance :-)

I don't know why I get a charge out of creating my very own dessert by drawing the frozen yogurt out of the machine which for me is the best part of Tutti Frutti!  

Tutti Frutti is a wonderful place for people of all ages who like frozen yogurt.  I really enjoyed the taste of my choices which were a combination of the taro, peach and chocolate and then I simply placed fresh cut strawberries and pineapples on top.  Cost a little over $5.00 for the small tub but this was a substantial amount of food and too much for my appetite.

The staff here are very pleasant and eager to explain the processes at the business, as well, they encourage you to try the flavour of the frozen yogurt before you fill your tub ( they will give you a little cup ).

The only potential downside is the cross contamination issues that could be a problem if the staff do not keep vigilant and change the spoons frequently and sanitize the handles on the frozen yogurt machines often since these areas are touched so frequently by bare handed individuals (children, teens and adults who may have not washed their hands).

All in all, a very enjoyable place for a nice cool treat.

I've only recently joined the world of hair and its complicated and challenging. But this barber shop has made it a lot easier. Sam is the owner and my prefered barber. He is very knowledgable and makes good suggestions to my requests. I actually like his most recent style enough to get it done a second time. 
His decor is minimal with some cool photos on the walls and a few sofas. The tv will distract you while you wait because there is no appointments in the barber world. 
For the basic cut its very affordable (under $20 for cut, tax and tip) but I sometimes get the wash and style which is only a few extra bucks but worth it if you're going out right away. 
St Albert has a lot of barbers and this is the one I choose to spend my money at because of the service, cut quality and experince. 
Thanks Sam!

I recommend visiting and supporting this cozy café in downtown St. Albert. For lunch today, my wife and I had the vegetarian combo with a meat item. The meal came out of the kitchen quickly. It was wonderfully flavoured, and generously supported with rolls of injera. 
Along with the Ethiopian food, the bistro has available a selection of sandwiches and pizzas, and I understand that even breakfast is offered.  Furthermore, there is a range of coffee drinks and other beverage choices, including Ethiopian coffee, and a selection of desserts. 
The owner was gracious and friendly as he chatted with us. After finishing our lunch, we left the café satisfied and warmed, pleased by the experience and resolving to return soon.

Went and checked out Eat Clean last week, was really impressed! The owners were super friendly and personable. The food was great, we got teriyaki bowls, my wife got a fresh juice and I got a wicked cup of black rifle coffee brewed fresh! We will be going back again soon and plan on rocking their meal prep to help out with lunches!!!

I went back again for their "weight loss pasta" and was super happy with it! It fills you up and tastes great - I recommend the pesto. Their vegetables were cooked nicely and they were fresh. Its one of those "use your fork to get all the good leftover bits" kind of place. The boyfriend tried their bison burger with sweet potato fries which I didn't try but he said was really good - the best he's had. Once again, great service and great food!

Stopped in here a few weeks ago after having found them featured on a website I frequent.  The girl who helped me was very nice and polite and gave instructions on how to get the most out of the cupcakes (bonus points that they actually keep them refrigerated and not in open air, unlike some other places)

Cupcakes were awesome - real buttercream, not too sweet, moist but not oily.  Definitely one of the best places I've been to.
The ONLY place I go for a cut. Been to a few places in town and Krista or Sam (owner) are the reasons I keep coming back. Quick, cheap and done to my expectations. Definitely recommend.

My best friend has ordered a few cakes from here and every cake has been amazing! I remembered eating left overs from their wedding and groom cake a few months after it was frozen and it still tastes the same. 

For my big 30, she ordered a barbie cake for me. I am amazed how perfect they make their fondant. And their buttercream... Loooove it! Their cakes are always classy and are always well put together. Thanks ladies!
Fantastic shop, reasonable price-- go see the purple hair girl (didn't catch her name) top notch chop!

Excellent service. This is now our family's favorite place for a treat. Great variety of flavors and toppings. This is a wonderful place for a healthier treat. We must have visited them at least 6 times in the last month. Highly recommended.

We had our wedding cake consultation to day (February 28) and we couldn't be more pleased. The shop itself is lovely and beautifully decorated with a pretty cupcake display and gorgeous sample wedding cakes. We're doing something more non-traditional (based on our favourite cartoon) so our consultation was with Jennifer, who was great to work with. I had talked to her via phone and email numerous times, so we had some idea of what we were doing going in.  She's a great cake sculptor, and her enthusiasm for her work is very genuine. She asked all about our ideas for the design and what budget we were looking at working with. She also talked about what she thought would work without trying to up sell us on anything we didn't need. And the cake! I'm normally not a fruit person, but the lemon cake with raspberry butter cream is to die for! There was nothing bad on the (very generous) sample plate. Shawn and I are very much looking forward to the rest of the cake design process and, of course, the actual cake.

I got one of their slab cakes for my birthday, and it was incredibly disappointing.  The buttercream was supposed to be raspberry but had very little flavour.  The fondant decorations were dry and cheap looking.  The cake was dense and extremely heavy; one of my friends described it as being like a block of concrete. 

Going by the other reviews on this site, it sounds like they do really nice cakes if you shell out for a custom design.  But they apparently can't be bothered to put much effort into a more ordinary order.

I must leave another five star update for the fabulous ladies at Over the Top. My son and I just had our birthday (1 and 31, yay us!) and we had a Doctor Who themed party. Rather than try and band out a TARDIS cake myself, I decided to leave it to the pros who did such a stellar job with our Adventure Time wedding cake. Again, with very little direction, we got the perfect cake to complement the theme of the party. Finn kept laughing and clapping his hands when we saw it; that's pretty high praise from a one year old. 

Not only was it gorgeous, it was delicious. We got tuxedo, and both the vanilla and chocolate were to die for. It's taken all my willpower not to have it for every meal since Saturday. All her party guests loved it, and kept asking where it was from. When I said the same bakery as our wedding cake, most people said, "Ah, that explains it!"

Now, up until party day, we had a pretty rotten week, so when I was surprised with a dozen mini Adventure Time cupcakes for my birthday, it made my day. It came out of the blue, and was one of those things that was totally not needed, but made me so happy. Little things like this are what makes a business stand out in my mind, and I find that stuff like this is getting harder and harder to find. 

Over the Top is going to be making all our special occasion cakes for as long as they are in business.
St. Albert needs more independent restaurants like this. The owner was friendly and genuine throughout our meal, and the food is very tasty.

Food: Had the Thai chicken quinoa vegetable dish and my daughter had the shrimp, brown rice and veggies.. 
the food portions were very good.  The chicken was very good and lots of flavor. I don't care for cooked peppers but these were actually cooked perfectly. 

Service : we were not greeted by the girl taking our order. It was weird to walk up to a counter and not have the girl say hello what can I get you? She just stood there waiting for us to place out order. For a new place, the staff could of been more excited to be part of a new restaurant. That needs work. 

Prices: well prices are a bit high. Perhaps less food and less cost, then your overhead won't be so out of whack. Part of clean eating is not to gorge yourself with carbs(rice, quinoa)

This is a very late review but I promised girl with the glasses and curly hair (forgot her name) that I'd make one.  My 25th birthday was in February this year and since 25 is a quarter of 100, I had to go big.  So I had a fondant cake shaped as boobs in my favorite bra worn by my now Ex.  She said that they had never made a tits cake before but would take the challenge and said that she found my Ex's bra to be very pretty looking.  So I had my cake tuxedo flavoured.  Picking up, the cake was perfect looking as it tasted perfect as well.  I can't say there's room for improvement but it would've been cool and funny to have the areolas emphasized through the bra hahaha.  Thanks guys for an amazing cake !

I think this is the best kept secret in St. Albert although it is probably quite busy on Saturdays for the farmers market.  The food was tasty...I had the breakfast croissant. The coffee was flavourful . And I love the ambience including the patio overlooking the river pathway....exactly what I imagine a bistro to be. Highly recommend.

It's always tough finding a good place for a quick, easy and here's the kicker, reasonably priced place to get your monthly haircut. Ok, more like your month and a half haircut - it all depends on the weather, at least that's my excuse. Well gents, I think I found a pretty good spot. After trying everything from student hair academies (dirt cheap but so slow with a 50% of getting a bad one) to pricier hair salons (generally good haircuts but way too expensive for my tastes).

Anyways, the place is called Barber Shop Boyz. Tucked in a little random strip mall in St. Albert, I stumbled upon this place one day and have been going ever since. The owner, Sam, is a very chill and easy going guy that knows how to cut hair. They have another barbershop out in the east end of the city.  The last time I went, a lovely lady did my hair and I was thoroughly impressed.  A hair cut costs $15 for adults which is very, very reasonable. Just walk in and wait (if there's a small line, don't worry - it won't be a long wait).

Anyways, great spot which I should probably have kept on the down low. You're welcome.

Phenomenal dance school in St. Albert offering programs from 3 years of age through adult.  

Dance Co. offers a wide range of programs from Happy Heart Dance Pre School to all the standard schools of dance: jazz, tap, hip-hop, lyrical, ballet, Musical Theatre and Ukrainian dance.  They also offer competitive dance programs as well as adult classes. 

They have recently expanded to take over part of the building next door so I think this puts them at about 6 dance studios in addition to the Happy Heart Play School (Which fills up quickly for morning roster!).

They have a large seating area for parents to sit and wait while their children take lessons and even a little play corner for the chitlins.

They stay in constant communication via e-mail with updates and even offer an area to consign/buy used dance apparel.  

I feel very fortunate that we are blessed in St. Albert with such a talented and devoted dance school.

PS - As a new dance Mom, I appreciate that their pricing is structured based on number of hours taught to individuals in your household.  For each subsequent calendar year program your child or sibling is enrolled in, you pay a slightly lower rate.

There cakes are delicious and look amazing. There service is great and they have a variety of flavours to choose from. They have interesting cup cake flavours that really appeal to kids like bubblegum and s'mores. They also have other deserts like French macaroons and cookies.

Our wedding cake from Over the Top Cakes can be summed up in one word: YUM! Seriously, it was one of the most delicious cakes I have ever eaten.  All night people kept telling me how much they enjoyed the cake, and I have to agree, they have it down to an art.  

The consult appointment we had at Over the Top was one of the most enjoyable wedding planning experiences we had.  Getting ten different types of cake to try? Awesome.  They also do incredible cake design and execution. Their online portfolio is highly impressive, and the cake they helped us design was equally matched in taste and aesthetic.  The women in the shop were friendly and polite, and very easy to deal with.  Their delivery was on time, and the cake was set up and waiting for us when we arrived at our wedding reception.

I thought our cake was lovely, with only minor criticism.  We had designed our features to be brushed with a satin-pearl finish, and I was hoping that the pearl effect would have been more noticable than it was.  The pearl brush-on also ran down the front of the cake a little bit from our monogram.  I am sure I am the only one who noticed, but when paying a premium for a designer cake, I was expecting perfection.  That being said, our cake was a beautiful show piece at our reception and an even more delicious dessert.  I hope I can visit the shop again for another special occasion cake, or to grab a cupcake to satisfy a sweet-tooth craving.

I only want to post that we tried to go there this morning for coffee but the café does not open until 11 according to the sign on the door and not at 9, as it says on this site. Owner, could you correct the listing please?

Definitely a welcoming atmosphere and unique restaurant.  We came upon this place while shopping in downtown St. Albert.  Service was excellent,the decor pleasing and the Ethiopian food was delicious and filling. A bit in the pricey side.  We paid $35 for three people for lunch.

Target s a great addition to St. Albert. In he world of targets , it's small and not a full grocery store which is then called a super center. The store selection of trendy products is good. Not junk like Walmart which I refuse to go to. I only gave I a three store because of the small size and not a full grocery store. I am shocked to see that people have coded target as a 4 $$$$ department store. Not sure who you are. Bloomingdales ,Nordstrom , holt renfrew are four, not target.

This gem in St. Albert is an absolute MUST visit for anyone who loves sweets or somehow doesn't!

Located off of St. Albert Trail, this petite shop is full of talented and friendly staff and ownership, and an abundance of yummy goodness!

The Cakes are all exquisitely made with beautiful artistry and flavour, and the cupcakes are also works of art with endless moistness and taste.

Do yourself a favour and head out to St. Albert now for the best cakes and cupcakes around!

The cake makers' creativity knows no bounds and the taste is over the top!

Brought the fam jam to Eat Clean for their grand opening this past weekend. 

It's located in the old Second Cup in Tudor Glen. 

I love the bright, clean, and fresh look!  The concept is great - fast, fresh, and healthy.  Lots of great vegan options, too. 

We tried the following:

Steak wrap with sweet potato fries - $14.99

Strawberry & banana smoothie with vegan protein powder - $5.99

Protein blueberry waffle - $8.99

Aloe juice - $4.00

The food was good and exactly as described.  The chipotle sauce with the sweet potato fries had a nice zip but the $14.99 price tag was tough to swallow (I had ordered it at the recommendation of the CEO of the company who was behind the counter for the grand opening).

My kiddo wasn't a fan of the Greek yogurt ( I think?) that was on top of the blueberry waffle unfortunately.  I like Greek yogurt but didn't know that it would be atop the waffle.  

One sip of the smoothie and my kiddo wasn't having it - so he grabbed his faithful aloe juice that we usually buy at Costco.  (Note it was $4.18 here with tax/deposit and they are less than $2 each at Costco). 

I enjoyed the smoothie but I'm also more accustomed to protein powder.  

All in total $40 was a bit much for a quick bite in which we didn't all have entrees.  I can see this as a good stop on the run but I don't see myself coming as a family again.  ( We could grab a protein bowl or two at Starbucks or a beef and salmon bowl at Tokyo Express across the street for 1/2 the cost).

Of note, they will be opening their drive thru in the coming week!

First off, there is a lot of construction going on around the restaurant - so you're going to get into some detours before you finally reach the parking lot. The lot is also pretty snug because there's a new bar/restaurant that just opened on the other side of the building and those cars took up a lot of space. We were worried that it was going to be busy, but when we entered, there was only a table of 2 seated. 

The place itself feels a bit eclectic. There's a dessert display case by the counter, an area in the corner for the Ethiopian coffee ceremony and a variety of different types of art on the walls. We sat a large table set for 4 with a pretty tiled top.

Solo, the owner/chef appeared to be the only one working - though later on, a young kid came out to help as well. Solo is very personable and friendly and very willing to answer questions we had. The young man was very obviously working his first job because he was so awkwardly sweet and lost...we couldn't even be upset with his service because you could see him trying but really struggling. Maybe some more hands-on guidance would be helpful for him. Other than that, no complaints about service. Food wasn't a very long wait even though Solo was doing everything on his own, and our waters were always kept filled. We even got to sample a soup he had made and even though we didn't order the coffee, he let us smell the beans when he brought them out to the other table.

Now, the food! The menu is an odd mix - a section of breakfast-y things, some sandwiches (I assume he's trying to lure the downtown St. Albert lunch crowd in), a section of Ethiopian dishes, a couple of pizzas and a coffee menu. We came for the Ethiopian food and so we ordered the Chacha  Tibs (beef with onions & peppers) - $17.99, the Shrimp Tibs (small shrimps in a tomato-based sauce) - $17.99 and the Vegetarian combo - $14.99. Everything came out on a giant metal platter that was lined with injera, then topped with all of our dishes, a small salad and when he placed it down, the chacha was poured into the middle. Extra rolls of injera came on the side, and for me, since the sourness of the injera hurts my stomach, he offered me some crusty bread. :) 

The concept is simple - you rip off pieces of the injera (think a sponge-y crepe with a sourdough taste) and then use that to pinch whatever filling you'd like in it. The vegetarian dishes were plentiful (a spicy chickpea powder dish, cabbage & carrots, spinach & potato, red lentils, split peas and another lentil dish). Normally, vegetarian things aren't my jam and I'd be all over the beef, but I really really enjoyed the flavours of the vegetarian items. The spinach and the spicy red lentils were my favourite of those. The shrimp were small, but there were quite a few of them and they were in a flavourful tomato sauce that had a bit of spice to it. The chacha had strips of beef and onions (think fajita fillings) that was in a peppery butter sauce. Though not as tender as I'd have liked, it was seasoned well. 

Ethiopian food is meant to be social - communal dishes that are shared and lingered over (same with the coffee ceremony)...we found the portions to be good. The three dishes between the 3 of us was sufficient without leaving us feeling too heavy, but keep in mind that of the 3, the vegetarian platter had 6 things in it. We enjoyed the experience and will definitely come back. Love that there is an independent place such as this in the heart of downtown St. Albert and we will surely support it. My only regret is not bringing my camera - though we were enjoying ourselves so much that I didn't even think to reach for my phone. Now that's a good night. :)

Tried this place called barbershop boyz and damm I gotta say the haircut I got was fresh. The wait was only ten minutes, they had 3 waiting and 3 cutting, one of the girls cut my hair and they were all very friendly and the owner was a pretty chill guy and knew everyone that walked thru the door. Great atmosphere and the vibe is good.
I highly recommend this place to any man,
Price is very good as well.
I'll be seeing you in 2 weeks guys!

If one wants to feel great about the dessert or cake for any function, I strongly recommend "over the top cakes". It starts with the first phone call and the professional, vibrant and cheerful greeting from Brandi. It's all up hill from there from a beautiful cake that we cannot wait to try tomorrow, to the outstanding and very special personalized service making you feel as the most important customer. In my case, the team came in on their day off to make sure we had our cake for our special event. 
I strongly recommend this bakery for all your functions and celebrations!! 
Thank you to the team at Over the Top Cakes

I ditched Barber Ha (one of the highest rated on Yelp) on 82nd Ave in favour of this place because:

They do a great job.

TSN is always on the TV while you wait.

A hair cut @ $15 doesn't break the bank.

The owner knows everyone and is very personable.

Plenty of free F250 accommodatingly sized parking spaces.

Located beside a Tim Hortons.

The bad is that the location isn't very fancy and seems pretty empty inside but what kind of sensible man goes to a barber to look at the decor; that's right, nobody!

This used to be a Second Cup, so it's quite large once you get inside (there's also a drive thru!). The day we went, it was packed - and being our first time, we weren't quite sure what to do. People were sort of milling around, but no one seemed to have food. Thankfully someone told us that we order at the counter and then they call out your order either to stay or go. 

The day we went, they were super backed up because they had a huge school order.
