We ordered and waited about an hour for our food - which I don't think is typical (hope not, since this is supposed to be a quick lunch option). We tried the quinoa and veggie bowl as well as the Thai chicken bowl (which turned out to be the same as the first bowl, but with added chicken). Lots of quinoa, lots of steamed veggies and for the chicken bowl, a decent amount of chicken cubes. It was all ok and I'd go back and try different things. It's nice to have a healthy option for lunch (just need it to be a bit quicker next time).

Hello! We had the most amazing wedding cake on the entire planet! I couldn't be more pleased. Delivery and set up were right on time, and I cried when insane the cake for the first time. It exceeded everything we had been expecting. We had talked about an Adventure Time cake with a few sculpted figures in fondant, and what we got was a two layer cake with half a dozen sculpted characters. Our guests were blown away, and we got multiple comments that it looked like something off of Cake Boss or Ace of Cakes. I couldn't agree more. I honestly don't know what else to say about the fabulous ladies at Over the Top Cakes. Give them a go, and you won't be disappointed. We certainly weren't, and we will be back for any other specialty cake needs we have in the future. Oh, and did I mention it was one of the most delicious cakes I have ever had? Even the fondant was tasty, and that is saying something. We barely had any left at the end of the night.
Pizza was amazing. I ordered the spicy perogy pizza it was amazing.  Better then BPs, good spice. I ordered from skip, it was fast, a bit expensive but worth it
Had the most delightful lunch! We ordered the Ethiopian vegetarian plate with the beef tips. Absolutely delicious! Great service and so reasonably priced.

Delicious food and an incredibly friendly and gracious host. Thoroughly enjoyed everything about it. My wife loved the Ethiopian coffee, made from beans personally imported and roasted by the proprietor, and he was cheerful and eager to explain and recommend menu items.

I ordered 10 dozen mini cupcakes for a wedding after-party.  The woman that helped us was AMAZING!  So friendly and helpful.  The cupcakes looked stunning and they even color matched the icing perfectly.  And, of course, they tasted as good as they looked!  Thank you so much for everything!
Amazing food, friendly staff and nice atmosphere. Great spot if you're looking for something healthy and delicious

I'm really sad that Saviour's recently caused.  The hubs and I were just saying we looked forward to returning here for their Vegetarian Platter and outstanding coffee. 

:-(

Great addition to St Albert. Really great food and thoughtful staff to explain it all to you if you are new to East African food. The injera bread is top notch. Start with the vegetarian combo and the add some meat dish and enjoy. It is also a great place to bring kids. According to my daughter, "You have to eat here it's not small it's a beautiful and delicious meal eat here and you will be wanting more food than you can eat!its like all you can eat but better."
Through Skip the Dishes, I ordered a 12" Everything Pizza, an order of Hot Wings and a Caesar Salad. Excellent Food. Fresh ingredients. Great taste. Highly recommended bar food. Very yummy.

Ordered pizza from DJ's on Friday. The food was fresh, warm and filling. The menu is on the more expensive side and the quality of pizza is par with competitors. 

One bonus is that you can order from DJ's using skip the dishes which makes it convenient for consumers.
A great experience and wonderful food.  The flavours are awesome and service is great. You have to try this out. It is so good.

The food here is amazing. The owner is sweet, friendly and accommodating, and the prices are more than fair. I took my dad here for lunch, and we split the vegetarian platter. If you've never had Ethiopian food before, this is a great introduction. I can't wait to go back in the summer, when hopefully their patio will be open!

I'm just writing about the cupcakes and macaroons 

Went in to pick up some cupcakes
Selection is soso wasn't to much a fan of the choices. Wish they had maple bacon! 
Hated that the cupcakes were almost frozen so I had to wait couple hour or more for it to be warm and soft.
The bubble gum cupcake was awesome the icing was amazing! bang on bubblegum flavor

The macaroons were soso as well.the texture was awesome, but once again the flavours lacked.
Orange was disgusting. pistachio was soso.
Coconut was pretty good and cookies and cream was the only one I actually enjoyed
The pink/purple one was okay I think strawberry or raspberry but was a little too sweet.


They need better selection. More choice or better flavours 
Salted caramel is a hit for macaroons!

Well I don't think I'll be back anytime soon
I still think crave tops the list of places iv tried so far

Wish they would also make some with no dairy at least one choice that changes every week
Since I can't have much dairy cupcakes are a once a month thing if I'm lucky

As only a casual observer in the past while my nieces were dancing (at a different studio) I cannot claim to be an expert in the dance studio field. I do enjoy the time my kids spend dancing here and they love it so I won't complain or try to be an expert about the instructors or service! 

The lessons that I have observed are top notch in my books and the upbeat natures of the instructors are such a pleasure to have in the room with young learners. The older girls in the studio act as role models for my littles and I am very grateful for how they conduct themselves for this reason. 

The facility itself is in need of some work and would likely be up to a landlord to ensure that is completed. If the studio found them selves relocating I could understand needing roomier accommodation for their students and playschool. 

As a parent I am pleased with the pricing and happy they have couches . The leadership and confidence building were obvious draws when I walked in the door and continue to impress me whenever I see the front desk dorm mother role they so obviously have without trying.

Pretty good!
Ordered delivery from here (they're partnered with a delivery site, which is nice) for a group of 4 people. We had each heard very good things about their pizza, so naturally we opted for some. Admittedly, the restaurant is a lot pricer than I would like and it especially gets more expensive with more people to feed. We spent about $80 for the four of us (with leftovers), which to me gets to be a bit more than I'd like to spend for pizza (I can spend half this price at other places).
That said, this pizza is a lot better than many of its competitors within the city. Our entire group agreed that although greasy, DJ's probably boasts the best traditional pizzas we've had in years. After 3 slices, I was very very full, which usually never happens to me!
I do wish, however, that the restaurant opened earlier than 4pm on weekdays. I would love some lunchtime pizza!

I brought my son here recently when the wIt across the way at Tommy Gunn's was over an hour.  

My son was reluctant and nervous to try somewhere new.  When we walked in, it took awhile for us to be acknowledged despite two people on the floor - a barber doing a cut on a gentleman and a younger female stylist towards the back sitting down. 

Eventually my son was paired with the younger female stylist.  Either she's not experienced with kids or maybe doesn't like cutting kiddo hair (son is 8 years) but the experience was a little uncomfortable.  

My son is pretty good at sitting still but moves a bit when the razor is "tickly" to his neck.  I don't recall her making any small talk with him or asking him any questions.  The only things I heard her say to him were to sit still or  he'd get cut or his haircut would be bad.  I get that he needs to be still but you'll catch more bees with honey when talking to a kiddo - or at least my son. 

The haircut was good but not one that stands out as a fave. 

The price was the same as Tommy Gunn's but came with less - no wash, no treats (like pop), and of course no cool video games, lol. 

I wanted to give thIs Barber Shop another try to support local but I don't think we will be returning anytime soon.

So 2 stars it is - I hate giving 2's but the shell rating system dictates that 3 stars = a okay and 2 stars = Eek, me thinks not.  And unfortunately that's where we're at.  The customer service experience wasn't positive and the value for $25 was less than other Barber Shops.  Maybe this place is the bomb.com for regular adults but not for my kiddo.

The pizza was amazing!  We ate in and have to say this place has the nicest ambience with great service!  We can't wait to go back and try the appy platter and the lasagna, both of which we've heard are great!  How had we never heard of this place until recently?  It's awesome!

I stumbled upon a local cake and cupcake shop yesterday while in the neighborhood.

I decided to wander in and take a peek and was super impressed by their beautiful display cakes.  The atmosphere was bright and elegant.  They had a room off to the side that looks like it is used for tastings.  I uploaded pics of their display cakes - be sure to check them out!

Their cupcakes were $3.50 each or 6 for $19.50.  I decided to pick up 2 cupcakes to give them a try:  mint chocolate and raspberry lemon.  The cupcakes were the most beautiful I have ever seen in person.  We are usually a Fuss cupcake family and frequent Fuss about 6 times a year - I thought it would be smashing if I could swap our regular Fuss for a local Mom & Pop shop!  I think the price was about 50 cents higher than we pay at Fuss regularly; however, I am glad to pay an extra 50 cents for great quality!

The lady behind the counter was super nice and recommended I let the cupcakes sit out for about an hour before eating them - the tip was much appreciated!

I also eyed their gorgeous S'mores cupcake with a graham cracker on top and the Red Velvet looked divine.  They had all kinds of flavors I would like to try like Pumpkin Spice and Canadian Maple!  

...................................

1 hour later, as suggested, my hubby and I loved our special treat!  I did find the Mint chocolate to be a little moister than the lemon based cupcake - perhaps a day fresher?  I'm not sure what the foot traffic would be like in my neighbourhood - I cannot imagine it would be all that busy.  

My hubby and I both agreed that we liked both the cupcakes better than FUSS and the buttercream was the best we ever had!  

I think this will be our new cupcake place but it is good to note they are closed 2 days a week...  I think it was M,T but I will have to double check that.

I would probably be inclined to only purchase 2 or 3 at a time rather than the 6 we usually get from Fuss just because I'm not certain of their foot traffic and doubt they are baked fresh daily and a half dozen cupcakes will usually last my hubby and I 3-4 days.  

Two big thumbs up for Over the Top Cakes!

Excellent pizza, best in St Albert in my opinion especially if you like lots of meat and cheese  Definitely not for the faint of heart but that's what I like the meat lovers. But of course all the pizzas are great. I use Skip the Dishes. Apparently they are the # 1 for Skip The Dishes.

I've continued to enjoy delicious cakes and treats over the past 6 years since my last review. 

Most recently I enjoyed their light and fluffy macarons paired with delicious rosé wines at the grand opening of Wine and Beyond St. Albert.  And the most adorable sunshine cookies for Summer Solstice.

It's also worth mentioning that they are extremely community oriented and happy to lend a hand to local causes, whether for an impromptu flash mob of kindness or giving out delicious treats to kids on Halloween.  

Thank you Whisk for continuing to blow me away with not only your creativity but your kindness and compassion for others. 

See you soon, Whisk!  See you soon.

Came to Tutti Frutti last week with my mother and daughter. They've been coming here on regular Gramma dates for about a year now.

Prices were comparable to other self-serve yogurt shops but the variety was less than optimal.

The yogurt machines were cool in that each had two flavors and the option to "twist" each machine's two flavors.

I quite liked the Tutti Frutti tart - pairs wonderful with fruit.

But unfortunately the toppings bar was lacking compared to most other self-serve shops I've been to.

Despite the wallpaper having an abundance of fresh fruit including raspberries - there were no raspberries.  Raspberries are my favourite fruit and a yogurt shop that doesn't have them is literally a deal breaker for me.  Also, the syrup toppings were only savory no option for a strawberry or similar fruit syrup topping.

Props for a kiddo play area and optional rewards program downloadable through a smart phone. 

While my kiddo was thrilled with her concoction, I'd rather go somewhere that has lots of fruit - fresh or frozen just as long as there is lots of fruit :-)

I've been wavering between three or two stars, and finally am giving it three mostly because I've actually had worse experiences elsewhere.  I took my grandson here because I wanted his wonderful fluffy, semi-curly-when-it-gets-unruly hair to get a "little" bit cut and shaped.  The last time I took him to a non-kids shop (such as Beaners), they completely ignored my clearly stated wishes and scalped him.  What is it about a kid and a pair of clippers - do you HAVE to shave it all off?

This shop is in a large room, although there are only a couple of barber chairs, so it doesn't feel crowded and is pretty clean and comfortable.  It didn't take long for our turn, and I tried to describe what I did - and DID NOT want.  Well, it still turned out waaaaaay shorter than I wanted, even with me saying over and over during the cut that I didn't want it short, but I think the barber was actually kind of playing with me, continuously cutting more and more and taunting that it started out so long it was nearly a mullet.  Hey, it simply was over his collar a bit, it was NOT approaching mullethood, and I'm not weird because I don't want a buzzcut on the kid.  

I'm finding it frustrating that the shops I've taken him to all want to just buzz him short no matter what i say - it must just be the easiest thing for them to quickly do.  It's what my mother used to do to my brothers when they were young, but she had no training and didn't charge for her time.  Maybe mens shops just don't want to work on a kid who giggles because the clippers tickle his ears and has to be reminded to sit up straight on their booster seat - I can't argue that it's a whole different experience  :-)
Fantastic food! Great service and fast and efficient/very tasty meal prep! Can't recommend this place enough, if you're in the area I would highly recommend checking it out !

Dance camps anyone? We were lucky to get to try out 2 different camps put on by dance co. One last summer which was a mermaid theme and over the spring break this year as well. 

You can really see the instructors enjoy what they were doing. My little can be a bit shy and it was so cool to see her open up and start moving and grooving with the others. 

A big part of my rating is also based on how well the pivoted during the changes in protocols ect. We always felt well informed and were given tons of options. They do offer a ton of competitive and recreational dancing as well which we are excited to try in the fall, but I definitely can recommend the summer camps. So fun for the kids!
Just ordered off skip the dishes.  Was very surprised. Pizza was VERY good. Perfect amount of cheese. Great sauce flavour and crust was good. Toppings were excellent!

I bought a salad with maybe 1 cup of spinach, 1/4 cup of chicken, 1 strawberry drizzled with balsamic vinegar. The salad normally comes with almonds and cheese both I can not eat. I will stick to eating at Freshii because their salads actually fill you up. This is had to be the worst salad I have had in many years. I am totally disappointed since I wanted to go to Eat Clean for a few months.
My kids go here.  For dance lessons.  They like it.  I sit on the couch.  And play candy crush.  They come out of class.  They had fun.  We leave.  Sleep.  Repeat.  Thank you Dance Co.

Unfortunately this place is did not meet the standards that I had for it, I ate at an Eat Clean in Fort Mcmurray that was outstanding, this one is not. The smoothie was watery, the food tasted highly processed and over sauced. I know that sounds ridiculous considering the place is called "eat clean".. but that is exactly my experience. I do not recommend it

I have been constantly impressed with the "above and beyond" atmosphere at Dance Co - teachers are great and really seem to love their job, the summer camp was an outstanding experience with a pizza and slumber party at the end, the yearly bar-b-que goes all out to provide fun for the kids.   It's a great place for kids to find new friends, form bonds, increase their self-confidence, stay active when snow-bound, and enjoy themselves.  There's a comfortable waiting area for parents and someone always available to answer questions.

We just ordered from skip the dishes and my kids absolutely loved the food. 

The pizza was amazing. The cheese was super flavourful and cooked with a nice crispy top. The crust was soft and fluffy, and the sauce had a bit of a unique flavouring as well. My kids said it was the best pizza they'd ever had. Take in to mind they are 9 & 11.

I tried out the meat lasagna. The meat sauce had a brilliant seasoning so it. I definitely have not had a lasagna quite like that one and will definitely order it again. Again they definitely do need t skimp on the cheese with this dish either. I also loved how the noodles were a perfect al dente texture. 

Definitely two thumbs up. And will be ordering again.
The food is superb! It's fresh , even the fruits they serve with the food! I love it ,I  never thought that being healthy is enjoyable until I found this place! Kudos to the owner and employees :-)

Stopped in for a quick look at their desserts and ended up leaving with 3 cupcakes to try. The gentleman who help us was super passionate about all the products and was able to answer my million questions including which was the most popular (vanilla and salted caramel). Overall not a bad cupcake, very moist cake and each flavour had a unique taste.

I went to this barber shop and it was the worst haircut experience I have ever gotten I would rather given my 9 year old niece a pair of scissors and asked her to cut it instead of the shorter guy that works here. I asked for my hair to be a certain way and he agreed then he asked me again and showed me what he was going to do and it didn't even come close to what he was describing to me. I'm very upset and I don't even know why I paid. I will never be going back to this barber shop because of how horrible of a job this guy did.

Nice place to let kids have fun choosing flavours, serving themselves from the yogurt machines, and then go crazy at the toppings bar.  It's the biggest selection of toppings I've ever encountered, but keep in mind that your final cost is determined by weight and an unattended child with big eyes can accumulate quite a bill for you  :-D.  There are bobas and sprinkles and candy galore, but also some less-sugary choices, so everyone should be able to find what they like, and then there are decadent syrups to add, including chocolate, caramel and Reese's peanut butter sauce.  All in all, a great treat.

Side note: the plastic spoons are cute and sturdy and it makes me sad to see them tossed in the trash instead of taken home to be recycled for lunch boxes or even playing in the sandbox - please get more use out of yours before tossing!  

My only compliant is that the young lady who's been working in the evenings when we go likes to hang out in the backroom and sometimes you have to summon her to come out for assistance.  Maybe it's phone texting or even legitimate chores, but I'd prefer to feel the staff is available out front when customers are in the shop.  I suspect it's all-too-easy for older kids to re-visit the toppings bar with no one keeping an eye on the business, as well as I've seen toddlers playing with the items at the front of the bar.

Great place to get a hair cut, my sons and I have been going there since we moved to St . Albert.

Have probably got hair cut from every barber there and there were great.

Nothing else left to say just giving credit when credit is due.

An awesome new addition to St. Albert's restaurant scene. I popped in for lunch for my first time a couple of weeks back for a healthy lunch as I was working two football games that evening. The pricing was maybe a little higher than what I traditionally look for when I go out to eat for lunch, but then again you get what you pay for and eat clean is a spot that advertises and delivers on fresh and healthy ingredients.

I opted for the Thai Grilled Chicken Bowl with quinoa and veggies. It was spicy, fresh, tasty, healthy and a perfect sized portion. The fruit infused water was awesome as well.

Looking forward to trying more here in the coming weeks, especially their smoothie menu. A great new spot that I seriously hope does very well!

Alright, my first 5 star review and I'm going to pour the kool aid hard on this one. This place is fantastic. We had the African breakfast and the Ethiopian vegetarian plate as well as the organic coffee. They roast and grind their own coffee , the presentation and flavour is incredible. The food was amazing, only surpassed by the incredibly friendly and personal service.

St. Albert needs more independent ethnic spots like this. Support these people, they have a great thing going and deserve to succeed.
Love the Death by chocolate and there bubblegum Flavors the best so far. I love so love how you put dummies and chocolate and raspberries in a certain type of things on your frozen yogurt.

First of all people... Target is NOT Walmart!

     Not. In. Any. Way. Shape. Or Form.

Here's my take on some of the differences between Target and Walmart:

1.Target doesn't have products that is advertised in the flyers on their shelves. 
REBUTTAL: Show up earlier because popular items sell out quickly.

2. Walmart's prices are lower.
REBUTTAL: So is Walmart's quality.

3. Walmart has Tim Hortons.
REBUTTAL: Target has Starbucks.

4. Walmart has McDonald's.
REBUTTAL: Target has a pharmaceutical staff that cares about your health.

5. Target has better selection in the States, than in Canada.
REBUTTAL: The United States has 300 million people. Canada has 30 million. (There are also many lines of products that are not available to Canadian distributors.)

6. Does Walmart have a family washroom?
REBUTTAL: Target does.

7. In general, which store is cleaner?
REBUTTAL: Uh... Target, by a freaking landslide. 

8. Walmart has greeters as soon as you walk through their doors.
REBUTTAL: Clearly, Target doesn't believe in having their clientele accosted.

9. Walmart has some stores that are "Super Centers", and some that aren't.
REBUTTAL: Target is just Target.

10. Walmart staff sometimes know where a certain product is located.
REBUTTAL: Target staff will take you to the product that you're looking for.

     One thing that I like about Target is that they have a nice, quaint little Oilers section, to appeal to the local market. They have a selection of t-shirts, hats, hoodies and apparel for men and women, along with kids' jerseys and even onesies, bibs, bottles and pacifiers for babies. 
     Does Walmart?
     No.

     I had a wonderful experience in receiving my flu shot through the Target pharmacy. Just on a whim while shopping in the St. Albert location, the trophy wife and I decided it would be a good idea to get flu shots. While the staff was extremely knowledgeable and friendly (and without the need for an appointment), we signed a paper, sat down in a chair in the back of the clinic, rolled up our sleeves and before the pharmacist could finish saying, "deep breath...", the shot was in, out and completely painless. This was a far cry from last year when I got my flu shot from a temporary clinic at the mall, and my arm was swollen and throbbed for three weeks. 

     In conclusion and in my opinion, going to Target is always an enjoyable experience, while I can't always say the same about Walmart. Do I boycott Walmart? Not at all, for I will admit that they do have more things in their Super Center than our little Target has, including square footage. 
     As far as an overall shopping experience goes, and if I had to choose one over the other, Target would be my overwhelming choice. 
     My world wouldn't crack in half if I never walked into another Walmart again.

I have not had a "barber" I have been loyal to since I moved to Edmonton 20 years ago. In college I went to whoever had hottest girls. Now its best cut and who can get me in. What can you say about a barber shop? I mean it is nice and clean inside. Has that hip ambience that most barber shops are going for these days. Staff was friendly enough. Main thing, the cut was very good. Price was normal for a guys cut. Likely be back again!

We went during covid. They are open but you call with your order and they bring it out. We had assorted macarons and black forest, German chocolate, and lemon cheesecake cupcakes. Everything was delicious. We will definitely go again.

Year end update - if you like eggnog, get over here NOW - it's fabulous flavouring done right!  And, to make it even sweeter, you'll get a great coupon card with your purchase to come back at a discount.  Can't ask for more than that!   

Also two fruity sorbets today, which is unusual - lemon and mango.  Another seasonal flavour that I can't rave about (although my granddaughter liked it) was Candy Cane Oreo (I don't think they called it Oreo, but the pic was along that genre).  This pic also showed it would be red, but it was chocolatey brown, and I didn't really taste the mint.  Oh well, not every flavour will appeal to every customer, right?  The eggnog had me smiling :-)

This is not so much of a review as it is a fond farewell.  Coming from the U.S., I was a diehard Target fan, was excited when it came to Canada, and sad to see it go.

And I now realize I extremely dislike the liquidation company that is closing it out.  They removed all the scanners so you can't tell what the price might be on an item, and can't depend on the shelf sticker to be "true" because the freakin' company has RAISED prices above what Target was charging - so AFTER you take the discount close-out deduction, MAYBE you end up close to what the original shelf price would have been! NOT FAIR!!.   Watch the register as you pay, because you'll be charged more than you expected.

Sorry to all the employees losing their jobs, sorry to customers who won't have options other than Walmart anymore, sorry for the monetary loss to Target.

Sad day.
High priced food...very small portions smoothie was grainy and for a clean eating establishment I felt more bloated than ever...not a fan

This was my first time having Ethiopian food, and I was so impressed food was great.  Service was great and recommendations were good.  Owner even talked us into ordering less than we were going to, and the amount was perfect.  I returned again and had the same great service and great food.  I highly recommend  this restaurant.
Marilyn N

Updating to appreciate two special nights recently - on National Froyo Day, you could fill your cup to overflowing for $5.99, and on Valentines Day it was buy-one-get-one-half-off.  Plus, they've been adding delicious fruity sorbets in the last couple weeks, so delicious!

Lame lame lame ! I'm 40 years old and I got refused at the entrance  ......... so I got ID'd at 8 PM with my GF and I had an expired license on me because I lost my original one ,which I will be getting in a week ,so I explained to him the situation and still it was a no go ,so I called the manager explaining the situation and still nothing came out of it ! My gf and I  would always go there  the waitresses were awesome with us , well now I'm sitting at Central and it's super nice and great staff ! So this is our new home and ill make sure all our friends come check it out ! St albert is a small town and I think they could have used  better judgment with there loyal customers! Thanks brew house !

I found this little restaurant by accident, but it was amazing. It's a family restaurant that go above and beyond any restaurant I've ever been to. I ordered a pizza for my kids and because I helped a stranger the restaurant gave me a ceaser salad for free. My mouth is still watering after eating their salads. Wow thank you so much for being kind.

First time at this fairly new Mexican restaurant in St Albert. Located right on Perron Street which is the downtown main street. There's a little cement "patio" in front which they share with Jack's Burgers (same owners).
Tastefully decorated with posters and wall art that adds to Mexican feel. There is an upstairs open dining balcony that over looks main street. Lots of free street parking.
Our waitress was very helpful, friendly, and efficient. We ordered the gringo beef & chicken al pastor as quesadillas which came out fast. Both incredibly delicious. The beef was too heavy for lunch and very filling. The pineapples in the chicken were skimpy to non existent....our waitress said they were a standard measured out amount. Both had ample meat and gooey cheese. Best things were the fresh, homemade salsa and guacamole....worth traveling from Edmonton for. Definately will be back to try the rest of the menu!

Just had the opportunity to try the new menu! It's like being in Mexico all over again. You can really tell everything is fresh made. The real tortilla chips and fresh guac are a great addition! The dessert platter was something I've never had or expected, and absolutely loved it! 
Surprisingly, even the vegetarian options were awesome! Glad to see the menu is staying fresh and with the times. Although I do miss some of the old favourites, the tacos make up for the void, and the varieties of tequila wash everything down nicely!

They have a new kitchen in their tap house. Good food made with the beers they brew?! Sounds like a match made in heaven! Check them out for lunch or dinner. 
Of their beers my favorites are clockwork orange and pumpjack but they also have some other selections I've never tried. I will definitely need to try their death by pumpkin beer for my Thanksgiving dinner! And maybe get creative and use it in my pumpkin pie!

Be waiting awhile to try this place, was super excited when it opened and finally got to last weekend. Our table was over 20 so keep that in mind. First of the "Canadiana" awesome. Hockey stick hichair! Boom. Yes I realize that was spelt wrong. The wall to #11 great idea in the home town! The buzzers a neat idea but could be bad for waitresses with drunks. The ceaser awesome! However my vodka coke was in such a tiny glass it coulda been a shot! Everyones food looked awesome from wraps to burgers, pizza and nachos. However they forgot mine  Eventually I asked for it and they did rush it out on the house. It wasn't as good as I thought. Maybe because I had hyped the tuna poke up in my head all week but it was only okay. Not bad but nothing I will order again. The service was great and I will definitely be back!!!
Best nachos (with chicken) in the word! I know, it's a big claim but they truly are great!

Terrible business, I wouldn't bring my pets here for a hair cut, they totally messed up my wife's hair didn't even listen to what she had asked for and they pretty well said if u take out a second Mortgage on your home you might get this fixed the way you want, I wouldn't recommend anyone coming here unless you want dior hair messed up.

It's great to finally have a good Mexican restaurant in St Albert. Cozy but trendy restaurant with a laid back atmosphere. Food was great! Great flavour and nice presentation. Services was great. We received our food and drinks very quickly. I will definitely be going back here.

Okay so I had heard a lot of good things about this and I wanted to see what the hype was all about. Their corn for an Appy was super tasty and the tacos are amazing, my girlfriend got a margarita and she loved it. Will definitely be going back
Best Tacos in town, usually pretty good service and food overall. I enjoy the atmosphere and the rooftop patio. Definitely recommend it, and try their nachos!

Drove 15 minutes from the north side to pick up our order...thought we'd try a new place. And it was totally worth it!! Best pizza I've had for ages. Such fresh toppings and the crust was really nice - different. Delicious sauces too! Mouth watering :) So sad that I can't get delivery to our house, but we'll order from here again. No question.

This FAMOSO rocks in the summertime for the patio alone!

We are always seated quickly here, receive fabulous and attentive service 9/10 times, and if there are any mistakes, they are quick to rectify the situation.

Staff always seem familiar with all the items on the menu even when I ask about new ones and are friendly.

On our most recent visit, we ate on the patio which had a great selection of tables and 2 couch sets with a lower coffee style table.  Plenty of umbrellas if you'd like to open one or a few up to provide some shade.

The parking lot is more than a PITA (pain in the a$$) but that's out of their control.

I highly recommend the current summer feature pizza the Don Andreas - YUMMY!  The avacado and cilantro are divine and the spicy side of hot sauce with lime really hit the spot.  As always, their gelato is second to none :-)

We will most definitely be back again and again.

PS - They have great lunch specials where you can get a pizetta (mini pizza) and soup or salad.  And if you have kiddos, their menu is the same but with a scoop of gelatto!  Very family friendly :-)

Great pizza right around the corner from home!! Just finished our 3rd order from Amore and it was great as usual. Each time the pizza is cooked just right always with a generous amount of topping. Pick up orders are always fast and the staff are great. This is now our favourite pizza spot in St. A, would definitely recommend trying it out! Thanks Amore :)

My husband and I were very excited to see a Mexican restaurant open in St. Albert so close to home.  When we went it was extremely busy but we managed to get a table and were served very quickly.  We didn't wait long for food or drinks and the service was great.  We had nachos to start which were fantastic and the beef and pork tacos that were to die for.  Can't wait to go back and try more!

Always like popping into here for a margarita or two. The decor is fun with the luchador theme. The staff is always friendly and eager to please. The food has always been tasty and reasonably priced for what you get. If you want cheaper go to Taco Bell, but you won't get the quality you will at Cerdo. I've found the portion size to be just enough to make me comfortable but not overly full which to me is a good thing. Also if you get the chance try their Pinocchio brand gelato it's delicious!

I took a friend here for lunch today. The service was slow and unpleasant.  They were out of the beverage we wanted. We waited for a long time to have our order taken, then had to ask for napkins, knives, and pepper.  The salad was lacking flavour... just thawed shrimp and some avacado on top of a limp lettuce mix.  I had to hunt down the server for our bill which came to $27.00 for two salads and water. No smiles or thank you from our server. Very disappointing experience.

Trust me, get the pork!
Thank god we finally have a great taco place in St. Albert. I've been twice and I can't get off of the pork tacos. The steak tacos are great and so are the shrimps tacos, but that pork... It beats any taco in the city and I've been to them all. 
They have a great selection of drinks, the tequila selection however is small but I'm sure that will change (they are new). The 3 dips with chips is really good, and the corn as a side is amazing! 
The only reason it's not five stars for me is the rice and beans. They're not good. Everything else is wonderful.

Offering good service and a warm welcome, Cerdo suffers from being a tad inauthentic and from featuring prices that are too high for this type of food and this type of dining environment.  Although I'm happy enough to have tried it out, I don't know if I'll be in any hurry to pay a return visit.

These guys are outstanding.  Quick to respond to phone calls and follow through with promises.  Send in a knowledgeable technician not just a salesperson.  We landed up not using them. So why the five star review?  Well it was their honesty.  Provided a detailed assessment of our older homes ventilation.  Recommended updating the ventilation system before they would install an air conditioner.  This kind of honest is rare these days in the service industry.  I would high recommend True North and plan to use them in the future.

I love Famoso. This one is new, and a bit overwhelming since there's more staff than diners, including at the tables. Never certain who works there or not, as they all seem to be from high school. New oven, so far so good. Not sure how it will get when the ovens are older, as pizzas seem to get charred when either the ovens are not well-maintained or the chefs make mistakes.

This place is great for the after work crowd that wants to kick their feet up and have a drink after a hard days work. They have food specials, drink specials, pool tables and everything else you need for a good time. 
Friday and Saturdays it turns into a lounge complete with DJ and dance floor so you can show off your moves! 
Remember to look through their drink menu as they have some great creations.

Took my cousin and her husband here for a chill night out for some drinks and eats since it was close to my house.
This was my 3rd time back and decided to up my rating due to always having great service here, as well as feeling welcome by the staff.
Nice to have a pub with live music once in a while near by instead of having to go somewhere down town or other part of the city.
They have downsized the night menu for food, as I was told that they would be concentrating more on appys.  So that's the only thing should be aware of, if thinking to come here for dinner you may be limited.  Otherwise, my view hasn't changed that this is a very laid back pub.

Excellent Beer; Excellent Moonshine! 
Truly a place that deserves your attention. 
It's not called "Hog's Head" anymore, though they do serve Hog's Head Brewery products, made on-site. Try a "Flight" to get the true experience.

The new name is "The Beer Factory" and it is under new Management.

Fridays and Saturdays they are open to Midnight.
They need their listing updated!

The food is quite good, too. Just like it was before.
Try the pork bites appetizer--you won't regret it one bit. 
They're aren't the same as the deep-fried, breaded variety.
Just Fantastic, like the brews!

And their prices are wayyy better than average.
Better food, better drinks and for less. Seriously.

They've built a new deck, too. It's huge! 
With a giant screen inside, they'll show hockey, football, soccer or whatever you ask for. Great place in St. Albert, off the beaten path.

Maybe it was an off night. Been to many locations and they've all been awesome. First time here and it was so so. Long wait, meal arrived before drinks, tomato sauce on Siciliana tasted very different than other locations. Our server was excellent though. 

Feeling like the fad is wearing off for me as the pizza is ok, wine is overpriced and staff seems without care and attention, aside from ours who has the name Night Barista on the bill so cannot give her props. She was great.

May return to give this location another chance.
Air conditioner was set so cold and was told by server they could not adjust it.  Otherwise service was good. Would not sit inside on a warm day unless you want to freeze.

Really nice atmosphere, clean and very welcoming.  Staff seem to be very young ,but for once they actually care about the service they give.

There was a mix up with our pizzas tonight and they were excellent at explaining and comping our meal. We really appreciated the honesty.

Food was excellent.

Highly recommend

Good food and great drinks!! The rooftop seating is worth waiting for. Multiple options for tacos, but my personal recommendation would be to have the carnitas, it's probably the closest to authentic Mexican on the menu. 

Overall it's a great place to meet up with friends and have a few drinks and some tasty tacos.

While I'm rarely in St. Albert, when I am it's usually to visit The Bourbon Room! 

I have only ever had their wings and pulled pork sandwich, but I have to say their cocktail menu is awesome! Served in giant mason jars and crafted to perfection, doesn't take many to have you up outta your chair and dancing! 

What differs this place from other piano bars is that if you have a request it doesn't cost you $100 to hear your song. While I had an odd request one night that the pianist didn't know, he offered up another great song that was just as good! These people sure have talent and pipes!! Don't be surprised if half the room sings along! You will catch yourself doing it, I promise! 

The service here is above par and the waitresses are attentive and anticipate your needs. In a busy place like this it's a great thing to see! They are friendly and great at making suggestions if you don't know what you're in the mood for. 

Don't be surprised if the owner pays a visit to your table either! There hasn't been a night where I haven't seen him working hard and making sure the place is running smoothly! If it's a special night like a birthday or stagette be sure to make room for a specialty shooter! 

What I really like about this place is that it's somewhere I can take my fun loving mom or my party animal friends. It really has something for everyone! A great place for a date or a girls night out! Even if you're not in the mood to shake your booty, you'll certainly enjoy the music! 

The Bourbon room also offers pool tables if that's your thing!

Dined at this restaurant with family for Sunday dinner. Heard they have delicious appetizers from a friend so we decided to give dinner a try. We all tried different beer and were pleased with them. They allowed us to sample a couple beers before deciding on one to order. 

For dinner, I ordered the garlic white wine fettuccine alfredo with shrimp and it was absolutely amazing! Often I find that garlic white wine sauces in restaurants aren't nearly garlicky enough but this had a lot of garlic, so I was very happy with that. Our party also tried the steak, the salmon, the tuna, and the BBQ chicken. Every one of us was pleased with our dish. I'm surprised to read the previous wishy-washy reviews because it certainly seems like they have worked out all the kinks. I would absolutely return here again.
Ate here recently and they were late with our pizza (barely noticeable). Our service was fantastic, the food was great, and they gave us a complimentary dessert!

Cerdo caters to the tastes of Albertans rather than Mexicans, but unlike Julio's Barrio, the food actually tastes pretty good. They also have a good selection of Alley Kat beers on tap and the rooftop patio is a great place to enjoy your brunch. I wouldn't drive out of my way to eat here, but it's a great option if you're in St. Albert.

My previous visit was mediocre; the food was ok but the service was appalling. This time it was overall terrible and ends this place for me. Friends wanted to try this place and I always give a restaurant a second chance. There will not be a third. Starting with the tacos, we each had the beef tacos. Well it was supposed to be beef but I would say they were pretty much 3/4 filler of cabbage. And that is ALL you get, no beans, no rice, nada. The little beef that was in the shell was so greasy I would not feed it to my dog. The margaritas are so over priced given what is offered and are based on tequila choices. They don't have most when asked or try to up-sell you by claiming they just ran out. The wait staff are young and pretty but lacking in basic customer service and really don't seem to know what they are doing. I truly wish we had gone to Taco Time or better yet, real mexican food at Calle. Even making my own tacos from box would have been leaps and bounds over this place. My advice is stay away.

Dont get me wrong the food is fantastic! The menu has a great selection of classics. It also has many experimental choices and they are very yummy! However the restaurant isnt really done up. Even though it is good I wouldn't take a first date there to impress her and the value sure isn't great. But keep in mind the food is amazing
This place is now closed. It's unfortunate they didn't let customers know it was closed on social media. I've seen quite a few people show up to the restaurant only to find it closed.

I love the hogs head! I have so much fun every time I go. The food is amazing, home cooked, and fast! Service is friendly, I feel like I'm among friends :) this is my fave place to start the night and have a good meal along with some home brewed moonshine :)

P.S. they've recently changed their name to "beer factory" just FYI

Subpar menu.  The lime margarita was the worst I have ever tasted.  Tequila poured into a glass with lime flavouring and slush.  It had no salt on the rim nor was it stirred.  My wife ordered wine.  Sent it back because the glass was dirty.  They returned with another dirty glass of wine.  They offered nothing as compensation for two orders of dirty glass wine.
The nachos were pretty tasty.  Small helping for the price.
Without sugnificant improvements this restaurant will not even be a memory.

Went at 7:40 and they turned us away but the door says open until 8. A beautiful evening disappointing was our 1st time entering the establishment tried jacks beside it instead (who also close at 8) they happily served us and we had the best burgers ever!

We take all our mechanical fix ups here. Never had a problem they couldnt fix. They have always stood by their work. The customer service is always great! If you need a mechanic in St. Albert stop by here!

I was recently part of a wedding in which the bride had her hair trial done at this studio and had then booked the bridal party's hair on the day of the wedding. 

The bride made arrangements with a hair stylist to open 30 minutes earlier to accommodate the 5 extra people needing to get their hair done. The hair stylist only came in about 10 minutes after the salon actually opened and did not apologize for showing up extremely late. She forgot she had this early appointment! 

The bride's hair did not turn out exactly as the trial she had done a couple of weeks prior to the big day. 

I had my hair done by someone who did not listen to my original request. I came in wanting a simple straight style. I was convinced to get curls, which was fine. I requested a slight bang trim and left with bangs that were cut very uneven and too short.

Everyone in the bridal party left pretty disappointed with how their hair was done that morning.

Great to have a Mexican option in St. Albert! It is the same great owners as Feast and Lounge, but with a whole new menu. When it comes to the drinks and food we tried the peach margaritas, nachos with chorizo, and chorizo tacos with a side of corn which were all great! The taco portions are large so I would recommend splitting one between two people.

Had their donair pizza again and it just gets better and better! Cooked just right, home made donair meat and sauce.  Fresh onions and tomatoes on top. The care and pride of this family run place shows. Great pizza and Donairs!  Top notch service!
Good price -- try them!

Unfortunately this place missed the mark in both service and food.  

Sounds like a bar/pub right?  But it's actually family style restaurant.  

Inconsistent is the only thing consistent here :-( Found the lighting odd as mentioned by other reviewers and the overall hugely open space.  Nothing seemed to jive here.  

Between menu and ambiance, just couldn't get a co sister vibe or outcome.

Salads are $15 range, burgers are $18ish, steaks are $30ish.

Also, as noted by another reviewer, washrooms are up a flight of stairs which is important to know if you're planning on bringing someone who cannot do stairs.

First visit to Cerdo. Service was good and friendly. They advertise that they support a local butcher shop with their meats which is nice to see. Atmosphere felt like you were not in St. Albert but rather in a small Mexican restaurant. 

Had the chorizo sausage tacos. Guacamole was great. Overall good sized portions. Not the best Mexican food I've had but the overall experience definitely makes it worth visiting again. Would recommend to anyone looking for a casual & relaxing beer with tacos. Well done!

Came here for lunch after a salesperson visited our office last week. 

One word - "underwhelmed"

Firstly, since this is a brewery I expected the first page of the menu to be...... beer! Well no, the first page was wine and mixed drinks  - beer didn't show until, wait for it....... The LAST page!

Menu was a little confusing, the "lunch" version of meatloaf is actually a sub-sandwich, not meatloaf on a plate as you might expect. The "blackened chicken ma and cheese" is actually a side serving of Mac and cheese, with a microwave-defrosted (at least tasted like it) seasoned chicken breast. There was no "star of the plate" as you might expect from the description. The meatloaf "entree" was the exact same thing with meatloaf instead of chicken. Meatloaf was way over done. 

Since Mac and cheese was the focal point of each dish you'd expect it to be good. Flavor and texture was great but the handful of unmelted cold shredded cheese and Luke warm macaroni made it lack-luster. 

I'll let them figure out how a kitchen woks before returning. The beer was good but unfortunately not what I will remember from this lunch.

The workers bring such a positive vibe to the store and everything is done efficiently. The work place always is so neat and tidy and they do their best to accommodate you according to your allergies. All meals are so healthy and meats are organic and local!

Oh how I love Famoso!

I recently moved back to St. Albert and received a Welcome Wagon package in the mail.  And much to my surprise it included a $30 gift certificate to Famoso!  Who does that??  Famoso, that's who.

So, 3 of us headed over for dinner on Saturday night.  We decided to share everything and ordered the Siciliana Pizza, the Famoso Salad and the... umm.... I forgot what they're called but basically cheese balls, wrapped in prosciutto and covered in a delicious tomato sauce (let's just call them HEAVEN!).

2 of us ordered Ceasars since they were on special ($5 for a single, $8 for a double).  And neither of us were happy with them at all.  There was nothing specifically wrong with them, so we didn't send them back, but neither of us drank more than 1/4 of them.  It would have been nice if our server or the manager (who came to chat with us and cleared our plates) had noticed and questioned it, but they don't lose a star for it because we could have just have easily told them about it.

I'm always happy with the food.... all three dishes were my favourites.  Service was very friendly and attentive.  Our servers name was Megan and she was very good at her job.

Can't wait to be back!

We enjoyed this place. It has a lovely ambiance. The tv in the corner showing Mexican wrestling was an impressive touch. It does seem more geared towards a lunch environment than a dinner environment. The music was a little loud for my tastes, but we could still talk. 

We both had the special. We found the food very good and very filling. Good price for what you get. 

Found the service to be a bit on the slow side, but the waitress was nice and friendly. 

Overall, we enjoyed the place and would definitely come back.

Had some time in the edmonton area and was recommended by friends to visit Feast and Lounge. Thoroughly enjoyed the buffalo skins, and the mac and cheese is to die for. Great drinks, great food, and great price! Definitely will be returning!

The Canadian Brewhouse is a nice touch for St.Albert, although it's in an unusual spot.
The place seems to be short staffed and not very fast. The food was decent, it wasn't amazing. 
If you're looking for a nice bar, with decent food, I would recommend the Brewhouse.

In March, St. Albert welcomed the new Cerdos Tacos + Tequila, a Mexican eatery located in the central Perron District and heart of the city. Sister restaurant to the neighboring Jack's Burger Shack, Cerdos Tacos + Tequila offers a wide variety of starters, huevo bowls, tacos and a drinks menu that will make tequila enthusiasts and margarita lovers proud.

Taking over the space of the short-lived Feast & Lounge, the owners discovered that demand for the comfort food-oriented menu was less than expected what with Jack's Burger Shack right there. With a passion towards Mexican cuisine and tacos, the space was reinvented and reincarnated to give you Cerdos!

Last month I spent one of my few available lunches to check Cerdos out. I recruited my friends Josh and Jesse (two hungry fellows!) to help me with the spread.

The P&C Shrimp tacos (think the Chinese takeout peaches and cream shrimp) were surprisingly delicious! Shredded cabbage and slivered almonds gave the taco a nice crunch, while cold marinated shrimp was refreshing and cooked perfectly. The plantain and peach puree added a touch of sweetness, a summer-patio kind of taco if I ever had one. Despite this taco being originally high on my "errr, I don't know" list, it ended up being one of my favourites.

Pork carnitas is a must order at any taqueria. It's a standard in my books. The pork was well cooked, crisp edges and the salsa verde was delicious. More salsa verde please!

I don't joke around when I'm determined to order the whole menu. Chicken Al Pastor and Gringo Beef tacos were also on our list. The chicken was marinated with guajillo chiles, a flavour that I wished pulled through a little bit more. The pineapples were a nice touch but became the predominant flavour for me.

The Yucatan Salmon tacos were a favourite amongst my tablemates. The spiced rubbed salmon were cut in bite sized pieces, making it easy to get a bite full every time.

Ah... the chorizo. At the time, Cerdos Tacos + Tequila was using the local D'Arcy's Meat Market's chorizo, one of my favourite products from them. Loved the fresh guacamole and definitely a re-order item for me. Since my visit, they have switched to using chorizo from The Salt Room by Chef Tony Krause. Love the fact that they're supporting local businesses and restauranteurs!

Our last taco for the day, the Cachete Beef Tacos. I was really excited about this one, a Mexican oregano and cinnamon braised beef with queso fresco and salsa caliente (tomatoes, habanero, jalapeno, cilantro, and lime). Perhaps my hopes were too high, I really wanted to taste every single described flavour profile! A delicious taco, nevertheless, but I'd love for a pop of cinnamon and the salsa caliente to hit me with all it's got!

All taco orders come in a set of two, with a choice of corn (gluten-free) or flour tortillas.  My personal preference: the flour tortillas. Tacos range from $7.50 to $12.50 and all can be made "Quesadilla style" for an extra $3. I would love to see more of the house made salsa on all tacos or perhaps put on the side for diners to add on at their leisure. Margaritas (also available as non-alcoholic) and cocktails (non-tequila lover options also available) were on point. Service and the kitchens were fantastic, given our large order and the start of a lunch rush.

Overall, a great space and atmosphere for St. Albertans and a with a wide variety of tacos, something to please even the pickiest! Happy for a great alternative to the much-loved Tres Carnales (still my fav!) that can be a little inaccessible for those who don't live in the Edmonton core. When the St. Albert Farmer's Market reopens in June, Cerdos Tacos + Tequila will be a fantastic spot for a meal and a lovely addition to their downtown area. In addition to Jack's Burger Shack, the two restaurants anchor the small complex and no doubt will make the people hungry for more!
We are still new in St Albert and our first visit was a good one!  First time Neapolitan pizza and I loved it!  Great service and very friendly to go with the good food!  We will go back!

This place really is good! I am so glad I stopped in. I ordered the shrimp tacos this time, and a shot of silver tequila;) looking at the menu, I believe the red snapper tacos will be my next adventure there:)

Just a day off at south common! I hear great things about this place but the only thing good was the server she was sweet and helpful. We had ordered 2 pizzas and both were soggy and could not even use our hands to eat..(first world problem). Maybe we are not cultured enough? The taste was ok for the creative names but would not go back.
Amore Pizza...Delicious. Great crust, not doughy, lots of toppings and cheese.  The family that runs it are really nice and friendly.  Great place to order pizza in St. Albert.

The tacos are delicious, albeit a little bit too expensive for the portion size you get. Each order of tacos is about $10-$11 but you only get two small tacos. I feel as though the price would be more suited to three tacos. The service is good and the restaurant is nice.

I don't generally go out much in Saint Albert but we were nearby and decided to check it out. 

The place was nice and there was live music with a piano set up central to the tables. The place was clean and in a good location and the staff was friendly. 

We ordered pizza and I got a side of stuffed mushrooms for myself and the food was fantastic. Great place to stop in for a drink for sure.

If I could give zero stars I would. GROSS. 
They claim they bake your pizza in 90 seconds. The flat thin crust was not cooked sufficiently so I sent it back and asked to cook the next one longer. Still not cooked long enough - dripping wet, and most of it was gooey dough. 

I can't imagine ever going back to this place.

Super convenient and attached to my Doctor's office.

They have a larger supply than Costco and can frequently make compounds that other pharmacies cannot!

Local and small - what's not to love?

This nail salon is terrible. When I walked in, several staff members were eating lunch as a group on one of the nail desks. I thought this was unsanitary. Next, I had my nails done. I got acrylic nails with a gel overlay. I told the woman that my natural is very thin, and to please be careful. She filed my nails too much with the drill, despite me asking her not to. Then, she used a nail file to file the edges. She filed to the point of bleeding on several nails, despite me asking her repeatedly to be careful. Lastly, my nails are full of tiny bubbles all over. They look terrible. When I brought this to her attention, she offered me a free fill in two weeks. I said that I didn't want her to do them again, and so she told me it would be free. Then she repeatedly said "go, go, go" until I left the salon.

Overall, the customer service was horrible and my nails look bad. Avoid this place, unless you like being treated like crap and having you fingers bleed.

It was the day before Cinco de Mayo and I went for tacos! I had heard for awhile I should try this place out. Totally worth it. First it is corny but at least it is trying for a Mexican feel. The service was quick and good. Had a mojito, it was meh but an actual good mojito is hard to find! The chorizo tacos though yummy! The fact is they have a few options which puts them way ahead typical tacos places. Oh and they have tequila so ya take that taco bell! $20 for a drink and a couple decent tacos is a decent price. I mean no it isn't cheap but you get what you pay for. I would say this is a great little Mexican lunch spot!

My friends and the many new friends we made enjoyed Duelling Pianos. The entertainment was top notch including crowd participation. Keith and Bree were the show tonight. Song requests were fulfilled. The service from our new server was awesome. We didn't eat but the plates I saw looked yummy.

Myself and my wife have been to Cerdo on a number of occasions and have enjoyed our experience immensely.  During one visit we had the opportunity to speak with one of the owners and told him how happy we were to have such a great new (and Mexican) restaurant on the St. Albert scene.
 
In demonstrating our St. Albert pride, we chose to attend your restaurant last night to share the great experience with our eldest daughter and her boyfriend, and my youngest daughter for the purpose of a family birthday celebration.
 
We arrived at 7:30 pm and chose to first order drinks and appetizers.  Shortly after ordering our main dishes, I realized I had forgotten to order a side dish that my wife & I had wanted.  I was told the kitchen had closed five minutes ago and it was not possible to get what we wanted.
 
Our waitress came and advised us of last call and we were obligated to put in another order for drinks. 
 
Our order came and the food and drinks were good.
 
Our entire party was shocked when the waitress came and interrupted our dinner, requesting that I pay the bill so that "things could get settled and it would make things smoother at the end".  I interrupted my dinner to pay.  The interruption was incredibly awkward and I cannot ever recall a situation where dining out, where a server has actually interrupted our dinner for the purpose of payment. I was horrified at this request and the audacity to interrupt our meal, however I think I was so surprised that none of us at the table said anything.
 
I also generously provided a 15% tip for a $200 meal that had not yet been complete.  Our server advised us many times to "take our time" with our meal, yet once paid, never bothered to attend the table again to see if we wanted dessert/coffee etc....(she did get us "to go" containers for our food).
 
As we were finishing off our food, imagine our shock and horror when this time, the COOK came by telling us that we had 5 minutes til closing.  We were NOT impressed.  We were made to feel that we and our patronage was not wanted (although our money clearly was).  We were rushed and treated rudely by the COOK, not to mention the server.
 
Our entire party was pretty angry at this point and left, feeling that we were not valued and quite frankly shocked at the treatment that we received.
 
As mentioned, we have previously attended Cerdo and was very happy with the experience until last night.  My wife and I as St. Albert residents feel that it is important to support small and independent businesses within the community, however we will take our business elsewhere in St. Albert if this is the new standard at Cerdo.

Came here at the suggestion of my coworkers after they gave it some rave reviews and I was sorely disappointed. Service was subpar and food was barely acceptable. Walked in and the place looked packed, asked someone at the bar (there was no hostess station) if there were any seats upstairs and were told to go look for ourselves. Ended up getting a seat at a communal table downstairs. Waitress took a very long time to get us water and take our orders. When we did order some drinks they took a very long time to arrived. Ordered nachos and three types of tacos, all disappointing. The meat was dry and everything generally lacked flavor. Will not return.

Took my wife out for a special dinner. Food was amazing! Had several different kinds of tacos and they blew my mind. The staff was helpful, prompt and super friendly. We will be back for many more dinners! Thanks Cerdo staff for an awesome experience!!
Very courteous staff that always greets you by name. A smaller pharmacy that takes time to ensure you are getting the best products and prices for your needs.

Love at first bite!  I tell ya, nothing makes me happier than a top notch mom & pop joint.

We popped into Amore Pizza tonight for the first time to pick up supper after a fun filled afternoon at the Woodlands splash park.


Amore Pizza replaced Grandin Pizza and opened its doors 3 weeks ago.

Lawrence, the owner, and his wife are longtime St. Albertans familiar with the neighborhood.  They were both super friendly and personable.  We decided to pop home during the 30 minute wait but could have easily stayed and chatted more.

We decided to bring home a super Donair with cheese (deseeded fresh jalapeños, homemade Donair sauce, and house prepped meat), an XL pepperoni & pineapple, and an XL feta kalamata pizza.

The restaurant is small - a delivery and to go kind of place.  They've made it their own with fresh paint and an homage to Uncle Dean if you catch my drift ;-)

The deets:

The Donair was superb and very fresh tasting.  In fact all their food was very fresh tasting.  Nothing was drenched in sauce.  It's like they but quality ingredients and want each flavour to stand out on it's own.  I had requested jalapeños or hot sauce and was pleasant surprised to find fresh and deseeded jalapeños in the Donair - yum! 

The pizza also had a rather indescribable way of tasting super fresh!  The pepperoni was quality and the kalamata olives were a plenty! The crust was chewy goodness cooked to perfection.  The tomato sauce tasted clean and fresh.  This definitely is not a place with loads of seasoning and spice - just clean and fresh goodness.  My only suggestion would be to do a little something to the crust to give it some pizazz.  Maybe brush with a garlic oil?  Not quite sure, just found that I was wishing the crust had a little kick.

Also, there was a surprise Greek salad with our meal.  Our family was impressed at the amount of toppings throughout the salad and the lightness to it.  Again, each individual flavour stood out!  The house Greek dressing was smooth and gentle contrasted against the sharp red onions, feta, red peppers, cucumbers, and kalamata olives.

If I were allowed to do 4.5 stars I would because I just need the crust to have a little something extra but Lawrence and his Mrs. Definitely bring it up to a 5 star review!  

They offer 10% off for pick up, free delivery over $20, and pizza by the dulce at lunch time.  Prices were perfect for a meal to bring home (just shy of $40) with plenty of leftovers for the kiddos' lunches tomorrow!

We will DEFINITELY be back!

Terrible service from kitchen, and owners didn't even bother to respond to my email telling them about our negative experience. I can handle staff who don't care but when owners don't care either I have no desire to support a local business. It's too bad because most of the food we had was really good.

So tasty & fast! The woman working the till was incredibly friendly and kind to my 3 yr ok:) 

So happy that I discovered this neighbourhood gem!!

Brand new location in St. Albert. 
So. Many. TVs. (Which is great if you enjoy the sports) 

Not many vegan options, I had the Greek salad. No cheese. If I were to go back there, I would ask for dressing on the side. It was swimming in it!

I'd try the veggie burger if I go back. 

For the meat eaters!
My husband got the chicken & Waffles and it came with roasted potatoes. Huge portions! He could hardly finish his plate. 

I'm the summer time, I'm looking forward to the rooftop patio.

I booked a private party for me and some friends. They don't have great specials for private parties but having the place to yourself, bringing beverages and snacks makes up for that. 

The staff gave us all a run down of how each station worked and let us go. I felt there should have been more emphasis on hand washing in between stations and the fact that some items would be provided when you "checked out". 

The potion sizes were generous, quality of meats were excellent (Hutterite meats supplied by D'arcy's), vegetable were fresh and plentiful. No weird ingredients like condensed soups either. 

I had a celiac friend who was accommodated and the staff were able to ensure no gluten contamination occurred. Another friend is allergic to tree nuts and all nut items were packaged separately to ensure no contamination. 

The meals I've had so far have been great. I will be back for more sessions.

Not authentic Mexican tacos but flavors were pretty decent.  
Food - chicken al pastor.  Not really slow roasted on a rotating stick al pastor (pork) but flavors were decent, good mix of sweet and salty.  Carnitas were good as well, well seasoned.  Chips and dips - guacamole needed seasoning and so did the salsas.
2 tacos for $9-$10 is not great value, that is where they would lose a half star.
Atmosphere - quick eats.  Maybe felt a little rushed.
Drinks - didn't enjoy any of their adult beverages this time and didn't offer Jaritos for pop on the menu.
Overall - mixed 3.5-4 stars.  I would definitely give it another go.  Not as authentic or tasty as Tres but it gives St. Albert another food option.

My family shared a late dinner and drinks on the patio this past Sunday night. The upstairs patio has a great environment with open air tables, closed in bar area and multiple TV screens to enjoy sporting events. The drinks were aplenty but the cocktails were overrun with ice, so the serving sizes were quite small for the price. We ordered several appetizers and a couple of main dishes. Service was abit disorganized as the order was mixed up and I received a plastic tray instead of a plate because no more plates could be found (they managed to find one later). I really did not want to stress about it at the time, but REALLY, wash a plate for the customer. The steak bits and jalapeno peppers were good but the burgers and poutine fell flat.  I understand that it is a BREWhouse and the food is not paramount but both the food (lack of flavour) and the drinks (over priced) were disappointments. Simply put, the value for your money is not there therefore we will not be returning. The Brewhouse needs to step up its game for this family.
Me and the Family went here last night. They have a roof top patio. The tacos were fantastic. I had the pork and the wife had the fish tacos so we shared them. The peach margarita was wicked awesome.

I was totally discouraged with furnace repair companies that just wanted to sell me something. Then I came across True North. From the first phone call, which lasted close to 10 minutes of Carmal asking me questions about my system -well, I was sold - in a a good way. The guys came out, were professional, spent considerable time doing diagnostics, then fixed the system and left us with some other recommendations, but again no big sell, just advising us. . All this within the quote provided on the phone. I'm recommending them to friends and family.

Best Chicken Tacos in the Edmonton area!!!! I've ate here about 3 times now since starting my job in the area, and I am never disappointed by the food and service. The decor of the restaurant is super cute too. Will definitely be back.

I'm glad St. Albert is getting some fun new places like Cerdo + Tequila! I get tired on the chains and if you're looking for a fun time locally owned St. Albert spot then I say this place is it! 
The shrimp tacos were the best! The salsa had peaches in it and it was simply a light delight!
I had a delicious glass of Pinot Grigio and a bulldog. I think they should use different glassware for the bulldog cuz it was hard to get a full stir on, which is essential for bulldog enjoyment. 
The place was very busy and the ticket times were a bit long, but it was a Friday night so I give y'all an acceptable pass on that.
All in all, I'd definitely go again! It's like one of the best meals I've had in stalbies (St. Albert) 
Oh, and they had chorizo from D'Arcy's Meat, which is local to Stalbs! Classy move! That meat was da bomb!

After checking out the Dinner Factory website, I decided to take the plunge and try out the this meal assembly system. After choosing 6 meals and booking my appointment, off I went to see if this was what I was hoping for. I was a little nervous to start, but after assembling my first meal, the rest came very easily.

 What I immediately noticed was that each assembly station was very clean and tidy. Each station has easy instructions for each meal. The ingredients are fresh and beautifully sliced or diced and the ingredients are stored safely in terms of refrigeration. There is no guess work as each container of ingredients is either pre-measured or has the correct measuring spoon or cup in it. After assembling each meal, I just popped it into the fridge and carried on to the next station. I had all 6 meals assembled within 1 hour! This was just so easy!

But the real test would be the ease of cooking once I got home. Five of my entrees went in to the freezer and our first Dinner Factory meal tonight was Chicken Cacciatore. I can happily report that the cooking was a snap and the final result was absolutely delicious! It was a sizable meal for my husband and I with leftovers for tomorrow night! I am really impressed and I will definitely return soon.

LOVE THIS LITTLE PLACE!!  Seriously one of St. Albert's hidden gems. Extremely reasonable prices, the Pizza is phenomenal, plenty of toppings and the sauce is a delicious homemade masterpiece. The family that owns the place is unconditionally friendly and accommodating.  Never tried any of the donairs but I would imagine the high quality extends across the entire menu.

Great food. Terrible service. I have been here twice and the food is good but not worth the wait. For the laid back vibe and quick lunch spot they sell they cannot deliver. As a new restaurant, this will sink them. 20 minutes + to get your order taken, not to mention drinks and when you do get them the drinks are never refilled; it's a very frustrating dining experience. Unless you have a lot of time, don't bother. No apologies either. It's like you are inconveniencing them being there. As Gordon Ramsey would say, they just don't care. They don't. So don't bother.

No Cheater Pints here! You'll get a full pint of ale every time....the glasses are big and full, the food is very good, lots of screens and lots of seats to watch the game and socialize. The decor is upscale yet comfortable. Cozy. Pleasing. And clean bathrooms. Live music.

I noticed Critical Mass was newly opened so we decided to try it. We sat in the lounge at a small table with club chairs. The chairs are too low for the table so our server changed them out for us with standard chairs. 

I wasn't familiar with most of the wines on the menu and asked for a small taster first. Was told no they don't do that...something to do with selling it by the ounce...maybe it's their inventory control system? So I asked if I could send it back if I don't like it and our server said yes she would take it off the bill. So I ordered a 9oz glass, and she suggested I should order a 6oz first because if I don't like it she has to pay for it. But I didn't want only 6ozs and 12 is too much so I took a gamble with the Pinot Grigio and it was fine.

Ordered their dry ribs, they were very tender and delicious.  Also had the house salads which includes mixed greens, tomatoes, peppers, cranberries, goats cheese and a house made dressing. Excellent! Lots of yummy choices on the menu. 

Overall I liked the food and server. Ambiance is a little blah, but once it filled up more it got better. But the no sample rule on the wines is a huge mistake in my opinion...a real turn off for a new customer.
Great haircuts by Kim! Great service, no waiting around, she did exactly what was requested and both my teenage girls got awesome haircuts from her, we will go back and see her again!

My boyfriend and I came here not realizing it wasn't "Blue Rare" anymore but decided to stay because we were feeling like steak, unfortunately we should of left, service was terrible, we practically received our drinks, ceasar salad that we ordered as a appy and meal all together, we both had the steak which came with a red wine sauce, it was ok, came with a side of potatoes and squash, the waitress gave us a 10% discount card for next time but I really don't think we will be back

Very attentive and friendly service even though it was quite busy due to the St Albert car show. Good selection of beers, a little pricey but at 7.50 a glass but in the range o brew pubs. They do make excellent Burgers and a great Chicken sandwich. The fries are perfectly cooked, fairly thin and FULLY peeled. Man I hate half peeled fries. These are every bit as good as McDonald's. The Burgers and fries are about $16 each. That is about the same price as Jack's Burgers across the street but a MUCH better burger. On top of that Jack's closed at 8 despite there being thousands of people in the downtown are for the car show.
I always find the food to be pretty tasty. Portions are a little small for the price you pay, but I find the quality to be above most mexican food places I've tried.

This is my favorite Famoso location. Not only is it a beautiful room but they often try new menu items here before they send it out to the others. I've been here at least 5 times in the past year and they aren't perfect but always enjoyable. They are really good with fixing any issues and now they serve directly to the table versus when they opened it was order at the counter.

A few of my favorite items on their menu is the gargonzola salad and the tomato bisque. I also prefer eating in cuz the pizza dough is better when it comes right out of the oven.

My wife and I just tried this new restaurant, which used to Rick's here in St. Albert.

We started with the dry ribs which were awesomely flavorful and tender .., probably one of the best we have had.

My wife had the hamburger with the pineapple and fries. Very tasty.

I had the butter chicken. Also very tasty. Spice level was mild- medium.

We will be returning to this restaurant and recommend that you give them a try.

I love the brew house. My husband and I came to this location before seeing a movie. We sat on their balcony. The balcony was nice. ( heaters for the colder days) The downfall. A few wasps kept bugging us the whole time we sat up there. 
Not really much you can do about wasps when there's food. 
The food was good. I normally eat the same thing when I come to all brewhouses. (The chicken quesadilla. It was a little burnt around the edges. But other then that it was good. The fries.... not happy with the brewhouses choice in changing their fries to crappy skinny McDonald type fries. Why have cheap fries at a good place to eat.  
It took us a while to get our food. We were almost late for our movie. But we have ourselves about an hour and a half thinking it would be enough time. 
The waitress was friendly.
Went in today to pick up two donairs to take home, love your food guys!! Keep the good work!! great chatting with you, and talk about golf!!!
