Had a couple of buddies over last night to watch the Oilers game and drink a few beers. We decided to order some pizza and I suggested we try Amore based on reviews I have read here on Yelp. 

It was a really good pizza... reminds me of the pizza you get at those "old school" steak and pizza spots like Capital or Coliseum. We ordered two large, a meat lovers and a pepperoni & mushroom. Plentiful toppings and cheese, dense crunchy crust, arrived hot and delicious. Delivery time was fast as well.

My only two gripes were the pizza sauce (I wish there had been more of it... I can't really even comment how it was as it was used so sparingly you really didn't taste it) and that it seemed a tad expensive ($52 after driver tip for two pizzas delivered). 

We will order from here again!

Great decor, clean and modern aesthetic. Personable staff who are very prompt. Great drink menu with some beers I haven't seen before. Really liked the rangeland pale ale. Had Bacon cheeseburger that was very moist and well seasoned. Bacon cooked perfectly. Fries were a real surprise, normally I eat after a burger but they were fried so well and seasoned correctly that I ate them all first. Never happens! Very much recommend this place.

I tried a few of the different beers... YUM! The owners are so knowledgeable and helpful in picking the right beer to try. My fav was the chocolate stout. I heard they are opening beer related food items in the fall IM SO EXCITED! I cant wait to go back and try out beer food to go with my beer! BEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEER

Best pizza in St. Albert!!
This place definitely lives up to the hype

This was my first time to this restaurant. We had a mixed group of adults and kids. They were very accommodating to the kids, and I was surprised that a place like this has a kid's menu since it strikes me as a pub style restaurant.  The service wasn't particularly the best, nor was it awful by any means. There was just something a bit off with a number of the service staff, perhaps it was a touch of arrogance that I was reading by not one, but a few of the staff.  I noticed that the staff were lacking simple manners, like saying excuse me when trying to pass through waiting customers or saying please and thank you. However the food made up for the service, ten-fold. The food was fresh, presented very well and so very tasty.  This restaurant knocks it out of the ballpark with their food, and I will definitely be back, hopefully to a better standard of service.

Definitely a welcome addition in St. Albert.  We're a city that typically avoids the big chains, but we needed a nice big sports bar and this fits the bill.

Food is tasty and drinks are good - what more can you ask for?   Oh!  How about 50 TVs all over the freaking place?  Brewhouse has been my choice for watching Hockey for a long time and I'm happy that we have one closer now.  Would have been great for last year's playoff run, but that's okay... we'll be ready for the next one now!

I was surprised one day when I saw Grandin Pizza had closed and Amore opened shortly after. We ordered a cheese pizza and a ham, pepperoni and black olive pizza. The pizza was better than the previous place and it reminded me a bit of Royal Pizza based on the style of pizza and the way it was cut.  We will definitely order from here again.
After a hot day in St Albert it was nice to sit down and enjoy craft beer at CMB. Tasty bourbon BBQ burger with yam fries. Prices were good and there was good variety for various tastebuds.

My boyfriend and I visited this restaurant over the weekend and had a really great experience. We sat on the patio upstairs which is one of the best in the city. I recommend ordering the Tres Dips (corn chips with guacamole and two salsas) as soon as you order drinks because the wait time for food can be a little long if you have nothing to munch on. We ordered the Gringo Beef, Chicken Al Pastor and Chorizo tacos. All of them were really flavourful and delicious! We'll definitely be back again.

Auto Select at 174 St. Albert Road - just behind the Petro-Can that sits next to the St. Albert Inn - is a fairly new business in that building but there's little doubt that it'll do just fine if the friendly atmosphere, the attention to detail and the customer service standards are maintained as they are now. The business is involved will all types of automotive repairs, has several excellent mechanics and a manger that goes the extra mile to ensure that you're comfortable. The hourly rate is comparable to most of the other garages and mechanics shops - in the $120 hour range - but these guys work to get the job done right - and with expediency. By the way - if you are looking for winter tires, Auto Select is my recommendation. I bought four new Hanook "I" Pike winter tires and had them installed on our new car last week. The price was between $320 and $560 less than any of the other (four) locations we contacted - so check them out before you buy anywhere else.

My girlfriends and I came here for cinco de mayo and I can just say that we have found our favourite taco joint. The food was spicy but so was the waiter. The service was impeccable, they were very attentive to our experience throughout the evening. Though it was obviously busy -because it's so good- we still were able to get a table in prompt time. From margaritas to gringo beef, all in all I really enjoyed this cute restaurant downtown St. Albert! Happy cinco de mayo

I've been really excited to try Cerdo for a long time... but every time I try to go, I end up at Jack's Burger Shack next door instead.  Not for any reason other than the fact that I am addicted to their burgers.

I finally walked in on a Sunday around 5 pm and ordered some take out.  Service was kind of lack lustre.  We took a really long time with the menu, since we hadn't been there before.  And when we finally decided, some of the things we wanted couldn't be done for take out (maybe mention that when you hand me the menu?).  Anyway, we finally decided and it took about 10 minutes for our food to be ready.

We got an order of the pork carnitas tacos and the gringos tacos.  Oh and an order of chips with 2 salsa and a guacamole.

The guac was good, but the salsas were a little underwhelming.  The carnitas tacos had big chunks of pork - I was expecting smaller pieces of meat.  They were pretty fatty too.  I would not order them again.
The gringos were great.  Lots of ground beef, just enough cheese and a big plop of salsa roja.  I added sour cream to it as well.  The menu described them as messy and not authentic.  Which although true, seemed like a strange thing to put in the description.

I watched the bartender make a few margaritas and bulldogs and was really disappointed to see that their margaritas are just tequila added to pre-made slush and lime juice.  

I'll come back if this is where somebody else wants to go, but it won't be my first choice.

I usually love their food here, and the service is typically good... but when I went there recently there was a sign at front that said "sold out." That makes no sense. Sold out of chicken? Sold out of drinks? Sold out of salsa? I'm horribly disappointed and confused with how a restaurant can "sell out" of food on a Saturday evening.

I normally get my nails done in Edmonton, but broke two and needed a place close to home. I live in St. Albert and I'm very picky about who does my nails. I stopped in here and they were able to fix the two and refill the rest quickly and professionally! They have the new chrome colours and she did an amazing job and a gel overlay to keep them from breaking easily. I was very impressed. The only downside was the price for the fill and chrome but I'll take it for nails that are done right! Definitely coming back.

I went to Just for You based on all the reviews for a Brazilian wax.  When I got there I went back into her room with the ultraviolet lights, no ambiance whatsoever.  She didn't leave the room while I changed out of my pants and underwear.  I lay on a table with a paper sheet overtop.  It was super painful and felt like it pulled my skin.  When I got home my bits were all swollen and red.  As the days went on I looked all spotty and blistered.  My partner looked at this and was shocked as I have never looked like that before.  The wax was either too hot or too cold.  

Would not recommend this place at all.  I am going back to Focus on You, she did an amazing job and not sure why I strayed.  Would pay the extra money to have a nice quiet room, fresh towels and a towelette to clean before you get on the table. And I nice spa-like table with a room that has ambiance.

We have LOVED Amore Pizza for a few years. The family that runs it are wonderful, friendly people. Sadly, I have noticed the last few times that the quality has gone down. Last night was the peak when we brought our pizzas home, took a bite and then tasted that dreaded char taste :( We flip the pizza over and it is burnt, overly well done and almost black.

One of my favorite places is The Bourbon Room, it has a great atmosphere with 2 pianos that play songs all night long, creating an amazing party and dancing atmosphere. A great place to meet new friends and get together with old ones.

The food selection is great and has a few different appetizing options pairing well with the great beverage selections available as well. We will be coming back again soon.

Came for a weekday lunch and was surprised they weren't super busy. The guy behind the bar was our server and he was great. Super friendly and a pleasure to deal with. 

We were told they didn't have chicken or fish that day, so we went with the migas huevos bowl ($12.50) and the chorizo tacos ($12) on corn tortillas. Hearty portion of chorizo in both orders, and it was very tasty and flavourful. The bowl needed a bit more flavour - I wish it was served with cilantro and a wedge of lime since I think it would take it over the top. There were lots of chips and the egg was soft and fluffy. They also didn't have fresh avocado, so they used guacamole on our orders (guess it's not made in house?). 

Overall, we enjoyed our meals and the service. We've been here numerous times and have always had a pleasant experience. It's a good alternative to having to drive downtown if you're towards the West end.
Great Pizza! Nothing beats a classic Margherita from Famoso. Our server Mike was also great, super friendly and attentive. Will be returning

A group from work met for a small informal bridal shower and I was very impressed with this lounge.  We had preordered an assortment of appetizers which were all very tasty and plentiful for our group. The staff and owner were very pleasant and attentive.  As we were all driving we declined the free shooter the owner offered us so he treated us all to mini cupcakes instead.  I would definitely go back to the Bourbon Room
Fantastic service !!!!! Fantastic food !!!! Brandon is amazing!!!!!!! Totally recommend this Brewhouse !!!!!! Portia is so awesome too !!!!! Thank you guys !!!!! We will be back for sure !!!!!

This is a fairly new restaurant and our first visit.   I was quite impressed with the variety and choice on the menu.  We ordered a couple of appetizers and a poutine.  All good was tasty and your typical pub style food, but fresh and good sized.  Refills on drinks were abundant and servers attentive and friendly.  The inside of the restaurant is cramped between tables but that is only an issue when walking in and out.  They allow kids here during the day, which is great for families and sets it apart from places like Central Social Hall and Original Joe's.  I am looking forward to coming back and trying the roof top patio when it is warmer.

Im sorry, but they undercook there Pizzas and call it authentic. I even asked if they could leave it in longer and it was still a doughy mess. This place sucks!! The cheese tasted synthetic as well ,wont go there ever again!!

It has taken us five years of living in St Albert to finally find a pizza that we LOVE.  We are so thankful they opened up!  My teenagers could not stop raving about how good the pizza was.  Top notch pizza and top notch customer service.  The owners are so friendly and accommodating!  Welcome to St Albert Amore Pizza, I hope you are here for the long haul :D
Really cool, chill brew pub.   Leather chairs, rustic decor and all their cool brews on tap. I had the Clockwork Orange and Death by Pumpkin beers and really enjoyed the cozy atmosphere.
Chinese food Thursday $6.99 50% bottle of wine 7.99 tankards of Bud and Bud light. $6.99 basket of jumbo shrimp

My girlfriends and I came here tonight for a some drinks and didn't realized that the football draft was on. We found it pretty loud and can barely heard each other's conversations. Food is mediocre. Drinks were not too bad. I ordered the buffalo chicken poutine and it was cold. I guess it's what I expect for pub food. Service was ok.

The Canadian Brewhouse is a large establishment that draws in a diverse crowd in every age group. 

The food is alright at best. The menu has a ton of items but because of this, not all menu items are constantly available. For example, we had free item from the Rewards app and the waitress told us they don't have any which seemed peculiar for a Friday evening around 7 PM. Additionally, we ordered a meatza pizza and it came out cold in the middle. When the waitress finally came to check on our table and we informed her of the issue she asked why we didn't notify her sooner. That was frustrating since she didn't come by to check on us for 20 mins or longer after getting our food. Anyways, she took the pizza and put it back in the heater for us (which probably isn't the most sanitary thing for a resturant). Our bill that night was full price and we were fairly disappointed. I would not recommend ordering that type of pizza.

Another tip of advice for future patrons is to be mindful of The Brewhouse's strategic marketing tactics. They advertise drink specials on the TVs but the specials are only for certain nights which is disclosed in the fine print. This is very deceiving as you see an advertisement for a shot for a certain price then get your bill and realize you're paying full price. 

Overall, I would never go out of my way to go to the brewhouse. The service is mediocre, the place is usually empty and the price is fairly high for the quality.
This place is all over the place when it comes to ordering food. Staff are rude as hell. The food is pretty shitty. Worst place to eat don't come here.

Won't go back. We ordered a medium pizza and breadsticks. The pizza had a strange taste, perhaps it would be to someone else's liking but no one in my family enjoyed it and the crust was burnt. 
The breadsticks were so burnt we just threw them away so I can't even give an opinion on the taste. Overpriced for a disappointing, burnt meal.

Well I decided to give the brew house in St. Albert a try. I first walked in to a half full bar. As I n walked up and found an open booth. The table was stained with grease and crumbs from the previous people who were seated there. A waitress quickly came up to take my order. Only for me to wait and wait. Then another different waitress came with my drink order to the table. When the rest of my table showed up we were greeted by yet another server? She at least was prompt with our drink orders. Which made up somewhat for the experience we were having thus far. 
The food was good. Usually most chain restaurants have similar standards. This was the case here.
Not sure however for the amount of staff on that the service is similar to what I've seen in other locations.

A great little pizza place that's not part of a large chain, located in the Grandin neighbourhood of St. Albert.  We found this place after searching for pizza restaurants on Yelp and saw some excellent reviews.  The reviews were accurate.  Great pizza, ample toppings and not too greasy, made for a great Friday night pizza and TV night.  They have plenty more than pizza on their menu, which I will definitely try next time I order.   Although we opted to pick up the pizza on our way home, they do offer delivery as well.

Friday's = time to try a new restaurant for lunch. Bonus, new lunch buddy! We decided to check out Cerdo Tacos + Tequila, sister restaurant to the uber popular Jack's Burger Shack because Mexican options are few and far in between this oasis we call Edmonton. Okay, technically Cerdo's is in St. Albert but come on, it's pretty much the same.

We arrived around 12:15pm and the place was packed. We had to sit in the bar area but eventually were able to snag a table as the lunch rush slowly filed out. Man, I don't know if this is normally the case but service was slooooow. Took forever for us to order and even longer to get our food. I don't normally complain (that much) about service but we only ordered two dishes!

Here's a breakdown of their menu along with prices (starters, huevo bowls and tacos). Seriously, I really, really, REALLY don't like when restaurant websites don't list their prices.

- Nachos ($13.50) with the Saltroom's chorizo ($3.00) - corn tortilla chips, jack cheese, tomato, green onion, jalapeno with sour cream and salsa as dipping sauces. The chips were crunchy and had that satisfying bite to it but the cheese could have used some better layering skills (it pretty much was all clumped into the middle). The jalapenos weren't spicy at all but gave the dish some colour. We added some chorizo - a tad expensive for a few pieces of chorizo, although it was tasty. The nachos were decent but we felt like you could make these at home pretty easily. Factor in the price, it's definitely overpriced for what it is.

- Chicken al pastor ($9.00) - guajillo marinated chicken, pineapple, cilantro and radish. The tacos come in pairs, topped with cabbage and onion and with your choice of either corn (gluten free) or flour tortillas. I don't understand their choice of offering two tortillas over the standard three. 

Given that, the tortillas were stuffed with a good amount of chicken. Cilantro was fresh. Pineapple was itty bitty pieces - a few small sliced pieces would have gave it a nice contrasting sweetness. The chicken wasn't bad. Overall, the taco was missing something - a kick to it, a Mexican hot sauce or something like that would have helped. We didn't see the hot sauce bottle until after we ate the whole taco though. Oops, our bad but they should have had something in it originally!

It's nice to see a more diverse selection of food options available in St. Albert. I know they have mad love for chains over here so I applaud the owners for bringing something new and different. I will have to try a few more dishes to see if my opinion changes of Cerdo's. As for now, decent spot but not my first choice in town when I'm craving Mexican food.
came to this place for the first time, the food was amazing and the employees were nice!

Wow this place has great pizza! So good that I drove almost 20 minutes for it....two weekends in a row. I was looking for a good pizza place on Yelp and found Amore. I have lived in St. Albert for 9 years and never heard of it. I decided to give it a shot and it sure was a good call.

My kids are young and are pretty picky eaters. They LOVED this pizza. We had a couple pepperoni pizzas and the kids couldn't get enough.

The pizza crust wasn't to heavy and had a nice crisp to it. There was a good amount of cheese on the pizzas and the toppings were plentiful.

We had the salt and pepper chicken wing and we liked those too. They were seasoned just right and had a good crispiness to them. 

The Greek salad was so good! There is lettuce in the Greek salad along with the other staples of Greek salad. The full size order comes with an order of garlic toast too!

We will definitely be ordering from here again. It's totally worth the drive to visit this hidden gem of St. Albert. Tell all your friends!
This patio has a great vibe. Food servings are really large and good pub food. Service isnt the greatest

I was recently treated to lunch here and it quickly became my favourite pizza spot!  I had a difficult time choosing which pizza to order because they all sounded fabulous, but settled on a Don Andreas, which had several of my favourite toppings, including cilantro, and came with extra hot sauce to kick it up another notch.

Leave room to try their gelato.  If you bring children and order a kids pizza, they get a scoop automatically - enough to make this adult a little jealous!   

It was crowded and quite noisy, which wasn't a problem for us since we had noisy kids with us, but keep that in mind if you're in the mood for a quiet, intimate setting - this ain't it!   Personally, the noise and laughter fit my mood just fine  :-)

I have been a fan of Famoso since it first opened it's original location on Jasper Ave. Living in St. Albert for the better part of the last decade the St. Albert location has become our "go-to". I have never had a disappointing meal or bad experience in the two dozen or so visits I have had to four of their different locations.

My personal favorite here is the Cavoletti pizza... don't let the odd looking toppings sway you from trying this gem. Brussel sprouts, gorgonzola, dates, honey... they all add up to deliciousness. They also typically have something interesting on tap for beer... I like that they change it up a bit.

Last night we had a Korean BBQ Beef pizza and a Primavera pizza. Both were awesome. 

Fresh toppings, wood fired thin crust pizza, and steady quality between locations. Famoso is a favorite old standby for us when we crave pizza!

Requested a service call, and got a sales call.  

One quick look and mentioned time to replace water tank, and maybe it is, but little investigation it seemed.  Same suggestion they had for the furnace several years ago (that turned out to be fine when checked by local gas company).

Everyone was pleasant enough, just seemed like pushing equipment was the default.

Incredible service! I had a laundry list of maintenance items for my vehicle and they handled them all within hours. Love the courtesy car, so it barely put a dent in my day. Fantastic rates too. Will be bringing my other vehicle here next.

After every sandwich spot within a 15 km radius was closed, we saw this taco joint. I had the chorizo tacos and a bulldog. The bulldog was delicious, although there was some brown dirt floating on it - not enough for me not to finish, but enough.
The chorizo taco was delicious. Lots of meat, plenty amount of guacamole. I had it on a corn tortilla, very soft and tasty. The guacamole was very fresh. Will definitely return.

Finally went there last weekend for the first time. I had a bulldog and the fish tacos. The tacos were absolutely fabulous! Their aioli sauce is delicious, the fish seasoning was full of flavour. However, the service was so-so; friendly enough. It was a bit pricey for the amount of food you get-- TWO tacos?! They are on the larger scale, but I definitely could've done three. Or just include a side with them, that would be a good compromise. 

It's hard to beat my already-favourite taco spots in YEG-- Rostizado and its original big brother, Tres Carnales-- but I'll definitely come back to try the rest of Cerdo's menu!

Amazing bourbon selection - check!
Live music - check!
Great ambiance and decor - check!
Friendly service - check!
Hawt servers - check!
Good food - check!
Draft beers - check!

Bourbon room has it all so when you go don't forget to pay the check!

They're having a big new year's celebration so buy advance tickets!

Excellent wings!! The sweet potato fries are delicious too, especially the addicting dip that comes with them lol Only $5.99 for a pound of wings on Wednesday's and they're the best wings I've had at a sports bar in a while. Cool atmosphere and good service. Very nice upper patio. 

Just do yourself a favour and don't order the pizza. After all it is a sports bar and they're not known for amazing pizza. They do load the toppings but I found it to be wayy to much on such a small personal pizza.

The best pizza in St. Albert. Very knowledgeable staff serve up a wide range of drink and amazing food. I always like to try different thing and can say the Marinated Olives are wicked good if you like olives of course. I've also had the prosciutto wrapped mozzarella balls which were mind blowing good I didn't want the bowl to ever be empty. The pizza is amazing and they have something for everyone. The Nutella Pizza is very rich in the best way possible I highly recommend this place to anyone and everyone  (I will update with pictures next visit)

I want to admit upfront that I'm picky about having anyone else do my nails.  I want the place to be spotless, I want the worker concentrating on me and not involved in fourteen other conversations with co-workers, I want pedicures to smooth my feet and leave my toes neatly polished, I want to feel hygiene practices are high .... and I want the prices to fit my budget.  I know, that's a whole lot to "want" and thus I'm often disappointed.

NOT TODAY!  This was my first visit and i didn't realize it was part of a chain until writing this review.  I see there's a wide variety of experiences people have had at other locations, but I want to emphasize I didn't have a single complaint and will definitely put this on my list of places to return.

First off, the prices are great.  $35 for a basic pedicure in a chair that actually functioned completely and comfortably.  My feet were in terrible winter shape and had been neglected recently, so I opted for the added scrub for another $10 and it was well worth it - after a detailed and effective scrub, a soothing cream was massaged in to improve circulation, from toe tips to knees.  Vanessa concentrated solely on me every moment, and constantly checked how things were feeling, explaining what each potion was doing, and adjusting pressure.  When she dropped a pumice, it immediately went into the trash and a new one was produced.  AND she changed the glove that had touched the floor (which was very clean, btw).  Water temperatures were checked (and I observed it for other customers as well) which I really appreciate, having been lobster-boiled at other businesses.  She checked the sandals I had worn and slipped disposable flip-flops on me for the drying time, advising that ten minutes in them first would insure no smears.

There's a special price for the pedicure/manicure combination and for children (who automatically get a nail design included, sure to delight them).  Waxing, eyelash extensions, tinting and paraffin treatments are also available.  Walk-ins were accommodated immediately, although I heard the hostess advising someone on the phone that evenings tended to be quite busy and there would be a wait time.

Looking forward to Vanessa keeping me sandal-ready and spiffy all summer!

I'm so thankful to have Cerdo close by. Even in the dead of winter, I feel like I can take a mini holiday and enjoy delicious food and lively, kitschy but authentic ambience. Thank you, Cerdo... never change!
Best pizza in St Albert. The 4 cheese pizza is the bomb if you like ALOT of cheese!!!

The pizza here is amazing !!! I hate Alberta pizza normal especially being from Toronto and Windsor Ontario you don't find good pizza anymore but this place is so worth the money and wait !!!! Highly recommend if you haven't tried them

Ordered the combo for pick up last night. 2 med pizzas with unlimited toppings, 10 chicken wings and 2 ltr of pop for $39. Great deal for average pizza. Sauce is too sweet for my liking. They should really try to clean up the front/pick up waiting area - not a very good impression.

If I could give this nail salon 0 stars I would. Absolutely the worst service and workers, so horrible I had to get up at the beginning of my appointment and leave because they continued to push towards acrylic nails when I repeatedly said I did not want them. At one point there were 5 nail techs crowded around the space trying to figure out what dip powder I already had on. Not sure how they are even open here anymore.

I've had pizza from there and they were ok for the price since it was a opening special awhile back. Tastes like frozen pizza from the grocery store. I went there today for a donair since Simply Donair is still not open. The donair was not good and quite pricey. A large is $13.10 with cheese. The meat had an unpleasant taste and the sweet sauce is not good. I can't wait for Simply Donair to open up in their new location.
Excellent brunch options and portion sizes for the cost.  Love the sports bar/restaurant atmosphere. We will return.

Not authentic mexican food.Tastes very bland and not exciting.What a disappointment.Not worth the money.There are way better mexican joints around than this place.The food is not bad but definetely not good

Sadly, my experience here was quite disappointing.  We arrived about 7:30 on a Saturday evening, and the place was packed, both inside and rooftop.   Long before our food arrived, however, it had emptied out.  Considering how long it took for our food, it made me wonder how long people had waited when the crowd was ordering.

Seating was a choice of tall backless stools or a low bench, neither contributing to comfort levels, and the tables for stools didn't allow much room for food, let alone a jacket or purse.  Water came promptly but was not chilled, and our glasses were hot out of the dishwasher, resulting in warm drinking water.  We had to ask for silverware (the table's bucket had only knives and one fork in it) and napkins.

We ordered the chips with two salsas and guac.  The bucket of chips was quite small, resulting in a lot of leftover salsa and guac, so when the waitress asked if we wanted more chips, we said yes.   She didn't ask if wanted to ORDER more, just if we WANTED more, so it was quite a surprise when the bill showed we were charged an additional $4 for the second small bucket (the original order was $9.50, so a total of $14 was crazy for relatively few chips).   To add insult to injury, the chips weren't even warm and most of them were broken crumbles, too small to easily dip in the salsa. This really seems unreasonable to me and ended the evening with a sense of irritation.  It may seem petty, but the combo of inferior chips plus sneaky charging  really bugged me!

Tacos are 2 for $11 - we tried sets of fish, chicken and ground beef.  Although they were certainly okay, they weren't especially impressive.  A bowl of beans and rice was $4 and was pronounced flavourless by a four year old aficionado who pushed them away after one bite.  The best item on the table was the corn on the cob (3 ears for $11), which everyone enjoyed.

Would I return?  Probably not.  The food is "okay" but pricey for what we got, both in quality and quantity.  Service was spotty and at least one of the servers walked around in a fugue of grumpiness which also didn't do much to make the evening more pleasant.

Went here for the first time. So far I've only cooked one of the meals I prepped, but it was tasty. I think some of the directions were missing for the rice pilaf (i.e. turn the heat down), because the water cooked out before the rice was done, so that was a bit disappointing, but we just added some more liquid, turned down the heat, and it turned out okay. Otherwise, the pork tenderloin was very delicious, and we're excited to try our other meals. 
I feel like it's reasonably priced meals, was so easy to do, and no clean up! It was also a fun activity for my husband and I to do together.

I called True North yesterday with an issue with my furnace.  Carmel answered the phone and was very helpful! She explained the service fee and gave a time when I could expect the technician. She did a follow up call to confirm  an earlier arrival time which was appreciated on a -25 day with no heat! The technicians - both  Coreys- were thorough, professional,  and explained the issue. Our furnace is now running great!
We'll definitely call True North again and highly recommend them!

Lee is AWESOME. Great prices, excellent waxing and she gets you in and out quick! Awesome service over all. Is great at fitting me in for last minute appointments. I am extremely picky with Brazilian waxes and Lee does an exceptional job.

After a short little yelp hiatus I figured I'd go out to a restaurant to celebrate going back to school and surviving the summer. My partner and I picked Critical Mass Brewing, located downtown in the heart of St Albert. When you arrive at the building you're greeted by open gates and an absolutely massive space! This place would be great for large parties as the area inside is enormous. They have patio, lounge, and dining room, so you can choose whatever your heart (or the rest of your party) fancies. 

We were seated quickly by our hostess who was also our server. There were about 3-4 other couples inside and a few on the patio. Music was playing but not too loud, and there are lots of windows. The decor is simple and plain, and there isn't really a "vibe" to this place. If anything it reminded me of a Moxie's on the inside and not a brewery but the food made up for it. 

There is a pretty decently sized drink menu with quite a few beers on tap. We shared the dry ribs and pretzel bites (the mustard dip was the bomb) and both got burgers. Hands down, best burger I've ever had. It was juicy, flavourful, and delicious and I would go back 100%. The fries are thin cut and as addicting as McDonalds. I'm seriously going to be thinking about this food for the rest of the week. 

Prices are decent, for two appetizers, two drinks, and two entrees it came to just $70. There's free parking up the road and it's a short walk from plenty of places in St. Albert. If you live in Edmonton it's definitely worth the trip out here and there's tons of cute businesses nearby to explore after dinner. Great service, outstanding food, and a weird atmosphere. Very accommodating. I'd go back, for sure!

Cerdos  by far is my favourite place to go ever for shrimp tacos.  They are always fresh and always very very tasty. Love the peach salsa and the crunchiness of these tacos. Service has always been very friendly and very prompt. I am new to the area and whenever I  get company I take them to cerdos

We are staying in St. Albert for a 2 Week Mandatory isolation and decided to order a donair loaf and all meat pizza from Amore.
The person taking the order was very helpful and the delivery guy was outstanding.  While my wife thought the Donai sauce was a little too sweet, I loved it.  The all meat pizza was possibly the BEST we have ever eaten. I asked for a little extra sauce and turned out perfect " no charge".
A definite yes and great place in St. Albert.

Came out with the whole fam jam (Gramma, Hubby, and both kiddos) tonight & so disappointed :-(

We were served like warm water, had to ask for silverware & napkins, and while our main server was friendly there were a couple not so cheerful ones walking around. The volume was super loud inside - think having to almost tell to hear each other.

Chips and salsa was $9.50 and came with just a handful of chips.  They asked if we wanted more - which we did - but didn't find out until we were paying that there was an additional $4 charge for more chips!  Also, both chip portions were 50% crumbles or pieces broken to about 1/4 chip size - pretty hard to eat with salsa.

My 4 year old ordered rice and beans for $4 and man were they bland.  He literally asked if they forgot to put in the flavor :-(

The Yucatan Pescado fish tacos (2 for $11) were the best thing we had but nothing to write home about.

My daughter enjoyed the Gringo Beef tacos (2 for $11) but the price still seems high.  They were super drippy as well.

Chicken al pastor tacos (2 for $10) were super bland and all 3 adults in our group elected to add hot sauce to these.

We also shared street corn - 3 ears for $11.  This was probably my favourite item here.

Service was slow and hit and miss depending on who was helping you.

Overall, I'd give the food 3 stars but the value was poor. 6 tacos, 1 bowl beans/rice, 3 corns, and chips/salsa - $70

I'd rather go to Tres Carnales or Calle Mexico any day - same prices but authentic and super flavorful.

Cerdos - I don't think we'll be back.
Best ribs I have ever eaten! Smoked for 48hrs. You can't even pick them up by the bone because the fall off! Manager Carmen is the most amazing, fun hostess! Go here!
Amazing tacos, very authentic Mexican food!! Great service too, I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking to eat in St Albert!

I would recommend the downtown location. Amazing pizza and most importantly very good customer service. Called this location (st. Albert) and was kept on hold for 5 minutes. When I went to order I was told that the website prices were incorrect and no deals exist on the weekend.  When I asked for more Information on one of the pizzas I was met with attitude from the women. I was already frustrated with this location as on one other occasion I ordered the donair pizza I usually get down town and was sorely disappointed with the lack of toppings. The crust showed though in multiple areas due to sparse application. I didn't want to drive far today so thought I would give them another try.... But I would rather drive all the way from St. Albert to down town to receive good service and better food. If you would like a great pizza and had a bad experience here try the downtown location if your I. The area! Amazing food.
First time eating here. The food was awesome and the service was just as equal. 10/10

Went into get my nails done today, left with big chunky nails. I went back a couple of hours later as I walked in to the salon the ladies where all at a desk eating. I apologize to the lady but asked if she can fix my nails. I even said I'd pay for her to fix them. She just  argued with me and told me that's how they were supposed to look. Then all three ladies gathered around arguing with me. So I just turned around and left. So I went across the parking lot to awesome nails and they fixed me right up! Ava was amazing

Good food and service. Lots of options for beer on tap. $4.99 steins everyday is a good deal, but I feel the menu prices are too steep for what it is. I still enjoyed the Canadian burger. Hubby enjoyed his beef dip also. Portions are decent.

There are two amazing donair shops in town, Simply and Amore.

What I love about Amore is that, well, just like their name, the food is made from LOVE. They make their donair meat from scratch! Not just one of those rotating hunks of beef under a heat lamp, they make a loaf from all fresh ingredient and bake it in an oven.

The service may be slow, but that's because LOVE is going into every meal they make, with quality, fresh ingredients that leads not just to a great tasting meal, but also leaves your stomach feeling the LOVE too.

The owners are the sweetest, and I've always had a great experience. I definitely recommend you check it out, and you can always call ahead with your order and then go pick it up so you aren't waiting (because it's definitely a take out place. LOVE it!

Omgosh yum! Donair with homemade fries! They use a special potato and vinegar in their oil. Whatever they do - amazeballs!  No proper full seating but a little bar table and stools so more of a take out. Truly glad to find this on Yelp :)
Lee is the best at waxing! She is always accommodating and her new space is wonderful!

Ordered some food for take out, initially there was an error with it not being gluten free but when i had called, they were very quick to fix the error. A staff member personally delivered a new order as well as credited the previous order. I have never experienced such good customer service. Will definitely be coming back!

Would have preferred to read a sign before entering the restaurant that there were supplier issues and not everything listed on the menu was available before having an order being taken.

Under normal circumstances TCB has been a decent option to go to for gluten-free menu options, however on this visit after the first order had to be changed because they did not have gluten-free tartar sauce for the fish and chips, a new order was placed for a gluten-free pizza.  After another delay, the manager came to tell me the  bad news that there was no gluten-free pizza crusts available.  This was at the 42 minute mark since the original order had been placed.  It's unfortunate that it took so long to find out that 2 gluten-free options were not available and that their online menu was not updated to reflect what options were available.  As we had already been delayed, we had to leave without any lunch.  The manager did apologize and attempted to try to get me to order something else but let's face it, I had severe doubts that any other gluten-free options were going to be available after already having 2 options be unavailable.  

I appreciate that they understood the importance of having a gluten-free option available but if they are having supplier issues, there is no excuse not to have a sign up indicating so for customers or updating the online menu to reflect item not available.  The manager attempted to make it better but really after 2 failed attempts I was beyond disappointed, past the point of hunger and left in tears.  Silly I know but when you have no choice but have to deal with gluten-free every day of your life, it can be difficult at times to find a restaurant with options that you are confident in that will not be contaminated or cause you stomach pain. 

Fellow celiac peeps beware.  You may have better luck than I  but sadly, I won't be back.

I've been using this business since 1999 having multiple prescriptions filled each month.  20 years of visits with a minimum of one visit a month means I've interacted with their staff on at least 240 visits - plus maybe an additional 30 visits for various extra prescriptions.  The friendly and knowledgeable folks there have always treated me with respect and promptness.  I moved away from St Albert 16 years ago but refuse to transfer my prescriptions elsewhere because I trust and am confident in the great service delivered at this pharmacy.
Me and my step mom went in for pedi/mani for my birthday and it was nothing but exceptional service! Thry were very friendly and awesome at the job! Ill be going back

had the Chinese food special on Thursday night for 6.99 each ,what they do not tell you is the the small cardboard containers are 3/4 filled with rice with just a sprinkling of meat and veg on top for color .a one star rating is to much .from feb 21 ,the waitress didn't even ask how the food was.  had to order more food ,dry ribs were a joke .still tipped 15% ,waitress pleasantly dropped this crap on my table .warning all my friends and family that this location has for some reason gone far far downhill and does not deserve your money

We've been to the Brewhouse 4 times since it opened in our neighbourhood and have never been disappointed with the food. But each time it has been busier than the last and there's quite a wait for both the food and the check. That won't stop us from going back but it will influence when and how often.

Wow, where to start. Stopped in Saturday around 4pm. As soon as we walked through the door we were greeted with an "HOLA". The place is cute with a rooftop lounge. Reminds me of a small place we went to in Mexico. The food was amazing. We had the nachos and the Chicken El Pastor tacos. The nachos could have used a little more cheese but the tacos were perfect. If you're looking for a quick bit or a few drinks, give this place a shot.

I gotta say I loved this place, it's family owned and everyone there is super friendly. I loved the atmosphere and the great talks. 

This Salon is located in easy to find area and lots of parking area. 

Connie was my stylist. She was very knowledgeable and has her own techniques that set her aside from other stylists I have had. She is really friendly and when you are finished not only are you truly satisfied but you want to come back again. 

My hair looks amazing I got a color/ highlights. Thanks to groupon or I wouldn't of found this place. 

I look forward in trying other services and getting my hair done again here:)

It was time for the annual football draft with me and bunch of my friends.  I booked the reservation online and noted it was for our draft.  It was booked for a Tuesday at 6:30pm.  Three of us arrived at about 6:15pm.  The hostess asked if we had a reservation  and I said we did.  There wasn't a table put aside but it didn't really matter since it was almost empty in the restaurant. We sat down and began to wait for the rest of our party to come.  After a few minutes, a server came over to tell us about the drink specials.  We ordered a couple of drinks and said we were waiting for a few others.  The server came back as the rest of my party was coming and dropped off the three drinks.  At the same time, I ordered my food.  The server heard my order, then turned around and left.  This left one of my friends sitting there wondering why she didn't take his order.  Over the next 15 or so minutes, the rest of the group arrived.  We sat and waited.  And waited.  And waited.  A manager came over and dropped my fries. I asked for some ketchup and was told it would be a few minutes.  The manager said that the server was really busy but would be by in a couple of minutes.  The manager then came back with the ketchup but still didn't take anyone else's order.  We waited another 10 minutes before I got frustrated and walked up to our server to say we had 8 people who wanted to order.  She looked up at me and told me to wait a few minutes.  I mean, WTF?  Anyways, the server eventually came over to the table to take some orders.  However, by this point (around 7:00pm) most of the group had decided not to order anything.  Why support a company that doesn't want to provide a basic level of service.  Only guy ordered some chicken fingers and a few beers were ordered.  All the while, the restaurant had cleared out.  There may have been four of five tables of patrons and it looked like our server was helping all of the tables.  However, she spent most of her time chatting with a group at a 4-top table.  I think she must have been friends with them since she just stood there talking to them for most of their time there.  The chicken fingers were dropped off but were not hot (lukewarm, at best).  The server then only came by every 20 minutes or so but didn't really ask if we needed refills or more drinks.  The table was frustrated and so we had decided to finish up and leave.  We waited and waited for our tabs.  I finally had to go up to the bar to ask the server to bring our bills.  She was not pleasant at all when presenting the bills and didn't even thank one person.  She presented the visa terminal to one person and when he was done she just said "gimme the machine, i can't reach that far".  Why not come around the table a bit?  We all stood up and just looked at one another as if to ask what had just happened.  As we walked out, we all noted that we would never be going to this location again.  Absolutely terrible.  

When I got home, I went to the website and clicked on the FEEDBACK link.  The link takes you to a third party site offering a free appetizer if you provide some feedback.  I entered the feedback and then never heard anything back.  I did however, get the free appetizer.  Thankfully, it can be used at any location.  I've had an issue with any other Brewhouse so I'd go back to another location, just not the St Albert location.

Oh, and online (Twitter and Facebook) the Brewhouse social media pages said that if you booked your draft at their locations there would be special offers and discounts for those who attended. Not surprisingly, the server didn't mention anything at all about the offers.  

Part of me blames management for being short staffed and leaving the server on her own. But the server could have explained the situation and asked for some patience.  However, she did nothing at all to help us understand her situation thus losing any sympathy we might have had.  The tips reflected this.
Just left the beer Factory and I'm having a bourbon with friends at the Bourbon Room. Wow what a cool place this is. Very comfortable and looks like it will be a great night.

Skip it. I tried this place twice cuz I'm always in the mall. The girls talk to each other in their own native language or talk on their cell phones the whole time. Both times too rough and try to upsell you the whole time. Terrible terrible terrible.

I hadn't been to the Bourbon Room for awhile and was very impressed with what they have done with the place. The place was been a number of different names and owners over the years, but has been the Bourbon Room for about 5yrs. The interior is done in a warm barn wood look and tastefully decorated to create a cozy comfortable feel. I was there for a Saturday afternoon jam session and found the place to be quite busy. They has numerous live acts come through and their dueling piano nights are quite popular.  kitchen was quite busy and while I didn't order any food there were plenty of tempting items coming from the kitchen. You can rent the establishment for private functions and with the new patio it offers customers a chance to enjoy the nice weather as we get it. Definitely worth checking out for an evening out or even just a relaxing afternoon beverage

In all candor, this place was a complete disappointment. I have found a growing trend in St. Albert- people jump on anything that is new and proclaim it great. And I am slowly learning that they are usually wrong in their bandwagon mindsets. 
First of all, the menu leaves a lot to be desired. If the prices don't appal you, the lack of imagination in the food will. Usually I am fond of concise menus, quality not quantity; however, Cerdo doesn't have a good selection of quality options. Furthermore, the drinks menu is equally disappointing. 
We ordered coconut, lime and strawberry house margaritas. Although not terrible, adding tequila, to strawberry syrup, and putting a slush on top, and failing to mix it is subpar. 
For food we ordered the carnitas, and Yucatan pescado tacos. Holy smokes no thank you!! To start with, the fish was awful. It had no flavour and it was mushy, and the pork wasn't great either. It was served in big chunks, although tender, it also lacked flavour.  Both were served on top of a bunch of cabbage and onions. And I have no idea what the sauce was, but it didn't add anything redeeming to the tacos. When we are paying basically $5 a taco, I would expect a lot more than that. 
All together our bill, which included, 3 drinks and 2 taco orders, came to $40. Which I found to be extremely overpriced for the quality of food we were served. 
There are far better taco places than Cerdo, so save your money and don't jump on this bandwagon.
The best pizzas and donairs! The food is fresh and fantastic and the prices are reasonable.  Delivery is quick and friendly. Definitely have the super cheese donair you will not be disappointed. A+

I am a celiac so I am always looking for new places to eat. Cerdo did not disappoint. In fact, I was honestly expected a good but average meal however my meal was FANTASTIC. I had the Gluten Free carnitas tacos (with corn soft tacos) and it was hands down the best I've had (and I have been to multiple other well known Mexican restaurants in and around Edmonton). The meat was so tender and the flavours were amazing. I did request their grilled, chopped pineapple on top which might have put it over the top delicious but I'm sure without it, it still would have been great. 
Waitress did say all the tacos are GF with the corn tortilla. 
My husband had the Gringo Beef and said it was really good as well!
Service was great and food came out prompt but we were also there on a Friday during the Christmas break, -30 outside and in-between meal rushes (2:30pm) SOOO it was a little set up in our favour to be quiet inside which meant food came fast! 
Highly recommend checking it out.

True North Heating and Cooling has been a gem to work with. Initially what started the summer before, with a call about a noisy neighbour's a/c and what could be done to help dampen the sound, continued that positive experience into a great one to follow. 
Who wants to be without heat in the winters that we seem to have here, but kerplunk it did, the 'ol 21 year old Frigidaire furnace cracked its heat exchanger. With -30°C weather in the forecast, this was not ideal timing, but when is it ever? 

Anyway, Chris showed up as soon as he was able to look at what we needed to do for getting heat in the house again. The calculation was a little different than I expected, now they just look at the number and size of windows in the house rather than the size of the house. We also looked together at other issues that we were having like not enough heat pumping into the upstairs and downstairs and how the airflow could be improved. 
They gave us some time to think about our options and what we were going to do for the install... but they also didn't make us wait on their end. The pencilled in an install date for us so that we wouldn't have to wait. That was so appreciative. They dropped off some smaller space heaters and some larger ones that plugged into the 220V outlets. The rental ended up being free with the install. (But do watch your usage as they're going to chew into your electricity bill... if you have a gas fireplace, best to use that.) 

So install date came. We chose the Lennox Merit ML296, it is a two-stage rather than a variable stage, but still better than what we had. The furnace could not be vented out of the chimney anymore with the hot water tank, as per the new regulations, and now is vented out the side of the house. So be sure you keep that in mind as there's going to have to be some new pipes and drilling involved. They helped pick the best path for the new intakes and exhaust. One thing that was good was there was no more need for the combustion air intake of the house, so that huge source of cold air into our utility room was going away! They cut and blocked it off. 

Demolition happened in the morning. The two installers arrived on time. Note for anyone, if you can give them your garage as a staging area that will make things way easier for them. When they pulled out the old furnace it was very clear that the heat exchanger had a nice big hole with another one or two more on the way. Ugh. (See picture.) The new Lennox is a bit smaller than the old one, but they were still able to use the existing ducting by installing an extension. They repositioned the furnace and new filter system (we went for the Merv16 filtration system to take care of dust allergies) to point in a more accessible manor than the old one. In addition to the installation of the furnace I was surprised that they also went and improved the drainage system of my humidifier and the furnace with proper PVC piping rather than the hokey flexible tube it replaced. Way more professional! They carefully went onto the roof and dropped down a new inset in the chimney to allow the water heater to still vent properly and soon after, that afternoon, the new thermostat was installed. All of this was done with proper social distancing and precautions, yet at the same time were available for any of my constant questions or inquiries during the install.

Part of the installation included a new thermostat to properly drive the new furnace. We requested an upgrade to the Honeywell T6 Pro Smart Thermostat WIFI (TH6220WF2006/U) and we couldn't be happier! We can now turn up and down the heat when we are away from the house or still in bed with the app or with Siri. With Apple HomeKit, we can set scenes to control it and our other devices. We like the touch display screen a lot better than the normal T6 Pro. It can even send you an alert if your house is too cold or hot. I recommend it.

The next day involved opening up the return air on our main floor to allow for better circulation and the addition of a proper one into the basement. New ducting was put in and installed in a location that wouldn't impede the positioning of furniture. The downstairs is still cool, but it isn't freezing like it was before. One thing about the install I did have concerns about was the exhaust outlet, it was positioned at the level of our backyard access path on the side of the house and my boys bumping into it. It also was near where the window opened. I sent them some pictures about it a few weeks later and they happily agreed to put an extension on the pipe to raise it above both issue sources and insulated it from freezing. No charge for the adjustment! 

In all this was something that I didn't want to have to do... the roof was the one planned. But obviously it was something that we had to do and it was obvious we had to do it with True North Heating and Cooling. I wouldn't have done it any other way! Thank you Chris, Carmal and the rest of your wonderful gang!
We really enjoyed the pizza. It was delicious.  The service was good.  However,  we felt it was a little too pricey.

It's a nice place, just not my kind of place. There is a big screen TV every 6 inches blaring in your face. So if you want to watch TV while paying top prices for food and drinks, go here. If you'd rather save yourself a $100, do it at home. Plus our server took payment for the whole bill from two guests, meaning she ended up with like a $140 tip. Ridiculous. Also don't appreciate how management treats their staff. Tried it twice, won't be back.

Famoso is great! It's my favorite restaurant in St Albert. I try to come here often, at least once a month :)

The staff are very friendly and the food is great. I always have a gelato iced coffee and the Caveletti pizza with truffle oil on it. Extra toppings can add up but the prices are mostly understandable.

The seasonal menu changes often and that's pretty great to see. My favorites have been the proscuitto wrapped foir de latte appetizer and the white chocolate and raspberry panna cotta dessert. I also had their tomato soup the last time I went (for my birthday two weeks ago) and it was very good.

For those of you that aren't familiar with Famoso; you fill out the order yourself. Yes, the pizza is very thin because you are supposed to fold it in half to eat it (I like it that way). It can be a little expensive but I think it's worth it. The atmosphere is nice; always very clean, slightly dim lighting. Eating on the patio is great when the weather is ready for it.

Knowledgeable staff. Professional. Caring and polite. I can't say enough good things about this company (and I'm usually a rather cynical person). We had our furnace replaced by them about a year ago. They provided great information about their products, called lots (confirm times, updates on early or delayed arrivals, ...).  They identified all the costs up front and there were no additional expenses despite a rather uniquely built home.

Months after the installation, we noticed a small problem with the exterior venting (we had the venting brought up to code when the furnace was done; True North looked after everything with a subcontractor). True North took full responsibility, and had it fixed quickly. No hassles even though they no longer used this subcontractor. I love this company!
 
Might not be the very lowest priced guys but sure to be very competitively priced. Provide great support after they've finished the job and peace of mind knowing that we've got a responsible company for the future.

The atmosphere is nice. Tried just about everything on the menu.  Mushroom Caps- nasty do not order.  Wings were ok. Coconut shrimp can out burnt got a new order but not very good.  Pizza was ok, but not worth $16 for 2 topping. Best thing was the Nachos.  About my 3rd 4th time here. Only seems to ever be one waitress.  Fine place for drinks and nachos. But won't order any other food here

The food here is AWESOME.

I wish I had known about this place for all of those years I was dating somebody that was in St. Albert, he lived right nearby and we could have walked here frequently. Because had we known how awesome it was I just know we would have been here often.

Decor is sparse and it is fairly small inside but the owner is doing renos soon. I'll be sure to revise my review once I check the post-renoed place out!

The menu is fairly small but they serve all day breakfast and lunch so there is still a fair amount to choose from. Both times I've been in I've had different sandwiches with the beet and parsnip salad--the salad is KILLER. You will regret it if you don't try it. Beet salad is usually awesome anyway but once you add in roasted parsnips it becomes a whole other level of amazing.

They also have flavoured moonshines on tap along with a whole host of house made beers... I don't even like beer and I found one that I would have more than a mouthful of. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly and everything is reasonably priced. They even have moonshine slurpees!

Tucked away in the industrial Riel park just north of the Enjoy centre you'd never know that this place was here. Please go check it out, I promise you won't be disappointed.

I am a big fan of this company. No I did not use them in the end as I found something a little different but they were definitely my runner up. Carmel was very informative and very helpful in the stressful time of having to replace our furnace.  I can't thank them for their time, education, and professionalism.
This salon is very clean, service are very good and great hair stylist! Not so pricey! I walk out of it very happy and satisfied with my beautiful hair!!!

I told her I had ingrown toenail surgery - she still proceeded to clip where there was no nail until I flinched in pain and saw red on my nail bed. I didn't notice any of their instruments were in any sanitizing solution. She changed the colour of my polish without consulting me. Not happy. Later - all night & the next day, I felt pain in my toes as if my body were fighting off an infection.

I called around and they were the cheapest to do an insurance inspection on out of the five I called. Shuttle service is really convenient. It looks clean inside the customer area as did the shop.

Now the thing I'm upset about. I was told they wouldn't sign off on my insurance inspection without replacing the rear swaybar bushings which were "worn out." Well, I said I'd do them myself and take it back to them to have a look and sign off on the inspection. When I said that on the phone i could hear the guy on the line deflate with disappointment and reluctantly, he agreed. Upon checking the car myself, I found no play in the bushings when applying force to them and I even went as far as driving over ungulating roads surfaces and confimed that there was no knocking or clunking from the rear suspension. Once I removed the bushings I noticed, the rubber had no cracks, it wasn't brittle and, it was the same shape and size as the replacements. I had to change perfectly good bushings for these people to sign off on my car. Sounds like they were hoping I wasn't savy enough to do them myself so they could charge me the hour they quoted me and do them in less than the 30 minutes it took me to do them on the driveway. Bushings are gravy on a car like this and take no time to do on a hoist, how many others have been quoted huge amounts of money for jobs that don't require the amount of time quoted or are not necessary. I feel like they held me hostage... Not happy with that.

I love the guys here, they're such a good, clean (at heart) and accommodating bunch. I know most of them by name, and sometimes they know my name even if I have never asked or forgotten theirs, shame on me, considering I always ask and am not one to forget even the name of the one who delivered pizza to me last year.

They are knowledgable, helpful and make time for me. If they can do it, they likely will. The best pharmacists and technicians, I know when push comes to shove I can count on them. I can't say enough good things about them.

Oh, they don't know how to use the phone. They never call to inform when a prescription is ready for pickup. It will just lie there forever. And they don't auto-refill either, you have to chase them. A pity, but then nothing and no one is perfect.

Really cool atmosphere and very unique space. Only had a chance to try the appies and some wine but everything we had was delicious. We were there on a Thursday so they didn't have entertainment, but they have a stage where they apparently have bands and comedians regularly. The staff were so down to earth and friendly. It felt more like they were hanging with us than working which is hard to find and made our experience that much better.

Excellent Customer Service! I had used their online apt calendar to book an apt on Friday April 19th (some businesses are still open and figured I would try). It was accepted but unfortunately when I arrived it was closed. Richard was so apologetic and nice, he offered to have my car picked up and dropped off while I was at work so I didn't need to make the drive again. I have always been impressed with their service and I trust their recommendations, they are knowledgeable and reasonable. I absolutely highly recommend them to everyone as I will be a life time customer. Thank you Richard and Chase for your outstanding service.

We popped in because it was sunny for only a short time and the patio looked so inviting.  We were a party of 4 and we were seated right away (seat yourself).  The patio is huge with a lot of places to sit and it's pretty comfortable.  There's shade if that's what you want or sun.  Also all tables had umbrellas unless you were on the couch areas. 

We had ordered a bunch of appetizers we got lasagna bites (delicious btw) and they are pretty filling and big. We also ordered dill pickle boneless wings (yum), sizzling shrimp, jalapeño popper things wrapped in bacon, deep fried pickles and Doritos wings.  My other friend loves their burgers and got the Canadian Burger which she loved!

All of our food came out at the same time and hot! That's what you expect and want.  The lasagna bites were great.  I am so surprised how big they are. These  are a great appie to share and take the leftovers (which heat up great). 

Deep fried pickles were a hit, they were piping hot and crunchy.  

Dorito wings, although I didn't try one everyone agreed they were good. It's a unique item and worth the try....if you like trying fun items like that. 

Sizzling shrimp, sadly they were very very burnt.  Our lovely sever came by and I explained that to her and she could visibly see the blackened shrimp.  Swiftly she took them away, I didn't want another one made because we had so much other food to eat. The manager came over promptly and apologized said they would pay for me beer.  Which I thought was really nice and was hospitable.  

Fast forward to when we got our bills, I thought they would only take off my beer but they also took off the shrimp.  That was a nice surprise. 

If you want AMAZING customer service whether you had to return a dish or not come to this location.  That in itself deserves 5/5 stars.

Great food every time!  The place is clean and organized. Food choices are always tasty and we like that they use organic when possible. 

We really love the butternut stuffed shells, pumpkin bisque and so many tasty meat choices to count. 

Great way to have quick meals without eating out costs.

My wife and I went there last week and had the worst experience.  First downside, you've got to pay in full up front when you book online.  We had never been before and didn't really know how it worked.  When we entered the store there were about 4 people chatting in the corner and a young man (around 17 or so) buzzing around.  We stood by the door for a minute before the young man came to greet us.  We said we had a session booked at noon, he looked us up and handed us a sheet that had the recipes we had picked out and said "here you go".  We asked him what do we do and he replied something to the effect of "well, you go to the station for the recipe you're making, you do it, then move on to the next one."  No orientation, no explaining of where to hang our coats, or to wash our hands first, or to put an apron on.  We kind of walked around dazed for a while and a man who I believe was this young man's father came over us and asked if we he had explained everything to us.  I said, no offense to the young man, but he hasn't really explained anything to us and we have no idea what to do. We then got a bit more of a runthough of how things work and what we should be doing.  

Unfortunately even after that, things were pretty poorly organized.  items were missing on stations, directions were vague (get the small container, ok... which one is the "small" one), in one case we were looking for something that a recipe referenced and the guy said "oh, yeah, don't worry about that, it's a mistake, you don't need that."  The recipes also mentioned things to grab at the end to go with them and we didn't receive all of them.  when we got home and tried to actually MAKE the recipes, the instructions are vague, missing points, reference parts that you didn't get.  We cooked the ribs according to the directions, and they needed DOUBLE the time printed on them to cook properly.


VERY POOR experience and we will NOT be back.

My daughters and I have been coming to see Jacklyn and Carly for about four or five years now. All three of us have tons of hair and have had a variety of haircuts, colors, highlights, updos, etc.  These two hairdressers are absolutely wonderful. They have great customer service and really care about their customers happiness. Neither myself or either of my daughters have ever left the salon unhappy.  I have referred many friends and coworkers here and all continue to get their hair done here and are very happy. This place is definitely a five star and I would highly recommend it to anyone!

Excellent place to unwind after work, sports on the tv, music not to loud able to talk across the table. 
Servers professional in there attention to the guests needs. Fast response to refilling pop or water. Tuesdays have tacos for $2.99 ea or Thursday is Chinese food $6.99 per food item choose between 5 choices.

I like this restaurant. It is affordable, tasty, and the drinks are fun! 

One of the most authentic taqueria style restaurants in the Metro area. Menu is kind of short, but the environment is exciting. 

They have an excellent patio to hang out on a share some drinks with friends on a nice summer day.

Located with the Grandin Medical Centre, this is as handy as you could ask for.  Quick, efficient, very friendly, and your prescription comes in an easy-open green container and a little candy - what a nice touch!

I keep coming back here and each time I'm impressed with the customer service received. 

I'm never made to feel stupid for not speaking car, lol.  I come here regularly now for tire change overs and oil changes.  I've also brought in one of our vehicles for a second opinion when the dealership recommended a few too many services. 

Recently I had a few additional repairs/services here and a check over for something else that may still be under warranty with Hyundai but Gate was still happy to help and give me a quote in case it's not covered for no charge. 

They also offer a shuttle service around the clock in case you need a ride to work or back home. 

Two thumbs way up and I'll keep coming back and recommending you to everyone I know!

The food is really terrible.  Consistently!  I love the patio so much though so I have kept going back.  3 for 3 bad food experiences have finally turned me away. 
The first bad food experience was about a month ago and I had the shepherds pie.  The meal was so salty I couldn't even eat it without it burning my lips.  I didn't eat it and the waitress removed it from my bill since I had barely touched it.  The second bad experience was last Thursday night.  My friend and I went for shrimp for $6.99 so we each ordered two orders of naked shrimp with wing flavors.  The waitress brought us tempura battered shrimp.  When we told her we asked for naked shrimp she huffed and puffed like we'd  messed up.  She corrected the mistake thankfully.  When I asked for a cup of tea she  made a big production about having to go "all the way downstairs" to get it (?). Finally the third and final straw was Friday night when my husband and I went for prime rib.  We couldn't get a table on the rooftop so we're seated inside.  I ordered a dark rum and Diet Coke and some pale looking beverage the color of iced tea arrived.  Bitter and not rum.  Strike one.  They replaced it so corrected the error.  Too much lime juice? The waitress said.  Don't think so but okay...We then ordered onion rings as an appetizer and they arrived burned.  Strike two.  We both had the prime rib.  I had no potato just vegetables.  The beans and red peppers were RAW!  The beans were hard as rock.  The sauce on the prime rib was so hot it was inedible.  I scraped it off the best I could so I could eat my meat but I didn't eat the veggies.  The waitress noticed we didn't eat the onion rings and wondered if we wanted to take them home.  When we said no she offered to speak to the manager about removing them from our bill.  My husband ordered the donut poutine to go.  While we were waiting for the dessert the manager came over and offered to remove the onion rings from our bill.  We had paid our bill already and my husband had left a $12 tip and the waitress did not bring him the refund.  I can only assume she gave herself an even better tip!  $22.00 at least for bad food.  Not bad.  Strike 3 and done.  So sad because I really love their patio but I will spend my money somewhere where  the food is better and the patio isn't as nice but adequate.  I am kinda sad.  Not going to lie

I've never had someone rush so bad....ever. Barely even scrubbed my feet. Was 15 seconds because I timed it. missed entire steps And then when she noticed I was upset she started trying to start conversation. Annoying....
Worst pedicure ever. Please save your money and go elsewhere. I regret the moment she started the pedicure. I should have just got up and left but the other ladies were half way done my daughters feet.

Nachos al Pastor were shared by two of us and were an excellent choice for dinner.  Chips were perfectly cooked, cheese was abundant, Chicken al Pastor was well seasoned and juicy.  Loved the rooftop patio, no bugs and quieter than main restaurant.  Will be back!

First visit was definitely disappointing.  I've only tried the donair so far, so I will update the review if I feel it's warranted once I try more items.

I walked in shortly after lunch on boxing day.  There was only one employee there and no other customers waiting.  One very important thing to know is that this is TAKE OUT only.  No chairs or tables at all.  So keep that in mind.

There are TVs on the wall that display the menu, but only the pizza one was turned on, so I had to ask if they had donairs as well (yes, I know it's in the name of the place, but without seeing them on the menu, I wasn't sure).  They do.  So I ordered a cheese donair with no onions.  Apparently they come in medium and large, so I ordered a medium.  He asked if I wanted lettuce and tomato, and I said yes.  He also asked if I wanted sweet sauce.  I'm not sure what the other options are, but that's what I wanted, so I said yes.

He disappeared into the back for quite a while.  I was confused, but I think he was working on a pizza delivery order.  Then he came back to the front and shaved the donair meat off and started building my donair.  I didn't pay too close attention, but if I had, I would have noticed the following:

- He put a tonne of raw onions in there and no tomato.  Some people love raw onions, some people can't stand them.  I'm the kind that can't stand them.
- Unlike other places that heat up the donair meat before building it, they do not.  So it was only luke warm.  Which left a really weird film in my mouth.

I won't be back for donairs, but might try their pizza some time.  The whole process was very long, considering that it wasn't even hot by the time I got it.

I have been coming to Deor for about 8 years. They used to be located in the strip mall over by the Earls and have since moved to their newest location which is conveniently located in the McKenney Ave strip mall near the Safeway. 

The studio is well lit and the decor is modern. I always get my hair cut by Sam. He does a great job on the hair cuts. He remembers my style between cuttings so I don't have to explain it every time. The haircuts aren't too expensive (less than $20) not including tip. 

He used to take walk ins exclusively but he now takes appointments which is good. There have been some long waits to get haircuts from him in the past. Not because there weren't other people available to cut hair but because everyone waits for Sam to cut their hair. 

I take both my boys (6 years & 18 months) to get their hair cut here. Carly cuts their hair and is great with them. She's patient, kind and does a good hair cut with a fidgeting kid. 

Sam owns Deor and is great to deal with! I have ordered beauty products from him for my wife with great success. I would definitely recommend this business if you looking to get your hair cut in St. Albert.

Treated my daughter to a visit here today, promising her it was definitely one of the best salons I've been to.  Again, not a single complaint.  We both had a pedicure/manicure combo with gel polish, carefully attended to the entire time.  Linda was attentive and offered good advice on how to tell future workers exactly what I preferred.  I seldom allow anyone to do my fingernails because I detest messiness, but she did a lovely job.  I'll be back!

Very busy for a cold Wednesday night, but to be expected for the 'new place' in town. Great decor and I love that there are so many TVs for watching the game. We will make use of the roof top patio in the summer! We loved the shuffle board table and the giant pac-man game, we will have to come back to have a couple games. Our server was definitely new, but did her best. It was wings night so the majority of our group ordered wings. The wings could be better, but were not terrible. The John candy burger was excellent I was told, and a huge serving. Someone in our group also had a wrap and the server was accommodating in adding chicken. Overall, a good experience, we will be back for the atmosphere and beer.

You can't go wrong with Tomato Bisque soup or the Prosciutto Arugula Pizza any day of the week.

I've tried many others, but always come back to these two staples.

There's something interestingly different about their 00 refined flour from Italy and how it doesn't leave your feeling heavy the way typical pizza does.

If you have room, you simply must try their gelato and sorbetto.

This location has a comfy patio open during the summer with both tables and outdoor couches.

Mmm.... PIzza.
