I found it a bit pricy for lunch - there are no specials or different menu - and for the price, I'd at least like decent napkins instead of a '50's burger-joint metal dispenser of thin, scratchy ones on each table. (And ironically, the "burger joint" next door has far better ones available).   I'd also like the waitress to come by occasionally and offer  water or check on whether things were going well.   There was literally no service provided, even though the restaurant was virtually empty.

Those 2 stars describe my food exactly - "meh - I've had better" - it wasn't so bad you'd send it back, but it also was not enticing or a delicious experience.  I felt like I was just getting through the meal, rather than enjoying it.  Nothing we tried created  that "oh wow, this is really good" reaction.

Sadly, I doubt if I will return, even though I was truly excited to have a source of Thai/Vietnamese food so close to home.    If the food had been great, I could overlook the total lack of service, but there was simply nothing to justify another visit.  Sigh ...
Absolutely amazing. Easy to order from the app. Everything was hot and ready upon pick up and just as amazing as if I'd have eaten in house. Awesome doesn't even describe the amazing experience

Great service and food, had fish and chips came out great had Bud light 20 oz came out cold eh! Had deep fried cheese cake was awesome. I would recommend this place for groups and individuals. Enjoy, smaller then some bars in St. Albert

Took my boots in to get the heels fixed. The guy was rude. When I went to pick up my boots, my back was facing me and he was on the machine. I said "excuse me" as I didn't know if he saw and he didn't turn around. Then he turned around and said rudely "couldn't you just wait a few mins?" Whao WTH? I just grabbed my boots and left. Wore my boots to a business meeting at someone's office 2 days later. When I walked out, the other person picked up a heel tip and said to me "this came off from your boots" Arrrggghhh it was so embarrassing, the whole tip came off my heels. I didn't bother taking my boots back to the same place. I took them somewhere else downtown and got them fixed instead. I'll never go back to this place again.

The reason I'm a fan of this Save On Foods is because they have some really caring staff.

Bill, is deaf, and has worked stocking the shelves for years... I always see him in the evenings and he's super nice! Plus it's nice for me to use my rusty sign language skills and it always seems to surprise him and make him smile.

The produce is always excellent at this location and the produce staff are quite helpful.  

The only department that I've had a bad experience with was the bakery when they spelled my daughter's name wrong on her Birthday cake and then made a mess of it where they had scraped it off before I arrived and redid it - you couldn't even read her name! When I complained they offered me a 15% discount. I paid for the cake and then spoke with the manager about the bakery department that didn't acknowledge their mistake or even apologize and told her I felt insulted being offered 15% off for my specialty order and you still couldn't read her name. The manager apologized and offered me a gift card as I had already paid for the cake.

I was glad she rectified the situation but I do not plan on ordering a personalized specialty cake from this location again.

That being said, I am still consistently impressed with the helpful and attentive staff from checkers to produce, to my favorite - Bill!  If I was rating this location on Bakery alone - I'd give them 2 stars - but overall they definitely get two thumbs up (aka 4 stars).

What a treasure trove this shop is, located in a strip mall several blocks away from the main street thru St. Albert - it is most definitely worth the time to track it down.  There are gifts of every description, from home decor to kitchenwares to jewelry, purses, great slippers, and of course seasonal decor.  It's simply crammed full of goodness and goodies!  Even the young'uns are entranced by the displays and actually ASK to come visit after their lessons at Danceco (located in the same area).  I love this shop and refuse to admit how much time I've spent drooling over items I couldn't resist.  Please check it out!
Got the rib and wing combo. Veggies and fires. Everything was great. Love the dill dip. Will have it again for sure

I truly like going to this store for so many reasons, but most of them all relate back to the staff.  The customer service is simply outstanding.  I've seen the assistant manager rush to help an older lady get her groceries out to her car, cashiers fill the cart for someone with a disability without an instant's hesitation, stockers notice when a customer seems unable to find something long before they'd be asking for help, bakery people stop their work to offer a cookie to a toddler after checking with Momma first, produce workers describe differences in veggies and offer to special order a request, deli and meat clerks provide meal suggestions - it just doesn't stop.   

During the warmer weather, the front area is fairly "open air" and the displays become imaginative.  I stopped once to talk to an employee who had created a HUGE display with carbonated drink cartons creating the Maple Leaf design, and it was obvious she loved her job and the freedom/trust she was given to make the front a welcoming place.   When employees feel good about where they work, it explains why customers will feel good shopping there.

Big thumbs up from me  :-)

Love Love Love this place. They always great you by name when you come in the door and it is always very clean and friendly. The shop itself isn't anything fancy but it's well kept and the employees make it worth it. They have great colour selections and I'm always happy when I leave the door!

If Japanese food is what you are looking for, look no further than this quaint little St. Albert gem.

Family run, family friendly, fresh, and it won't break the bank.  What more could you ask for?

Do yourself a favour and skip Tokyo Express next time, drive across the trail, and support this wonderful little restaurant.

Personal Faves:  Tempura Udon and Mochi.

Some of my coworkers and I ordered lunch here a a few weeks ago and I ordered the honey garlic boneless wings. I was very impressed with the size of the boneless wings and you can see the thick pieces of chicken breast that was breaded, deep fried and toss in honey garlic sauce (my choice of sauce). The boneless wings tasted so good yesterday that I decided to order wings again the next day, but for dinner. This time, I ordered the original style wings (bone in) and went with dry rub seasonings to both. One was salt and pepper and the other was lemon pepper. Oh and these wings were huge! There was a wing promo, 3lbs of wings for $30 with fries. Definitely a good deal.

Love this place! I am a native-Edmontonian who is now living in Los Angeles and was in town for Christmas. Was recommended to Awesome Nails by my best friend who is a regular (and they happily remembered who she was when I mentioned her). Went in to get my NYE nails done. Was sat right away, service was friendly, loved the colour selection for shellac nails, and I was happy to hang out with the staff. All the other customers that came in were made to be super comfortable by the staff and the staff members seemed to love to chat with everyone and try to get to know them better. Just a friendly, little shop with incredible staff that I will definitely come back to when I'm back in town!

This salon is well-named -- it truly is awesome.  I felt like I had found my Holy Grail of pedicures and have never had such happy feet.  The first thing I noticed was that the water bowls had a new liner applied, which is such an important hygiene feature.  Then, each employee wore a face mask while working, and the tools were brought fresh.  Hooray for a place that cares!!

The pedicure experience itself was lovely.  My nails were well-trimmed, the colour was impeccably applied, including base and top coat (which I've had salons skimp on), and OH MY GOODNESS warm lotion and hot towel for the leg/foot massage.  Heaven!!

The salon is owned by a young man and staffed with his mother Le (queen of pedicures!!), brother Peter and sister, plus two other ladies were there.  I felt like they all took pride in their work and I will definitely be back - no need to continue my search for a place that is clean, careful, and pleasing results.  Awesome, indeed!

New bar and grill that just opened in the St Albert mall this week. Have never heard of it, but apparently it's a Canadian franchise from out east that are locally owned.
Smaller but cozier space with some big screen TVs, which I can see as a great place to watch some Oilers hockey.
I had the bacon and cheese burger, as well for this week and next, all burgers are half price (after that, it's every Wednesday, check out their website to see daily food and drink specials).  Wings are also half price during this time.  I found the burger very good and filling, and ended it with a delicious ice cream cake. My friends also ordered the burgers, wings, ribs and deep fried cauliflowers. All loved their foods and no complaints.  Today being Wednesday, it's $5 for all domestic and premium beer (imports like Stella are not included), so a great deal if looking for a drink to end the day.
Obviously with it being just opened, they will have some minor issues to work out, but I expected that with any new opened place.  Our server was awesome and was still learning the ropes, but we were ok with that since he was working his ass off.  Met and talked to the owner and she's truly passionate about what she does, so know she will be making sure things are great there.
Will definitely come back again if in the area.  Just a warning that for now, with it being new, I noticed that during the dinner hour, it was very busy and may have to wait a bit for a table.

Great place as a go to  for unique gifts, for that unique person in your life or friends. Different one off items to see. Visit once every couple weeks. On McKenney Ave in St. Albert.

 Seasons gift shop. Enjoy the browsing.

Every single time i come to this store there is a lineup past pharmacy and only 2-3 cashiers working. I have no idea why i bother shopping somewhere where i have to stand in line for 15-20 minutes. I am not coming back here until they figure out how to staff appropriately, and I'd prompt others to shop somewhere else too (superstore and safeway are right across the street). I get that COVID-19 is influencing staffing, but even BEFOFE the pandemic 19 this place NEVER had enough cashiers. I'm frustrated and will be shopping somewhere else for here on out. (Oh, and costumers aren't social distancing, and staff aren't doing anything to promote social distancing. Extremely unsafe for seniors!)
Their bento boxes are outstanding.If you want something tasty and affordable, give this little Japanese restaurant on Hebert Road a try.

I was due for a new set of glasses and heard good things about MDO from my sister and a friend so I decided to check it out. Immediately upon entering it was clear MDO was not like other optical shops. I was greeted and asked to sit, and the staff questioned me about my previous styles, day to day tasks and thoughts about my ideal eye wear moving forward.  I have to say it was refreshing as I'm used to going in to a store and aimlessly walking around for 15 minutes looking at frames unsure of what would work, and trying to catch the eye of a staff member to help me.
Based on your conversation and guidance the MDO staff gather pairs they think will fit your face and lifestyle. I have to admit a handful of the pairs chosen for me, I would have never even picked up if I were looking alone.... but I was surprised how all of them worked in one way or another. The practice of them selecting frames for you makes complete sense... I don't look at myself all day in my glasses, other people do. So experts identifying styles that compliment my facial structure is brilliant, and ended up working out for me.  I got a new pair of glasses that I would have never even found if it weren't for MDO. I've had nothing but compliments since I received them. The whole experience was great, I would definitely recommend MDO to anyone looking for quality designer glasses in a broad range of styles and colours.
Thanks MDO!

Owner is rude and thinks he's the best in the city and says he just fixes the competitors mistakes. Wanted $120 to put soles on a pair of men's dress shoes. Told him I had it done at Commerce place on the same type of shoes for $40 and he handed the shoes back and said to go somewhere else. I will gladly go somewhere else and get them fixed. Don't support this business.

great friendly staff
accepts me in store with medical mask exemption without making me feel like a criminal for having a disability 

Thanks Save-On

It was Sunday and I planned some mom/daughter time. We live outside of town and checked out reviews and Awesome Nails seemed like a winner. We arrived at 12:15 as there hours on Yelp and Google say they open at 12:00. We entered and sat down for about 5 minutes, began picking a colour and one the three employees asked what we needed. We asked for a mani/pedi for two and they said they don't have time today and that was it. I've never had that happen before, was kind odd and confusing. We left to City Nails down the street.

The service at this salon is exceptional. 
I got my nails done yesterday and I was especially impressed with the expertise of the nail technician, the attention to detail with shape and cuticles, the removal of my old powder/gel was painless which is a first. 
They were talented and took their time until my nails looked perfect, I never felt rushed. Everyone is very kind and professional. This is probably the best set of gel nails I have ever had.

I brought my momma here last week for a birthday pedicure treat.  What led me to his location was the fabulous review by fellow Yelper Dana C.

I called day of and managed to get an afternoon booking with Peter and his mother, Le.

Like the dork that I am, I forgot to change out of my skinny pants jeans and couldn't pull my pant cuff more than about 4" past my ankle.  But Peter didn't let this phase him and did an excellent job on removing the rough spots on my feet.  I also dropped the display ring of nail polish colours in the water (like it was my first pedicure ever, what was wrong with me that day?).  Peter quickly swooped it up from the water, cleaned it off, and handed it back to me without making me feel awkward. 

Actually, the quality of pedicure here was most definitely in my top 5 ever.  I think I paid $45 because I got gel polish but the quality overall was hands down better than $80-$100 services I've had elsewhere (and I look forward to not wearing skinny jeans next time, lol). 

Most importantly, my mother was happy with her pedicure which is no easy feat I assure you.  My mom is super picky about polish application.  Additionally, she is diabetic and has to be really careful with her feet and ensure that her cuticles aren't cut or that people don't accidentally cut/scrape her feet with the exfoliation process/shavers.  

Le was fabulous with my Mom and checked in throughout the service.

We will most definitely be coming back.

AND they offer kids pedicures/manicures at a discounted rate here for 12 and under.  I definitely see a 3 generation pedicure appointment in the near future :-)

I've been getting my nails done here for over 2 years and never had an issue with the quality or customer service.  Vinh is always accommodating and so nice. Prices are great and it's clean!  Highly recommend this salon.

An amazing experience and both my glasses and sunglasses look amazing! My vision is perfect and I will definitely be a repeat customer.
Their attention to detail is reassuring, as well as their assistance with helping you choose an appropriate frame with regards to the shape of  your face.

The guy there wanted $30 to place lining in heels of dress shoes, which was okay. Then he said I had to pay up front, cash or debit. No credit cards "because it costs me 7%".  He wasn't too friendly either, "Believe me, lots of places don't take credit cards" he said...I said it is normally considered a cost of doing business and I'll take my business to a shop that follows normal practices and respects their customers.

So I will just say I had a pair of my iron worker boots resoled here, which cost me 174 dollars. The soles are good and heavy duty but the fact I even considered paying this amount was my own fault when downtown shoe repair which has excellent reviews was going Ron charge me 60 for the same thing. 

The fact that you pay 170 dollars and they don't even shine the shoes, Clean the glue off the bottom of your shoes and overall just looks like shardy work is a real piss off. 

Personally I'd find another store to go to even if you need to drive a bit farther. Not worth the money!

Awesome nails definitely lives up to its name... my nails look absolutely awesome. Ava is so lovely. She took her time, made sure the shape was perfect, made sure there were no snaggy bits that would be uncomfortable for me later... (I often find myself filing my nails after... not today!) The Salon was clean... all precautions in place to ensure safety during covid. Very pleased and I will absolutely come back. Glad I listened to all the good reviews and tried this place out.

I walked in w/o an appointment and I was quickly sat down and helped. I got acrylic nails and I loved the results. The woman who helped me name is Ava, very friendly and helpful. I hope to go back for a new set!

I have been dealing with Doug, Deb and Heather for the last couple of months.  I consider myself to have extremely sensitive eyes and I just got my first progressives and a greenish trendy frame that I did not like after the first week of wearing them; the frame was just not me. There was an issue with the progressives as well and not only were these wonderful people very concerned about the fact that I was not so happy with my frames, they were also very concerned that I was having issues on the computer portion of the lens.  They said that because of my sensitivity, I should go with a more advanced progressive. So at the end of all of this, they gave me a more expensive frame and the better set of progressives for not a penny over what I had originally spent and they gave me a computer lens as well to go into my spare frames at home.  My parents had been dealing with Doug and Deb for years and my grandmother as well and now I am and I could not be happier with the effort that Heather put into the whole thing for me. I felt like a pain in the butt to them and they treated me like family. I don't do a lot of reviews of anything but I needed to put this story out there and say how well I've been treated.

Love Love Love this place. They always greet you by name when you come in the door and it is always very clean. They have great colour selections and I'm always happy when I leave. I usually see Ava who has a great attention to detail and is always great to chat with!

VERY happy with our experience here.  After a rough weekend moving, we were in desperate need of some relaxation.  A quick Yelp search brought us to Awesome Nails.

When we walked in, there were only two staff members there, and they were both working on pedicures.  I asked if they had time to squeeze two more pedicures in, and they said it would be about 15 - 20 minutes.  So we sat and waited.

Around noon, we were shown to the pedicure chairs.  I was happy to see that they use plastic liners in the foot baths - I had never seen that before.  The two staff were incredibly friendly, and engaged in conversations with us.  We were all laughing and chatting for the full hour.

The pedicure itself was great.  One of the best I've received.  And the foot and leg massage was definitely the best I've received during a pedicure.  I will happily go back.

Shellac Pedicure is $45 and worth every penny.

My sister called me last night really wanted to get her nails done. I texted my friend and fellow Yelper because her nails are always done beautifully and she used to go to a place in St. Albert that always did a great job.  Well that place is Awesome Nails.  

Firstly, I love a recommendation. Secondly, my sister made our appointment for 11:15am.  They called her Saturday before our appointment to let us know if we wanted we could come in early. I love that! And yes we could. 

The place was so busy when we got there.  All the people working were kind and courteous and helped us right away. There was a tiny miscommunication about what we wanted done to our nails but that was no issue to the workers. They were like that's ok we can do that too. 

The place is very clean and I love the selection of sparkly nail polishes. The prices are reasonable.  

While we were here there was a group of beautiful woman on a stag getting their toes done and having a wonderful time.  I overheard them saying that the service was amazing and they all loved their toes. 

Vihn (owner) did my manicure with shellac overlay and yes it's a simple procedure I assume for them but he did an impeccable job.  My nails look amazing and just how I wanted them to look.  He took his time yet he was very quick and methodical. 

My sister got gel nails and they were done so amazingly as well. 

I was very impressed with how much Vihn cares about his work and his workplace and workers. Not to mention his clients.  He knew several people by name and he talked kindly over my fellow yelper and friend Dana.  This place cares about it all.  I will be returning and referring.  

Great work on our nails!!!
I had to take my boyfriends shoes for work in to get fixed. The man was very friendly to me and was very talkative. I paid $50 plus tax and got the shoes back the same evening!
6 months in and already on second owners. And new owners refuse Groupons sold by first. I had gifted the Groupon to my sister and beyond the refusal they experienced poor food.

A great date night or ladies night! 
No need to to go to dinner before hand because they feed you delicious food all night long!

Went for the first time on Dec 20, 2015.  My daughter and I went to try the corn and crab chowder.  We were hoping to have the Cajun Steak Sandwich and substitute the fries for soup.  We arrived when they opened and were seated after they cleared the waiting line.  Our waitress Diane came over and asked if we wanted a drink.  We asked for water with lots of lemons and this seemed to turn her off.  She brought the water with two small lemon wedges.  Asked if we were ready and we said yes and she said I will be back and then walked away.  Not sure why she asked??  When she returned I asked if we could substitute the fries for the corn and crab chowder.  She said NO and then lectured us on food costs and that the soup was way more to make.  YA I know...but apparently Diane did not want to provide any option for an up charge.  So we order the chowder and the steak sandwich, no big deal.  The Corn and Crab chowder was really a corn chowder.  There was very little crab other than a few stringy pieces, certainly no chunks never mind lumps.  It was tasty even though I would have preferred some real crab...or visible crab.  The steak was ok, nicely spiced.  The food was certainly ok, the service was brutal.  Diane never did improve, until it was time to give us the bill and act like she cared to try and get a tip.  The ONLY reason I tipped was because the kitchen staff did a good job.

Today I ordered at sunny Street Cafe, to be delivered. I added sausage for my breakfast. It's a completely burnt sausage as you can see here . Can't believe they will send such food to their 
. Won't order from them again

I've heard the entire spectrum of reviews of this restaurant. From great to mediocre to fantastic. Sadly I had a mediocre experience. My husband had the jambalaya with alligator sausage and said it was "good" :) I had the fish (it was the Valentines special) and it wasn't special. Saffron rice tasted like normal uncle bens with yellow food colouring and the vegetables were way undercooked. 

The coffee and cheesecake wrapped in phyllo were delicious! 

Also noticed that the noise level was very loud and the restaurant was not full.

Oh lord have Mercy.

Yesterday, the hubs and I had some of the oils and balsamic vinegars from Evoolution when we went to Pamap's Brazilian steakhouse for lunch during Downtown Dining Week 2016.  They were soooooo good that after we left we literally drove to Evoolution in the Enjoy Centre (St. Albert) in order to go pick some up for home!

We were blown away by the enormous variety upon entering Evoolution.  The layout was beautiful and quite inviting.

There were popcorn samples with oil and sea salt as well as bread dippers to try the various oils/vinegars.

They told us about Wednesday tastings for $30 where you get to try a starter, main, and dessert while learning about how to use their products and you get 15% off your purchases that night!  UM YES!!!!!!!! SIGN ME UP NOW!!!!!!!!

We only had about 20 minutes which really wasn't enough for a first visit but the staff were super awesome at making recommendations based on what we enjoyed at Pampa's.

We opted for the Pick 6 for $36 (sample sizes) to figure out what will suit us best.

Their Balsamic Vinegars will last quite a long time but the oils are best used in 4-6 months for optimal taste. 

I seriously cannot wait to go to one of the Wednesday night tastings!

Super awesome! Drive out to St. Albert just to indulge all the time. They have petite portions which is awesome... they use to bring a baggette and butter automatically to table - they don't anymore so make sure to ask!

Wooooo, I'm on a roll for trying out new restaurants in St. Albert.  Can someone saaaaaaay work perks? We decided to try out the Cajun House for lunch, which I've heard nothing but good things about.  We went there on a Tuesday and I was impressed that they are very wheelchair friendly both inside and outside the restaurant. Cajun House is a bit more upscale, so FYI, be prepared to shell out some dolla dolla bills y'all.

They have a feature menu on for the month of December, called "Cajun Christmas Festival". All of the entrée dishes sounded pretty delicious. I was able to convince my one co-worker to share with me. I like how they have a petite and regular size for their entrees, although I couldn't see that much of a difference between the amount of food given between the two sizes (maybe a slightly larger amount of meat but that was about it). Go with the petite and save yourself some moola.

We ordered:
- Seafood Jambalaya ($30) - came with a variety of seafood (scallops, shrimp, red snapper, mussels and crab claws). Everything is baked in saffron rice and served in a red Creole sauce. The dish was flavourful, heavenly goodness. Definitely was worth the price tag, especially considering they are generous with the crab claws.
- Cinnamon pork tenderloin ($14 petite) - pan fried pork tenderloin medallions flavoured with cinnamon and topped with Cajun prawns. Served on a smoked red onion reduction.  We shared this plate and the pork tenderloin had a sweet, cinnamon(y) flavour. Can't say I've ever thought of doing a cinnamon rub with any type of meat. Genius.
- Dill and cucumber salmon ($14 petite) - pan seared chinook salmon topped with a baby dill cream sauce, garnished with baby shrimp and fresh cucumbers.
- Chipotle beef tenderloin with prawns ($19 petite) - charbroiled beef tenderloin medallions and topped with chipotle butter and cajun prawns.
- Muffeletta ($13) - sandwich with genoa salami, italian ham, provolone cheese and olive salad. This is one of my co-worker's go to po-boy sandwich (apparently he comes here all the time with his family).

This seems like the go to spot for retirees and business lunches. We were seated close to a group of older ladies (aka. grandma's) that look like they come here every Tuesday, which is super adorable. Cajun House is definitely worth a try, as long as someone else is paying the billz.

Saw a familiar name from the US and was excited to get some biscuits and gravy. What was I thinking? I guess I assumed that I would get a fresh, delicious meal, but instead I got an old biscuit that was microwaved and pre-packaged gravy that was apparently made by someone who had no idea what gravy is. I couldn't even eat it. Why would anyone think you could get away with microwaving a biscuit? What should've been buttery flaky and delicious was soggy and had the consistency of shoe leather. Makes me wonder what else they cheap out on. Avoid.

Love this place!!!!
I have been here a few times now and just love it!
Staff are friendly and ask how our meal was.
Service was fast.
I had the chicken Munro loved it.
Atmosphere is quite which i really like
Wish they had a patio setting.....

The Cajun House has been around for quite some time for a good reason.  The food is always delicious and the service friendly.

My daughter and I have the petite portion whenever we order as the servings are quite large.  I always have the Seafood Jambalaya Pasta which comes with a generous amount of sausage.  

It's very busy on weekends, so don't expect to get seated right away if you go then.  We usually go during the week and are seated immediately.
Great tasting food. Lots of fruit. Just the right amount of food to fill you up. Very courteous staff. Definitely going to be a repeat customer.

2.5 outta 5. We went on mothers day, so it was decently busy but not crazy by any means and the service was slow. Friendly enough when we got served. There is nothing amazing about the menu, it is just breakfast stuff but it is good. I will say this the sausage gravy is awesome! I could have just ate a giant plate of that. Also the pancakes are HUGE!!! It is a decent meal at an average price. Nothing fancy but alright

Read a couple of reviews and thought I would give it a try. 

Was sat right away and promptly ignored no coffee water etc was offered to start. 10 min later our waitress came to take our order and promptly threw the other waitress under the bus. 

15 minutes go by and not once did anyone check in on us, I had to stop our waitress and ask for a refill on the bottomless. 

When the food finally came the hash browns were barely warm and very greasy and the eggs were supposed to have been medium not soft. 

The pancakes were large and pretty much as listed. 

After the meal I finally got a coffee refill without having to flag down the waitress 

The restaurant was about 1/3 full and the reason I got for the poor service was they are short staffed and too busy 

Will not return

We bought a Groupon to give this new St. Albert breakfast and lunch spot a try, and we were pleased with the visit.

This is in the old Royal Pizza that seemingly failed and arose from the dead 3 or 4 times in the past decade. The menu selection really reminded me of breakfast spots you find in the US with Mexican inspired breakfasts and biscuits and gravy. You never see biscuits and gravy up here and I am a fan... so I had to try theirs!

Sunny Street Cafe offers a "stuffed biscuits and gravy " in which sausage, peppers and onions are cooked into the biscuits and then they are smothered in sausage gravy as per tradition. Mine were very tasty. I had the full order which is two biscuits. My only issue was a weird one... one of my biscuits was Luke warm while the other was piping hot. Odd. My sunny side up eggs were done to perfection. Heathers Denver omelette was delicious and fresh. Service was good and fast as well.

Worth a try!
Came here with some suppliers. Apitizers were excellent, especially the alligator sausage. Everyones meal looked good. And my snapper and ship eettofee was soooo groooood.

Came here with a few friends to celebrate a birthday on a Friday evening.  Good thing reservations were made since the restaurant was packed by 6:15.  There were lots of tables but were a bit close to each other.  Parking was also a challenge on a busy night since there is limited parking in front of the building.  There is a lot across the street but I think you need to buy a ticket.  The restaurant is located near St. Albert's city hall.

The menu had a nice variety, it was hard to decide what to have.  They offer half orders and allow you to choose more than one item.  Three friends had soup all different kinds, each was full of vegetables and meat not just watery broth.  They all looked delicious.  The crab cakes were a nice size and was fresh and moist, you get two in the full order.  I really enjoyed the pecan chicken with broccoli and peppers and a side of garlic butter linguine.  There were also a few Po-boy sandwich choices but I have never had one but may try one some day here!

Make sure you make reservations, it's a great place for a date, with friends or family.  There is something for everyone.

This is my one of my favourite restaurants in St. Albert. It has amazing food and great service. I have been going here for over 20 years and never had anything but quality food and a nice experience. I am told the owner is the chef and everything is homemade. I do take out from here too approx every 6 weeks. The shrimp poor boys and seafood gumbo are perfect for for home. Food is very reasonable and they offer a seasonal menu. It is always busy but they take reservations.  I love the boulibasse , salads and gumbos . my friends always get ya ya steak.

Another pleasant surprise this month for my dining out adventures! The Cajun House in St. Albert is a sure thing, tried, tested and true and still around after all these for a good reason.... their food is reasonable, tasty; the service wonderful, unrushed, and the restaurant itself kitschy and unassuming.

I came here for dinner on a Tuesday night with a friend who was visiting. She grew up in St. Albert and after hitting out on a couple other restaurants in the area, we decided just to come here. She says it's a solid choice. She was right!

From the moment we were seated, our server was super pleasant. Her name was Ashley. She took our drink orders while we perused the menu. There are lots of items on the menu, some with seafood, and others more meat-centric. It was so hard to decide as everything sounded delicious!

We shared the coconut shrimp to start, and for $13 we got some deliciously coconut crusted shrimp with a ginger dipping sauce. I would definitely order this up again.

I ended up ordering the Jambalaya - Oh it was soooo filling and so good for the price of $14! It came with a heaping order of jambalaya, accompanied by an array of grilled veggies, and the best part? The delicious, deep red creole sauce (I had to ask for more because it was sooo good!)

My friend ordered the Steak Jefferson which was grilled and crusted with goat cheese? and a delicious gravy! Also accompanied by veggies and potatoes this time. It's her go-to dish whenever she eats here. Note that they have "petite" sizes for a good portion of their entrees, and although petite in price, was nothing petite in the serving size!

For dessert, yes we were full, but couldn't resist order a house-made dessert, we chose the strawberry rhubarb crisp with vanilla ice cream. This was our least favourite item. The crisp was not so crispy. Although piping hot when it arrived, the dish tasted like it had sat in the fridge for too many days and thus the topping was soggy.

But don't let that detract from your opinion of this restaurant. I would highly recommend coming here if you're in the mood for some solid southwest, Cajun cooking!

Great breakfast for an excellent price! Love that you can substitute fruit for potatoes and build your own oatmeal. 

Staff was very pleasant and checked on us multiple times to see how things were going. We brought along baby and it was very relaxing because it wasn't busy on a Tuesday morning. 

Definitely worth a try.
I was super unimpressed with this restaurant. The food was under seasoned and over cooked. We went in a group

A recent addition to the St. Albert breakfast scene!  This is a well located, locally owned restaurant near south St. Albert, easily accessible from Edmonton on Anthony Henday.  The coffee is absolutely great, not too strong, just the way I like it.  Refills came regularly.  For breakfast I had eggs with toast and hash browns.  They tasted home cooked and filled me up very well.  My partner had pancakes with cinnamon and they looked delicious.  Serving sizes are large and the service is attentive, quick and very friendly.  Definitely worth coming back.

Holistically, my first impression of this place is that it's okay. There was nothing in my food experience that has me jumping up and down with too much excitement.

Our server though friendly and helpful was a bit slow and seemed timid. The restaurant was quite busy for a Sunday afternoon. This fact was impressive knowing that the place hasn't been open for business for too long (about 4 weeks or so). It took a while to get our order and it took some time for our plates to be cleared away. 

The portions were quite large. I split a hearty breakfast with my boyfriend. We didn't want to be too full as we were planning to have an early dinner with friends.  We substituted the sausage links with smoked sausage for $1.99. The poached eggs were cooked perfectly. The hash browns could've been better. They were shredded and just okay. The blueberry buttermilk pancakes were large and a bit tough to cut. However, the huge pancakes were tasty and surprisingly didn't make us full too quickly. The fruit bowl was also kind of pricey for being more than $5. The fruit consisted of chunks of honey dew, cantaloupe, grapes, a couple slivers of strawberries and some thin slices of banana. I had a tall glass of chocolate milk to drink. My boyfriend drank coffee. 

Our meal cost about $27 even though we only shared one entree, replaced the standard sausage (that comes with the entree) with smoked sausage and added a fruit bowl.  We thought this price was a bit expensive for what we ate. You would probably get more for your money if you just order one entree per person instead of sharing. 

I totally understand that this place just opened. Hopefully in time things will run more smoothly and efficiently during the weekend. I'll have to come back again and see.
Great food for a very reasonable price.  I find the portion sizes to be quite generous, so usually order the "petite" size, and still rarely have enough room for dessert. (Which is a shame really!)
This was my first time visiting the Cajun house & the food was amazing! Fresh, hot and delicious! Pricey but ok with paying that for good food and quality!

Biscuits and gravy were very good and eggs cooked perfectly to order.
Will be back to try other menu items.  The family running the place keeps it clean and take pride in serving good food.

I love this place. It's been excellent for as long as I can remember. Food is fabulous, prices are reasonable, portions more than satisfactory and service excellent and friendly. Just consistently great.

Service was friendly, attentive and the food came out quickly despite being pretty busy.

The food was tasty but for a Cajun restaurant the spice was heavily downplayed. The food definitely would not offend anyone, so it didn't wow me. Next time I go I am going to ask them to make it like they would back home and see if that cures the problem. The food has all of the basics to be great just needs a whole bunch more zip in its dooda.

I'm not even a big fan of Fried Chicken.  I usually get chicken strips instead because I don't like eating it off the bone.  But I had to stick with the basics for my first visit.

The batter is crispy and delicious and the chicken stays so juicy.  I don't have a single complaint with the chicken.  I can't wait to try the chicken strips next time!

But the real stars here are the sides.  O.M.G.  The fries are fresh cut and the gravy is out of this world.  It's so so flavourful.  The potato salad and coleslaw are made fresh in the restaurant as well and you can tell.  

Now... the thing I was most excited for.  The Corn Fritters.  There's something a little different about them that I can't quite put my finger on, but they are amazing.  SO GOOD!

I'm definitely a fan of the food and I can't wait to come back.

Now for the service.  It's the little things here that set them above the rest.  The lady who was working the counter was really patient with us while we looked over the menu board.  I think she really loves being there.  She made great suggestions for us and we went with them all lol

It's a small place, with a few tables if you want to eat in.

Check them out!!

I looked at the TripAdvisor reviews to select a restaurant and decided upon the Cajun House based on Past reviews. I believe these reviews are very old because the quality of food that we had tonight was very poor. I will say that our server Chantel was fabulous she was courteous prompt checked-in regularly to see how we were doing and was a very pleasant individual to deal with. The food however was below anyone's standards. We ordered the mussels which were Bland to the point of the sauce was like water and had little substance. I have made mussels at home that were much much better than these. We had the frogs legs which were under seasoned poorly cooked and very Bland. We tried the house specialty which was the seafood gumbo and there was something rotten in it just a bad bitter taste and we sent it back in fear of getting ill. Cajun House your customers are willing to spend good money for good food, what you are serving is poor food and you will not get my money ever again.

LOVE LOVE LOVE this location too. A huge thanks to fellow Yelper Bernice G for taking me here for a taste testing event for my birthday. It was the best educational food date a gal can ask for. 

The lady who was presenting did an awesome job - very casual but interactive and super knowledgeable. The ladies who helped her out and the women behind the scenes who made our food were also exceptional.

The food served was creative, well made and inspired! So much so that I bought many of the oils and vinegars used so I could hopefully recreate the dishes at home!

The quality of oils, vinegars, salts, spices, and other things Evoolution are top notch and worth the money. They also carry a selection of local products like chocolates from Violet Chocolate company and Vegan bacon from Sailing On.

I can't recommend this location enough - and if you get a chance, try out one of their tasting events - you will fall in love with this store and concept even more!

My partner took me here for my birthday and we were really excited to try a good Cajun place and he had heard good things about it. The decor is reminiscent of Boston pizza but we were hoping that maybe the restaurant put the focus on the food. For a drink I ordered the Creole Bloody Mary. It came with a piece of shrimp and celery. The drink was really good. I saw a lot of compliments on the customer service on their Yelp page. Maybe we came on a bad night. The server was really nice. The food didn't take too long. But she dropped it off and didn't check on us again until we were finished. No one asked if I wanted a second drink. There were a few servers on staff but they didn't circulate much and mostly hung out at the bar chatting while our server ran around. Our food arrived and it looks delicious. I ordered the seafood jambalaya and my partner ordered a combination plate. His red beans and rice were nice and smoky. My dish looked lovely and was a generous serving but once I got through the crab legs I was disappointed to find that the rest of the dish was bland and watery.  It was filling but so boring. This was a let down as it was a special occasion.

I had a friend bring me here for dinner on Friday, and really enjoyed the setting of the Cajun House. Beautiful and comfy decor made my meal enjoyable. The Service was the best part of it, our server had her timing down perfect. She wasn't pushy, and one thing that stood out to me was, she didn't ask us to refill our waters, instead let us enjoy our conversation. 

 I wasn't overly impressed with the wine menu. But they made me a great ceaser drink! Now the food, I enjoyed reading the menu. And they weren't kidding with the meal portions. I should have got a petite meal cause I was stuffed after! But the food was missing some flare to it, I though my meal was just okay. 

 But overall, my dinner was good. I didn't feel rushed even though the place was getting full. I would come back again for sure.

Good friends treated my husband and I to a meal at this fun little spot. The restaurant itself is in a professional building, but once inside, the atmosphere is definitey anything but business. The cocktail menu was interesting and I enjoyed the whiskey "martini". My husband thought his Cesar garnished with shrimp was just right. 

Our fresh oysters were the perfect start and super fresh, which was quite a pleasant surprise for Edmonton. The wine list was small, but complimented the menu nicely. We all tried different dishes and while some were not authentic to the Louisiana theme of the menu, they were all quite good. The Blackened Snapper and Jackson Filet were standouts of the meal. My Seafood Jambalaya was not quite what you'd expect to get in the south. The seafood was fresh and cooked nicely, but the rice and seasoning were all wrong. This southern girl was left wishing she'd opted for one of the creative fish dishes instead. You really can't blame a Canadian restaurant for not being completely authentic, but I would suggest a quick glace at few jambalaya recipes or even an episode of Emeril for the chef.

Worse food ever.  I had the $5 coupon to try and was very disappointed.  French  were dark brown , soggy and limp as if the fries were sitting there and they put it  back in oil.  Also the gravy was very watery.  Had three pieces of skimpy chicken.  Would not go back again.  This is in St. Albert.

My parents live in St. Albert and are regulars at The Cajun House. They brought us here for dinner during a recent visit, and we were thoroughly impressed. The service is fast and friendly, the decor is beautiful and fun, and the food is DELICIOUS. I love that you can order entrees in two different sizes (petite or regular). I had the red snapper in petite, and the portion was more than enough. The fish was fresh and flavorful, and the steamed veggies were the perfect side. My parents love the pecan chicken and the chicken monroe, and other dishes we tried were the Jefferson steak and crab cakes - all were great. The raspberry white chocolate cheesecake was unique and decadent. All in all, this is hands down THE BEST restaurant in St. Albert, and also well-worth the drive from Edmonton.

My wife and I had  soup and sandwiches there for lunch today. Good food, great soup in a nice, clean and sunny environment. Mohammed and his crew provided a friendly and efficient service, at very affordable prices. We'll definitely be going back to try some great looking menu items for breakfast. 
.

I've heard so much about The Cajun House so my expectations were quite high. I'm not sure it's lived up to them.

I had the Shrimp Po-boy with a side of Crab Corn Gumbo and it only cost $12.60 but I expected more flavor in the dish. The Po-boy had crispy deep fried shrimp but it was on a totally wrong bun instead of a french baguette and it was only paired with tomato and alfalfa sprouts. There was also a creamy sauce that offered the only bit of flavor. The gumbo was mediocre at best. Felt like it was thickened with flour and didn't have much crab. The fresh green onion garnish was the nicest part.

I will continue to try different dishes but my first introduction to the Cajun House wasn't great.

Great service and great food at very reasonable prices. All the portions were big; enough to be full and have lots of leftovers. There was 3 of us for dinner ; We had the Louisiana jambalaya, the pasta jambalaya and the steak Jefferson, all came out looking and tasting delicious. Plus the coconut shrimp and spring rolls to start. Shrimp was great but spring rolls were just ok, nothing to write home about. All in all a delicious meal and I would definitely be back! Thanks!

Great Food and Great Service

My husband and I love this restaurant. The ambiance was amazing, the decor and lighting make it a perfect date spot or girls night out. Their menu was diverse and included local ingredients and seasonal selections. It was difficult to choose from so many amazing options. The drinks were expertly made and delivered promptly. The food was a short wait. We loved both dishes. The flavours were a perfect compliment, simple and elegant. We will be coming back to this spot again and again!

Nice atmosphere friendly service. Food was good not great. The Seafood Gumbo was the highlight. Jambalaya good but not memorable. Prices a bit high 70$ with tip for two for lunch with only one beer is a bit much.

I'm not sure why the yelp reviews went down so much, but when my gf and I were there last it was great creole food. 

It has the right amount of spice to flavour and should not be overlooked as one of the prime dining places in the area. There are some seating and noise issues that could be addressed but the food should never comprise itself for what it is. Can't wait to eat there again.

This is my favorite restaurant in St. Albert.  The food is always good and excellent value for your money.  There are nicer restaurants when it comes to ambiance and food presentation but they come at a higher price.  I suggest ordering the petite meal size unless you are very hungry.  They have an excellent gluten free chocolate cake.

My wife and I come here quite often.  You get a decent meal here but the decision to eat here is not one of excitement, more of " how about ... "

Frog Legs - these are very tasty.  And it does "taste like chicken"
Gumbo - nice thick hearty gumbo.  Decent flavors.
Crab & Corn Chowder - not a ton of flavor, don't think their seafood stock is strong enough
Shrimp Bisque - a little weak on the shrimp flavor
Salads - hit or miss.  More of a miss lately serving wilted greens
Creole Shrimp - Decent flavors for the shrimp.  Rice or pasta and vegetables lack any flavor.
Po Boys - Oyster is my favorite and the shrimp was good as well.  How can you screw up fried anything

Food - like above you will get a decent meal for a decent price
Wine - Average, not coming here to indulge in high end wines with a high end meal
Atmosphere - friendly, casual.  Nothing special but maybe I've been here too many times

Save yourself the trip. To say this breakfast place was a waste of money would be an understatement. Ordered the bison chilli and the beans were RAW. I told the server and she said they had received multiple complaints about it. She said that's how they made their chilli and some people liked
It and some people didn't. I personally do not eat undercooked beans, and knowing that chillis are supposed to be cooked over longer periods of time and the beans being raw made be question whether or not the bison was properly cooked and safe to eat. We also ordered the loaded hash browns. These were  fine at best. They were shredded and not very warm and the gravy was really salty. To top it all off it was expensive for what we ordered. We did not have to pay for the undercooked chilli (thank god) but we did pay for the hash browns and two coffees which was about 20 dollars. Skip this place. Run far. Run fast.

Some friends and I visited the Cajun House because it is close to The Arden Theatre.  The service was great and the restaurant is nicely (but not spectacularly) decorated.  We had a little trouble finding the restaurant because it is in a business building, however that meant there was a lot of parking.
We ordered several appetizers and an entree each.  Overall the crab cake seemed to be the favourite appetizer.  The coconut shrimp was good but I probably wouldn't order it again because it was expensive for six shrimp.  Everyone liked their entrees very much and I really liked my veal scallopini.  There was so much food on my plate that I had enough left over for two lunches!
One of my favourite features of the menu is the half orders - which is great for people who are trying to watch their calories or are simply light eaters.
We will probably return the next time we have an event at The Arden.
Wow!!! Best corn fritters, chicken and fries.  Service is great and prices can't be beat.  Great new addition to St. Albert!!!

I have been going to this restaurant for years and have never had a bad meal.  They offer petite sized portions which are still plenty to eat, but leave you some room for dessert.  I've taken many friends from out-of-town here, as well has recommended it to others and everyone always seems to enjoy it.  There is a private room for large groups if you have a special occasion.  Have booked it once and it was great fun.
Nice restaurant. Good service but the food just wasn't too flavourful. You'd expect more from a Cajun restaurant I think.

This was our first visit for brunch.    I had the eggs Benedict which was good.  The eggs were perfectly poached soft and the hash browns were very crispy and good.   My partner had the steak and eggs with grits on the side.    He was very happy with his.   The steal was cooked perfectly and the grits were very tasty. 

Servers were pleasant and kept our coffee cups full.   Will definitely return.  Next time I'm going to try the whole wheat pancakes.

We came to celebrate a friend's birthday and this was her choice restaurant.  For a Friday early evening, the restaurant was busy but not full.  We were seating close to the kitchen/bar but it wasn't too busy and crowded.  Some of our party was there when we arrived and there was glasses of water on the table for each of us.  It was a cool day so I ordered a mint tea which came in a large pot that didn't need refilling but provided lots of cups of tea.

The menu had lots of great options including Po boy sandwiches, gumbo, and lots of meat and seafood entrees.  There were so many options, it made it different for us to decide.  I liked the option of petite and regular but being hungry, I went with the regular size.  After ordering, our server brought out slices of bread with butter.  I would have preferred warm bread instead of at room temperature but still a nice addition.

It was also great that you could order 2 different options and mix it up for the regular size.  My 2 crab cakes (1 for the petite) were grilled which I prefer over fried.  I asked for the tomato cream sauce on the side so I could dip the crab cake in it instead of too much sauce.  The cakes were delicious with lots of crab.  The vegetables were a great additional but I found the broccoli bitter tasting.  I choose the spaghetti over rice for my side and it was a generous portion but a bit greasy for my liking.

Everyone in the party enjoyed their meals which include mussels, steak sandwich, and the pecan crusted chicken.  We didn't have room for dessert but they had lots of yummy sounded choices.  The server was good to answer our questions, check in on us, and also take away our plates.

If I'm in St. Albert again again, would stop by for another visit to check out more seafood!

Had the bouillabaisse.  While it was excellent, the portion was quite small.  It was served without bread so I was still very hungry.  For $15, not very satisfying though tasty.  Restaurant is appealing. My husband had an oyster po'boy but it was overwhelmed by the inclusion of alfalfa sprouts.   My mother had a petit plate and the size was fair.  Service was pleasant though inconsistent.   Only one waitress which was likely the issue.

We went here for my birthday because I wanted to try something different. While the house vodka was not great the merlot is very nice. First frog legs ever, they don't have much meat on them but they are tasty. Not sure what the sauce was on them but it was awesome. Tried catfish for the first time to, like most white fish it takes the flavour of the sauce which was good. The potato side and veggies were nice as well. Also tried the Louisiana Jambalaya, that is an amazing dish. Also tried them mussels and would have them again. Pecan pie was decent but the raspberry cheese cake is amazballs! Now bring $$$ cause it aint cheap but it is good. Also our waitress was super friendly and great with a bit of a big table. Totally be back!
Still my favorite place for takeout and dining I. St. Albert . Excellent food and seafood gumbo is amazing.

My friend and I decided to check out this new breakfast/lunch option in St. Albert since there was a Groupon available. We bother ordered the biscuits and gravy and both agreed that we would come back again! (Even sans Groupon) the biscuits were flaky and full or flavorful herbs and spices and the gravy was drool worthy. The portions were generous (you can get a half order with one biscuit or a full with two, we each got the full), prices were fair, and the service was fast and friendly.

I really thought I reviewed this place already... weird.

Anyway... this is by far my favourite place for breakfast in St. Albert.  I spend a decent amount of time in the southern states each year and I crave biscuits and sausage gravy when I'm home (Don't tell me I can make it myself...that's not the point).  So when I found Sunny Street, I was in heaven.  You mean to tell me I can get Sausage Gravy AND a basted egg??  (They don't really know what that is in the states).

Service is ridiculously friendly and attentive. It can get pretty busy on the weekends, but I've never had a problem getting a table.  They recently changed the layout of the dining room a bit and it's much more open now.

I had planned this evening carefully, and made the reservation weeks before the day. My sister and I celebrate our birthdays together (September) and this year it was my choice of restaurant. I really wanted
Cajun food, and there are at least 3 choices within Edmonton, however I decided to go with Cajun House. The place itself is attractive and the service was really excellent. Three of our party were pleased with their meals as they seemed substantial and tasty. My husband and I, not so much, and mine was extremely disappointing. I contacted them directly (after the night) and received no reply whatsoever. To me, this should be part of attentive customer service. Let me mention here that seldom do I complain about a meal. For a 'po'boy' sandwich that costs as much as a huge plate of Jambalaya or pasta, I would have expected to get MUCH more than a tiny bun, with 3 deep-fried oysters, tomato and some alfalfa sprouts. So much for my birthday dinner! I gave it 2 stars for the fact that the wait staff was excellent and the others within my party enjoyed their meals.

The Cajun as a unique menu  and it's filled with great food. I think there is something on the menu for everyone. 

I actually just want to comment on their deep fried white chocolate cheesecake. WOW. It is amazing! It's drizzled in raspberry sauce and probably one of best desserts I have had in a long time!

Other than that the service is good.. pretty average. No complaints or compliments there.
Their eggs benny is my favorite thing to order!!! I always get that when I go there and sometimes I even crave it.

More than an hour no food. Wouldn't recommend. Apparently the chef was on vacation and the staff couldn't deal with the orders or cook in the order they were placed. We saw people served that came an hour after we placed our order. When the food finally came wasn't worth the wait.

Shrimp creole, jambalaya - and a great selection of po-boys too! One thing I'd recommend d - take your own crab fork - they don't have any skinny ones and you'll want all the goodness those crab legs have to offer!

A quant yet outdated decor greets you. Most of the patrons were my age.  Boomer and up. Good list of beverages.  There is large selection of food.  I had the seafood jambalaya and seafood bisque. The food was obviously microwaved.  The scallops were very hot while the rice was lukewarm.  Bland taste.  The crab legs were not fresh.  For an entree that cost $31 it was not even worth half the price. The bread pudding was poorly done.  Hard and dry portions and the rum sauce was rum water.  If this is indicative of the food they regularly serve, I am surprised that they are still open.  Mediocre and way over-priced. If I had not been with friends who invited me, I would have sent the food back and left.  I was really hoping to have a fine creole dish.  Unfortunately my hopes were dashed.
However waiter was excellent.

Are you kidding me?!? 

Evoolution has been a life changing experience! Gone are the days of my palate succumbing to burgers, pizza or Cool Ranch Doritos. As much as I loved that stuff in the olden days (!), the trophy wife and I found this little gem located in The Enjoy Centre in St. Albert, after sampling them at Pampa restaurant in downtown Edmonton. We finished our lunch at Pampa and immediately drove to The Enjoy Centre for a field trip. 
 
Upon arriving at Evoolution, we soon discovered that you can sample any of their vinegar and oil wares that you desire.  We were completely blown away by the selection and flavours of Evoolution. 

We decided to go with their 6 for $36, choosing two oils and 4 flavored vinegars. We bought them with the idea of making our own salad dressings or drippings for a nice bread. 

If you can appreciate a good balsamic, I urge you to check out Evoolution. No word of a lie, this place has changed the way I look at food.

I really like the Cajun House, they make a great meal that tastes authentic. They have options no other restaurant in town has, friendly staff, pleasant atmosphere, all around just a great experience, I would definitely recommend this place for a date or a family dinner or special occasion of any kind.
Spent the evening in good company, enjoying tasting of oil ice oil and vinegeretts. Enjoyed the staff demonstration of parings and the sampling  of many wonderful dishes.

Order 8 piece chicken dinner and it was terrible! Chicken was dry and not fit for human consumption. Fries were over cooked to the point of being close to burnt. Food looked like it had been cooked and then recooked several times. Ended up throwing everything out and had soup and sandwiches for dinner. Will never order this food again!
Interesting note......I wrote a review on my exoerience and it never appeared on the website. Looks like only positive reviews get posted!

Oh oh oh!!!! Corn Fritters!!!! These are a perfect pairing with the crispy fried juicy chicken that you get from this place. A very welcome addition to st Albert. Fresh cut fries, fantastic gravy. The staff are friendly. If you are looking for some good take out or delivery, this place is a must. There is some seating inside, but it is very limited:)))))

What can I say? I LOVE this location. I LOVE the quality olive oils, vinegars and salts that they provide. I came to this location for an evening of taste testing with delicious food using their quality products.  It surpassed my expectations!  The staff that were there and the facilitator were fabulous! They took us through a wonderful exploration of different kinds of oils and vinegars that were served to us in a variety of dishes prepared by the owner's mom. We were also given the recipes to take home to and try and if we decided to purchase any items that evening, we received 15% off. The recipes were developed by staff in the store to encourage innovation and fun! How cool is that? If you do decide to come to one of their tasting events, come hungry!  You get plenty of food to sample and I guess they change it up every season.

If you just want to come check out the store and not partake in the tasting event, it is well worth your while!  You can still sample the products on their own or with pieces of bread.

The staff are great and you can tell they love the product and love what they do. I strongly recommend checking this place out when you are in the area.

The Cajun House was the no brainer choice for Mother's Day this year.  The last year has been really difficult for my family and my mom deserved the best for this special day.  The Cajun House has been her favourite for many many years, so I made a reservation a couple of weeks ahead to make sure we could get a seat.  

This place really understands Customer Service.  We were greeted very warmly when we arrive slightly early for our 7:15pm reservation and were seated right away.  After a couple of minutes, our server came by and offered us beverages.  

We were a little slow to order because we just couldn't decide.  And then I saw that you could combine two petite versions of entrees to form one super entrée!  What a great idea.  I was feeling especially indecisive that evening, so I chose this option and went with the Chicken Monroe and the Filet Mignon Ya Ya.  Both were delicious!

My mom was much more decisive and went with the full order of the Shrimp and Scallop Brochette.  But here is what put the service over the top for us.  I asked what the vegetables were that came with the dishes and explained that my mom has a zucchini allergy.  Our server took this very serious.  And although the Brochette dish did not come with those veggies, she made a note to the kitchen to ensure that there was the least possibility of cross contamination.  It was really appreciated.  Instead of pasta or rice on the side, she went with the potato option (which may be new, because it is not listed on the menu).  Those potatoes are so good!  They slice the potato thinly and then bake it with butter.

The food was absolutely amazing.  Did I need to order two mini meals?  No.  Would I do it again?  In a heartbeat!  My mom loved her meal and ate absolutely everything on her plate.  Which is very impressive!

We couldn't say no to dessert also.  We went in fully expecting to order the warm white chocolate cheesecake, because it has been our favourite for a long time.  But the Mississippi Mud Pie caught my eye this time and we just had to have it.  It is a layer of dark chocolate cheesecake, topped with a tall layer of chocolate mousse.  Absolutely delicious. I contemplated ordering a second one to go so I could eat it at 2 am. 

As amazing as the food was, the shining star of our visit was the service.  She was really attentive and very friendly (without being forced).  When she described dishes for us, she used the perfect words and really helped us understand what we were ordering.  

We've decided that we will definitely be coming here more often.

And BONUS!  There is a wheelchair ramp and the whole restaurant is accessible.

Husband and I met another couple at the Cajun House for dinner recently. My husband ordered a jambalaya dish and I had the Bienville Chicken. He loved his dinner. Me, well I ate about 1/8, seriously.  It was so very bland, I had to look for the chicken, and ask for extra parmesan (which I also had a hard time seeing). I took the balance of my meal home. I left somewhat hungry, the wine helped LOL I regret not saying something to the waitress but the restaurant was one of two our friends suggested and I did not want to offend them. Wait staff was excellent. Parking terrible-the lot was full but the restaurant was not. Would I go back? Maybe.

PS My husband ate my leftovers. Used salt and pepper and said garlic toast would have been good with it and more peppers.

My husband & I decided to give this place a try after a friend's recommendation and we were not disappointed in the slightest. Loved it from the glass of red wine to the appetizer followed by the main courses and finished it off with a delicious dessert. Our service was great despite the crowd of people including a large Christmas party. She was attentive & lovely we were very pleased with our entire dining experience. It does take time there as everything is made to order but well worth the wait.

Okay, I'll admit it. 

I have a fear of barber shops.

Well, maybe not an actual FEAR per se, but an extreme disliking to the entire idea of a barber shop/hair stylist/salon/whateveryouwanttocallit.

On a whim, I decided that I needed a haircut so I thought that I'd try one that just opened up five minutes from my house, Tommy Gun's Original Barbershop.

Upon arrival, there were TV's on the wall, all showing sports. The staff was quick to acknowledge me, helpful in starting my electronic sign-in and offered me a beverage such as cold bottled water or pop, and hot coffee or tea while I wait for my name to be called.

After a 5 (maybe) minute wait, my stylist Shiloh took me back for a shampoo, cut, another shampoo and styling of my luxurious quaff. Shiloh was very attentive, thorough in explaining what she planned on doing, very friendly and made me feel as relaxed as I ever have been in a barber shop. 

The only reason that kept me from giving Tommy Gun's a five-star rating was the price of their basic cut. For me, a $30 charge for a men's haircut is a little steep. This past July, I got a cut in a California waterfront shop for $15 bucks. Granted, they only had one small TV, didn't offer me a drink and I never got a shampoo, but they had the coolest wall of old comic book covers that I've ever seen.

Anyhoo, I would go back to Tommy Gun's again. I only wish that they might give patrons  the option of no shampoo treatment and maybe charge $20? That would be far easier to swallow.

This is literally the worst barber shop in all of St. Albert all the way to Southside Edmonton. The prices are absolutely RIDICULOUS. $31.50 for  a mens haircut and $21 for a kids.... REALLY? The  management seems very unskilled, unprofessional, and weak. I'm never going to return back here, wait times were all over the place and inconsistent, the app screwed me over multiple times, my kids haircuts and my husband's haircut were below sub par. Not worth your time, money or energy at all. I've made a complaint before and was told the manager, Samantha, would give me a call... Never happened. Super disappointed. Clearly doesn't care about the clients if she can't give a 5 minute phone call to an unhappy customer. The receptionists also get treated like trash and seem to just take it. Favouritism seems to come into play here quite a lot from what I've seen the numerous times I've gone in with my kids and husband. Unhappy, unpleased, and never going back.

Literally dragged hubs in here today and was blown away!  This looks like a Dream barber shop.  Sure the price is $30 but it comes with a glass bottle pop, coffee? Or tea and iPads to pass the time and FREE PAC-MAN!

Yes, you read that right!  FREE PAC-Man Arcade Party!  Who cares about the included shampoo & scalp massage?  Just kidding ;-)

The receptionist (Rachel) was super nice and answered all of my bazillion questions while my hub's had his hair cut.  

Now, I don't think women typically stay but I was quite comfortable sipping on a tea and checking the Place out.

They also appeared to have every may hair & beard/mustache product known to man. 

Ladies - looking for a place to have your men get freshened up with a new do?  Look no further!

Also, they did kiddo cuts (0-11) for $20!  I will TOTALLY bring my 5 year old here for his next hair cut! 

2 thumbs way up!

Oh and hubs and I both loved the cut from Selina!  

We will be back! (Prob this week with the little guy!)

PS - Get a stamp card! 11th cut is free :-)

Loved in St. Albert my entire life and have yet to visit the Cajun house until tonight. I was recommended it by a lady who lives at the retirement home I work at. All I can say is WOW how did I not come sooner. I love how they give you the option of a petite size or regular size for the entrees because I can never eat a full size serving at most restaurants. It was the perfect amount. The food was HOT and FRESH. I ordered the Chicken Monroe - Cajun chicken with red pepper sauce, with baby potatoes, vegetables, and mushrooms on the side. Everything was cooked perfectly and SO flavourful. The mushrooms were absolutely amazing too. Definitely coming back soon to try more of the menu!! Reasonably priced too might I add. We also had a lovely young girl as our server who's name was Amy, she was very sweet, joyful and fast!

We decided to give the new Chicken on the Way in St. Albert tonight... an easy end to a lazy February Sunday. 

A very plain Jane little restaurant that has opened in the old Solo Liquor location. First off, I still remember the old Chicken on the Way delivery trucks from being a little boy growing up in Millwoods in the late 1970's, so there was some nostalgia involved here...

This place is very affordable. We opted to split the Hungry Man Meal Special ( 5 pcs of chicken, fries, 2 corn fritters and a side of gravy). We upgraded to a bigger fries and added an extra 3 corn fritters. With tip it came in under $20 and was more than enough food for both of us. For that alone we will be coming back here on weekends when we have our nephews to keep cost low on eating out. 

The chicken was greasy, fairly tasty. Moist and juicy and cooked perfectly. Overall average I would say. I was not a fan of the gravy, I found it quite bland and too thick. The fries are fresh cut and very good (very small in size though) and the corn fritters, as noted in other reviews, are the true star here. They are frigging delicious. Load up.

The staff was very friendly, and again the price is very good. Food overall I would say is average but a very fair price for what you get!

Second time trying this place for my child's haircut, and the last time at that. The first fade was so choppy in the back and this time it was blunt and choppy in the front. For the price I could've just buzz cut his hair for free. That's basically what he got. A choppy buzz cut. And the ladies working aren't friendly at all!

This was my third visit. First visit was absolutely great and kept me coming back.  Staff were friendly, offered me a drink and the wait time was nil.  Haircut was super too. The second visit was good too but I just didn't entirely connect with the stylist but she did an excellent job.  The third visit was terrible. Check in staff was not friendly and waved me off to input my info into the computer.   The stylist insulted me within 30 seconds of sitting down and then took forever to cut my hair.  Other clients came and went while my haircut dragged on and on.  I wish the TV was on so I could at least help from falling asleep, but she didn't even offer TV. 40 minutes to get a simple haircut and the stylist insulting me left me baffled.  Of course I'll try it again sometime but will ask for a different stylist.

Checked out the brand new  St. Albert location of Banh  Mi Nhon Hoa this past weekend.  So excited to have this Vietnamese street food shop in St. Albert!

Hubs and I shared chicken satay sub ($7), Peachy colada (fresh fruit bubble tea $6), beef salad rolls ($8), and Pho ($12). 

Everything was delicious!  The salad roll dipping sauce was sweeter than I am used to and less peanut based. Still good - just different. 

All of their bubble teas are fresh fruit based which makes this Mom very happy.  They can also do a dairy free option. 

Of course the bread and butter here are the delicious subs!  Bread is baked in house daily and oh so perfect. 

I can't wait to go back and try a different sub, the spicy noodle soup, and a vermicelli bowl!

Disappointed with our most recent visit during COVID.  My 9 year old son had been bugging me to go back for months and months.  Finally took him back and was disappointed to see most of the extras about this place closed because of COVID - the stand up video game machine, the iPads, no glass bottles of self-serve pop, etc.  I get it but this place is pricey and to not have the extras made it feel like a rip off.

And to top it off the hair cut he got this past time was not up to snuff.  

I know it could be a one off but for Tommy Guns prices compared to any other barber shop in town, we definitely won't be back during COVID.
9 years since my last review and The Cajun House is still one of my favourite restaurants, I still request this place for date night!

i went her last week... i was a lil reliant since from the outside the place looks very out of date and weird but trust me once u eat there u will love it, they have a big menu full of nice options, at frist when i saw the price of hte entrees i tough it was expensive (20 dollars for a regular pasta ans 12 for a petite size) but then i saw that the "petite" size its huge and its what other places call normal, we ordered two appetizers and a corn and crab chowder.. was so good, for entree i got the jambalaya pasta it was amazing fll of seafood, scallops, homemade ham and creole sausage really loaded!! the sauce was awesome it also came with a side or roasted fresh veggies, obviously i didnt even finished it (the petite size), too bad i was to full for dessert cz y wanted to have the bread pudding with rum,,,
next time ill get it as well as the jefferson steak that comes  crusted with goat chesse and with a nice wine demi glace yummy

If your looking for a really tasty Bubble Tea drink with lots of fruit and original taste, don't depend on this place for it. Super disappointed with the lack luster and bland flavors. We had three different types that somehow all tasted identical. How does that even happen?
The blackened snapper and Cajun shrimp together with the insanely delicious flourless chocolate cake made me add this place to one of my favourite restaurants in Alberta. Very very impressed!

I've always wanted to try a Vietnamese sub so I didn't know what to expect. When I received my lemon grass chicken sub I was like this is it?  I had a bite and was like ok this is good, and then another bite where I got all the flavours and I was in heaven. I am completely addicted now. Had their subs five times in a week. I crave them all the time. Definitely a good place to go to.

Me and my husband LOVE this restaurant it has an amazing cozy romantic atmosphere without the high end price tag. Everything on the menu is amazing, the service is always fantastic and we recommend it to all our friends. If you're going as a couple for a date night ask if a booth is available and you'll get a cozy little spot in the back. We always get drinks, applies and our meals for under $100. 2 thumbs up!!!

I don't always go to St. Albert for dinner, but when I do I end up going to The Cajun House. My first trip there was to try some dishes I missed from my trip to New Orleans, but the food and service is so good that whenever I'm in St. Albert (like I was last weekend) then The Cajun House has become my go-to spot. 

First I'll just mention that the restaurant is in an office building and get into the building requires going up several stairs. There apparently is a ramp (I didn't see it on my visit, but I phoned and double checked) that leads to the back of the restaurant. The restaurant is inside an office building, so when you go into the main building the restaurant is on the left side.
