The location itself need a bit of updating but the service was really good and they do great work so I think its worth the 5 stars!

Update: I've upgraded my rating to 5 stars because I continue to eat here for lunch and dinner and I'm very happy with the consistency of their products. We order pretty much the same items every time we go and I've never had an issue or complaint. The toro sashimi (tuna belly) is trimmed and cut beautifully and each portion is a nice size (6 pieces for $18). The large assorted tempura (12 pieces for $18) comes with an interesting variety of items: 4 prawns, 2 onions rings, 2 squash, 2 yams, 1 string bean, and 1 broccoli head. Also their chopped scallop roll always has a generous amount of fresh baby scallops in a tasty sauce with very little rice wrapping the whole thing together. The staff are friendly, attentive, quick to respond, and clean. They also remember me every time I come even if it's been a month or two. I will continue to eat here and enjoy it!


I've been here for lunch a few times now and we've ordered similar items.

Park Salad - decent size, decent dressing, and it comes with random bits of seafood that were tempura deep fried then packed together and served with a sauce. 

Toro sashimi - very fresh, good size pieces, and slightly cheaper then other places in the city.

Chicken Karage - this dish is tasty because its basically crispy deep fried pieces of chicken skin with a mayo dip. You can't really go wrong with that but it's 8 pretty small pieces for $6.

We usually add one of their fancy rolls as well. This ends up coming to around $45 with a coke. 

Now it is a Korean owned Japanese restaurant and that's very common in Vancouver which is where the family came from.
I come here regularly with my family and friends. Amazing sushi for such an awesome price!

Went for lunch for my daughters birthday! Staff were great, and service was quick. We had edamame, miso soup, Gyoza and tempura shrimp to start - all good, and then shared a bunch of rolls. French kiss was the best! Nice atmosphere, will definitely be back.
One of the better places to get a massage. I remember reading that they do shellac nails too, whatever that is, which might interest the ladies.
Some of the tastiest sushi I've had in a while. I usually get one of the combos and find it's filling and well made.
Honestly i have been to some japanese restaurant and its not soo bad i kinda liked it even though the owners are korean and not japanese. It gets 3/5 caz parking sux but food isnt bad as parking

Got a set of tires here. They do the work when they say and for the price they say AFTER you remind them of the quote they gave over the phone. And unless you enjoy spending an hour scrubbing scuffs off the rim of your wheels and have unbalanced tires (even after going back to them for a second attempt at it) I highly recommend going elsewhere. OEM confirmed and fixed the imbalance, and vehicle is smooth again. I've had bad service here before but got in a crunch for tires and thought after 15 years they may have improved. I was wrong.

4.5 Stars really. When do I normally give an update on a place. Not very often. It's because I want these guys to make it so St. Albert has another option for Japanese good. And in my opinion the best for a lot of items. Best garden/house salad : fresh and the best house dressing. Best tuna tataki : their ponzu is the tastiest out there in the yeg area. Their Hot Night roll is fantastic, one of my favourite rolls again in the yeg area. Tempura : light and crispy and for our daughter with allergies one of the only tempura she can eat.  And their toro has improved, on par with some of the best in the area, nice oiliness and fresh.
So I write this in conflict as I want them to do well but also know when people start coming, it's going to be harder to get a table.

Great staff and great service. I've been going there for years so I'm not basing this on one time. There have been minor issues for sure, like when a mechanic left a wrench under my hood, but overall they have been friendly, on time and know their business. Sometimes when you bring a vehicle in for service at any garage the mechanic suggests more work is needed than you expected. It's up to you to decide if you want to do the work or not. I've never had an issue with their work or professionalism and will continue to support this location for years to come. Good job, boys!
Super fast, and very friendly every time. Food is tiptop quality, the chicken is spectacular.

Came to Sushi Park again this weekend with the whole fam jam in tow, Grandma, too!  We had just watched Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom (Yessss!) and were hungry from all the excitement.

Unfortunately, the meal fell flat for us and was just okay.

Ohana-Ya just a little further south on St. Albert Trail is my current go to Sushi joint in St. A.

First off - Yay for having a kids meal but boo for serving a total of 6 thinly sliced pieces of beef over bean sprouts and calling that kid friendly teriyaki.  My kids love teriyaki but over rice - not a plate of sprouts.  Also, at $12, it was seriously lacking in beef.  We even ordered a full plate of adult beef teriyaki to up it for them and that too was 90% bean sprouts.

My hubs had the chicken and tempura Udon and while the broth was delicious it wasn't his favourite Udon.  Also, he didn't care for the fact that the tempura was in the molten lava hot broth turning to absolute mush.

Highlights for sure were the Seafood salad and Avocado Salad.  I'd definitely order the Seafood Salad again - think finely chopped sashimi over a mix of greens with a delicious gingery rice vinegar dressing.

We tried a few rolls - but again none were stand outs for us.

At darn near $100, I'd rather go to Ohana-Ya (St. A) or Sushi Factory (Leduc).
Amazing food.  Wines were a good selection with reasonable pricing.  Three of us had dinner and we would have changed anything. Great restaurant.
Extremely clean! All the staff are super friendly and helpful. You can generally get in pretty quick which is nice a lot of places you can not. Staff are well trained and confident in what they do!

Had the opportunity to try out Sushi Park this weekend and it was great.  Sadly still no liquor license but the sushi was delicious.  Great portion sizes for the price and service was good. We went right before closing and they had no problem serving us. Will be back for sure!
Bad first impression. Not rushing back any time soon. Perhaps they would benefit from some staff training.

Ate there last night with family. A great environment, helpful service, variety of drinks, and really excellent unique food. The chef came out to meet us after which was a nice personal touch.
Try the coconut chicken, it's great.

My boyfriend and I stumbled upon this place last year and to date it has been our favorite place to go for sushi. The staff is always friendly and the service is great, the food is always delicious, and they always give us something complementary with our meal! Not only that but the restaurant is smaller so it's always nice and quiet. The sushi is reasonably priced and always tastes so fresh. It is definitely my favorite place to go to curb my sushi craving :)
Great food and service. I will be back. Wanted to visit many times finally got there today. Had tempura, hot plate, deluxe sushi, tuna tataki all of it was great.

I have tried A LOT of sushi places in Edmonton and area, but this is by far my favourite and my go-to. If we aren't feeling fancy, my hubby and I can eat the standard rolls until we are full for prices equivalent to somewhere like Tokyo Express, except that the rolls are fresh and delicious! The fun rolls are more expensive, but still very reasonable. Their rice is always perfectly seasoned. I am picky about my tempura, and Sushi Park does theirs right! This is a small, family run place which is very welcoming. I don't order a lot of sashimi or noodle bowls, so I cannot comment too much on that, other than to say that what I've had is always delicious. Their house dressing is also phenomenal!
Very clean, and welcoming environment! The receptionist is very friendly and helpful. The estheticians are very professional and efficient. I would definitely recommend!
Absolutely delicious, quality food, with great presentation. Friendly, prompt staff. Got to meet the chef. Great to have an option like this in town.

Pretty crappy experience. Right off the bat we were seated at the lounge (even with a reservation) and were tucked into a corner. The seating was so awkward and cramped that we had to move chairs to get in and out to use the bathroom. The concept of a lounge wouldn't have been an issue if the music wasn't blaring-- and it wasn't even good music; it was weird indie depressing stuff that played on a loop. It took about 15 minutes for our drink order to be taken, then when we placed our food order we realized a bit later that we weren't asked how we wanted our steaks done. However... the food was fantastic. For paying 30+ dollars a plate, the atmosphere was awful and the service was terrible. I wish they did skip the dishes, because I never want to step foot in that building again. I recommend going to Ernest or 19 if you're looking for a fine dinning experience worth the price.

A fabulous sushi stop as I was passing through St. Albert! Being my first visit, I am impressed enough with the service, food, quality and facility to give 5 stars. 

First the service was warm and friendly with a helpful waitress who took the time to help me make a selection based on what I love when I order sushi. My expectations are high after enjoying authentic Japanese sushi after nearly two years of residence in Japan. At no time I feel delayed or hurried by the service. Well done on a Monday evening. 

Second, the food is outstanding in presentation, portion and freshness with wonderful flavours that brought back my experience of Japan. So delicious in every bite. Take your time to savour each piece of sushi and not overlap each without a cleanse with some ginger, salad or a sip of Sapporo beer!  Your taste buds will thank you so they can enjoy the distinct flavours of each type of sushi. A very refreshing salad!  The Miso soup was wonderful and flavourful. 

Third, the quality is great!  Nothing fishy tasting, fresh ingredients that blended together well with the sweetness of soy and hotness from wasabi. A real delight with generous nigiri sushi. Loved it! I want more! 

Fourth, the faculty is clean, nicely lit and decorated. While not an authentic Japanese experience, nonetheless it's inviting and comfortable. It's a good place to bring friends or family for on or up to six table seating. Although I'm sure for larger groups the tables could easily be custom arranged for more. 

Overall I'm impressed with Sushi Park and what it offered. Even enjoyed a free sample of Tempura Roll and the Lettuce/Salad. It's a place I'd like to return to and try other menu items.

A lovely belated Valentines Date for me and the fella. Service is always good, though I wish the starters were finished before the rest of our order was brought out. Not the worst but it meant we had a massive table of food, luckily we were at a 4 seater and had room.
The octopus on the sashimi platter was a tad chewy but apart from that everything was top notch. Can highly recommend to takoyaki and the tuna tataki appetizers. We also had a taster sent by the chef which was a nice touch. Value for money for sure. I wish half stars were an option because I definitely would say 4 1/2 stars.

This is one of the best experiences in terms of service I've had in a long time.  My parents' old furnace decided to stop working properly during a cold snap.  They got ATCO out and was told it was an issue with the motor.  We were calling companies and most either were too busy to answer or weren't able to come out for at least 2-3 days.  Well, just our luck that Furnace Solutions answered the phone and the guy I spoke with said they could get someone that evening to my parents' house.  He got the information and when I got more information about the issue, I called back but received a full voice message.  I sent a text with the information.  It wasn't even the evening and my parents got a call that the tech would be arriving soon.

Marty replaced the motor but advised a new furnace would be needed, which we agreed with.  We knew the furnace was on its last legs and did not feel my parents were being told this for a sale of a new furnace.  The sales guy, Jamie, called and said he could come that evening but we weren't able to meet him there so we arranged for a visit a few days later.  That's job dedication he was willing to stop by on a Saturday evening! They are really great about calling if they are running late, or letting the customer know about what time they would be arriving.

Jamie was a little later than the scheduled time but he called to let me know.  He was friendly and asked questions and provided information.  He showed us the Trane furnaces and the ones that he would recommend.  The amount on the previous invoice from the motor replacement would be put towards the new total.  It was also great they offered no tax for a senior's discount.  They were initially going to come the next day to install the furnace but due to a personal issue, they came the following day.  Not a big deal for us as a two day turn around is pretty good.  

I was not there on installation day but it seems they did a diligent job and removed the old furnace and installed the new one without any issues.  I'm glad that we found a great company in a time of urgency when we just wanted any company to fix the issue so my parents would have heat during the cold snap.  Would recommend this company and it's great they are 24 hours too!

What a shame. I used to tell everyone to go here and I was advised to do the same. Never again. The kid at the counter is a crook and tries to get you to do work that isn't needed. My power steering line failed and no I didn't need new transmission cooler lines as you so insisted. I took it elsewhere because of that and I won't be back as a result. Not sure if Todd is the owner anymore but he needs to look at his service writers. He's got a problem there for sure. Sadly I do NOT recommend.

A+ Customer Service & Exceptional Work by the crew at Furnace Solutions!

We have some income property and noticed our tenants had several fans running in the house, because our home was well insulated it meant it kept the heat in as well. Great for winter, not so much during our hotter summers. I put off doing something like this because I was worried about the expense and work involved but wanting to keep our tenants comfortable, we contacted Furnace Solution, they came out and right away and after some quick consultation recommended an air conditioning solution that would meet our needs, and to my surprize their estimate was comprehensive and lower than anyone else's. 
 
When I arrived to check on how the installation was progressing I was surprised to see how fast and efficient they were, especially given some challenges to being an older home with a finished basement. They had several ideas on how to overcome them and felt confident there was no problem. Jordan and Nolan were exceptionally great to deal with and took the time to explain everything they were doing and provided an accurate completion time. I really appreciated the expert opinions and suggestions they provided and how they even addressed our future needs. Courtney came by to do a quick check to see if I had any questions, it was nice to know that Furnace Solutions has a team of support too.  I felt reassured that the was receiving the best care. I know they had other clients, but during the install I felt like I was the only one that mattered that day.   Our tenant was also pleased by the quick professional work and came home to a comfortable cool environment. 

If your like us and want your tenants or yourself to be comfortable, make sure furnace solution is your first or last call.

A huge thank you goes out to Furnace Solutions!

John & Janet

Have been to Focus previously and although I found it on the expensive side I enjoyed my day at the Spa. I wanted to purchase a gift certificate for a friend. Saw their advertisement that they were having Black Friday specials.  So I signed up for their newsletter and patiently waited to receive the specials. Newsletter never came so I phoned Focus whoever answer kept referring me to the newsletter that I never received. She herself did not know what the specials were. She finally agreed to take my number and call me back with the info.  She never called back.. So Focus you lost two customers. I used Yelp reviews to find another salon with great reviews and better prices and they were more than accommodating in answering my questions.

I remembered going to a Swiss Chalet as a kid, and decided to have dinner at the St. Albert location. It was easily one of the worst dining experiences I've had in a long time. The waitress was incredibly rude - she flung menus at us, barked 'What you want?" when she came to take our order, and rolled her eyes when I asked her a question about a menu item. 

Food was slow to arrive, and not at all worth the wait. I ordered a quarter chicken meal with mashed potatoes. The chicken was still pink, and very dry. Mashed potatoes were cold and lumpy. My boyfriend ordered a hot sandwich that arrived cold and tasted stale. Definitely would not come back here again.

When I think comfort food, a place like this hits the spot. We were seated quickly and our drinks were brought to us right away. 

There's a promotion on where you get a free quarter chicken with any rib entree, so we ordered a 1/2 rack with mashed potatoes (they're our favourite side - something about them is so good!). We also tried their "fired up" deal which was $12.99 for a quarter chicken in your choice of spicy sauce (we chose buffalo butter), side, and your choice of soup, pie or mini donuts. Both entrees cone with a dinner roll and chalet sauce for the chicken as well.

Our food came out fast and was great. The ribs were surprisingly good: very tender and flavourful. Quarter chickens were both good, though the spicy sauce wasn't very spicy to me. Think it was Frank's mixed with butter and brushed on after. Chose the mini donuts and you get 5 drizzled in caramel with a pile of whipped cream. Very similar to the ones you get at fairs and carnivals. 

Overall, we liked it. The server was friendly, the food is consistent with what we expected and the price was right. Inexpensive dinner out that tastes very comforting.

Best sushi place in St. Albert! Absolutely wonderful place. Great prices, fantastic people, and overall an amazing experience. The food was delicious, and was served to us fast. Will come here many times in the upcoming future!

I've visited Sushi Park twice now and they've yet to disappoint me.

First visit, we ordered:
Salmon sashimi, miso soup, gyoza, french kiss roll (so freakin' good), saba, salmon and tuna toro nigiri, and prawn tempura.

Now let me tell you something: I'm not the biggest fan of salmon sashimi or any other sashimi just because of how slimy they can be and the texture just doesn't agree with me sometimes. BUT goodness gracious, their sashimi was not slimy at all, it went down easy (without being slimy) and it was smooth and buttery even? Needless to say, I am a fan of their salmon sashimi (just theirs though lol). 

Their miso soup was super flavourful and fresh.

I usually prefer my gyoza to be a little crispy but these were soft and I actually did not mind them. The pork and veggie filling was super tasty and the sauce it goes with just brought out those flavours more. The overall appearance of the gyoza looked homemade and tasted homemade so props to the chef.

The french kiss roll was basically a deep fried california roll but with avocado and cream cheese and chopped scallop on top + sauces. At first, I was hesitant cause cream cheese with sushi is a lil weird and might overpower everything else like other rolls I've eaten with cream cheese. BUT the cream cheese was in small portions so the taste came right at the end and it was a wonderful bite. Also, I should add that their roll portions were the right size, not too big that it doesn't fit in one bite but not too small that I can still talk after I put it in my mouth. And the sauces were great, not too much that that is all you taste which is perfect cause too much sauce is a no-no.

The rice in the nigiris were perfect (as my friend says): the rice did not fall apart and the fish on top was a good size and she says overall they were some bangin' nigiri.

The prawn tempura was amazing. The batter wasn't too much so I actually tasted the prawn. Not super crunchy either. Perf crunch + perf prawn = yum.

Second visit, we ordered:
Salmon sashimi, french kiss roll, tuna tataki, saba and salmon nigiri.
My friend ordered the tuna toro nigiri like last time but was told they sold out :( but instead they were very lovely enough to bring out some fresh salad on the house. It was absolutely delish. I'd order it the next time we come once we find out what it's called lol.

A little hesitant about the tuna tataki just because I only love beef tataki but goodness gracious, it was scrumptious. The tuna was seared perfectly: it was soft but still had texture on the outside and their ponzu sauce was different but good different. I wouldn't mind bottling that sauce up.

Overall, 5 stars. Servers were attentive and friendly and not all up in your face like some servers can be. Ambience of the place was very relaxed. There was music in the background that lightened up the mood (I felt like I was in Japan almost). In the end, I would go back every week if I could. If you're thinking of going there, don't think, just go. Like now.

This is most definitely my favourite sushi place in both AB and BC. The menu is fairly priced and has plenty to offer. For the actual sushi, it is amazing and incomparable to any other place. Typically when I bring new people to the restaurant, I order the appetizer tempura (5peices assorted), deep fried dynamite, California rolls and miso soup (99 cents !!!). That comes to about 23$ so very cheap ! Also everytime I've gone to Sushi Park I have gotten a free dish, whether it be miso soup or the new tempura roll (which I highly recommend). Lastly, the service is very friendly and quick. I'd eat here everyday if I could !
Such a fun, creative space. Be CERTAIN you are here to try one of their fresh cinnamon buns. Amazing!
Wow service is amazing,food is amazing , the chef are amazing, it's a yes all the way ,thank u for the complimentary sushi there :) was a nice touch :)
This is my favourite place for a romantic date night and the brunch is fantastic too. The steak is perfect and so flavourful and I love their seasonal offerings. The service is incredible too.

Me and my friend went here because the other two Japanese restaurant we wanna tried was closed. So we got here and didn't expect that it is so tasty. The sashimi is very fresh. And the St. Albert roll is super tasty. We also ordered a beef rice bowl. It is okay but the rice is good. It is a little expensive and with the taste, it's worth it!
Food is very good . Would like to see a little more choices on the dinner menu. Service was very good and waiteris was very pleasant
Strong estheticians, experienced RMT, convenient location, good products. You won't be disappointed with Focus On You.
Loved it! Service is fast the food is delicious! Love this little sushi gem in St. Albert
Best sushi I have had in St. Albert or Edmonton area! Prices are good, the food is fresh, and service has always been perfect. Can't wait to eat here again!

I love the idea of a late night dessert bar and wanted so badly to like it here. I think it was too new when we tried it (shortly after opening) and they had some kinks to iron out. 

The space itself is dark, filled with lots of dark, warm wood for a sexy coffee house feel. Lots of original art pieces and space - felt big for the few tables that were set up. 

Service was a bit awkward, but again, it could be new-business jitters. We ordered a regular coffee, their signature Baked Canadian and another dessert, but were brought a berry cheesecake. That's ok! I like cheesecake too. They brought us a tiny portion of caramel corn to start and it was delicious, but very soft. The cheesecake was great and I'm glad they brought us that instead of whatever we ordered. It was smooth and creamy with the perfect amount of berries on top. I'd definitely get that again. Unfortunately, the Baked Canadian looked better than it turned out to be. The chocolate cake inside was moist but didn't have much flavour, and the plentiful meringue was too much. It wasn't like a gooey meringue you'd get on a lemon pie, but just fell flat in taste - like airy foam. For $15 we would choose something else next time.

Their social media showcases a lot of custom cakes and they all look beautiful. Also, they do workshops and classes! I'd try it again now that they have been open for a bit.

This is a charming little place that everyone should have the joy of experiencing, it will not disappoint. The first time we went it was Christmas time and there was an enormous real Christmas tree set up and adorable Christmas treats and cookie boxes for purchase. Everything is made on site. We ordered coffee, hot chocolate, gingerbread and the kids got milk and cookies. The cookies were baked while we had our drinks and came out hot and fresh, ready to dunk. The adults even wished they had ordered some for themselves.
Before we left we got a special surprise, Santa Claus! 
This place offers special baking classes, custom made cakes and goodies as well as holiday themed treat boxes such as valentines and Easter cookie kits. Book a private party, or even pop in for free movie nights! 
It is a cozy, adorable place and the owners are very friendly, definitely recommend!

If getting ripped off is one of life's pleasures, this is the place to be. If it is not, then I suggest you seek another shop for your mechanical services. 

This is my story -- a vehicle of mine required a new power steering pump, so to Fountain Tire I go! Well the fellow quotes me 1 hour shop time plus parts. No problem. He quotes me a NEW pump at $400 but says he could source out a used one for cheaper. I elect for the used pump...

A day later I come to retrieve my vehicle and am graced by an $800 service bill. Hmm...something's not adding up. $400 + $100 (labor) should be $500 plus tax and other shop fees. Lo an behold I am quoted a part replacement cost of $600 for USED. I thought used would have been cheaper. Boy was I wrong! Evidently that USED part had been bathed in liquid gold and kissed by the Dalai Lama hence the premium. So I express my concerns, and the service tech plays dumb and says he'll check with the "manager" aka "come back in a few hours when I have time to come up with a better story". 

An hour later I come back. The total bill remains unchanged but the part cost has in fact decreased but labor costs increased. I guess I was charged for that hour of "story telling". 

Moral of the story: do your homework before getting mechanical work done AND don't go to Fountain Tire in St. Albert.

Best sushi place in St. Albert for sure, and maybe Edmonton too! The service can't be beat and their sushi is delicious! The pricing is awesome and in my opinion you get more than you pay for. It's always clean and welcoming and the employees are always smiling. On a few occasions we had free samples brought over to try and that has expanded my ordering-range for sure. It's always a treat going to Sushi Park!

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY! Made an appointment with this company, waited 5 hours, and no one showed. 2 technicians had called saying that they were on their way, only for neither of them to show up. 

I took a day off work and waited around in a freezing cold house only to be disappointed. We ended up calling another company and they came within the hour.  Furnace solutions will never have my business in the future.

Update: technician showed up even after we cancelled. I turned him away, only for him to continue to call and text me.  When the new furnace company arrived, they informed us that he was parked down the street. I do not appreciate or tolerate such harassment.

Who would have thought St. Albert could have such an awesome Japanese restaurant. This place is so cute with great food to boot.

The walls are a warm pumpkin orange with Japanese geisha art work. The waitress wear kimono like uniforms. The menu is huge and as one customer I spoke to said " you can't go wrong with anything you order."

I had lunch with  group of 5 coworkers. Food was fast and we were given complimentary  miso soup and a light salad. We ordered several dishes to share from the menu. My favorite was the A C rolls. We also had the yam tempura, (which I thought were just  okay but everyone else seemed to really enjoy), the deep fried tofu (yum), the Victoria rolls, tuna Taki rolls, dynamite rolls and deep fried California rolls.

All the food was delicious and fresh. Servus was fast and friendly. I have not one bad thing to say thus the five star rating.

Its that time of year when my 18 year old furnace is reminding me I should have saved money for a rainy day like any responsible home owner should. My furnace was blowing cold air, had Atco gas come to inspect the issue and they recommended I contact a furnace company. When most companies would charge you ridiculous rates for calling a same day appointments as an emergency and overcharge for after hours, I was lucky to get a referral to Furnace Solutions and met Justin Jacobsen to fit me into his busy schedule and charge me a reasonable price for the service. I found their service to be honest and truthful and efficient, with the service I had received it was evident that they take and look after their customers. Totally recommend this company for any furnace issues for anyone.

This is my go to sushi, I've tried quite a bit of places for sushi as I always like to see what different places have to offer. The owners of this place are so sweet, and friendly. I love their chop chop and dragon eyes. They also have amazing miso soup did I mention the soup is free ?! Well yeah it is . I've never been to an sushi place and got free miso soup, so that's an plus for me ! If you haven't tried this place give it an try :)
This is the best sushi place in St.Albert maybe even Edmonton. We always forget to take a picture of the food as we can't wait to dig in.

Awesome customer service top notch there was a mix up with the appointment no fault of there's or mine computer glitch  caused it but they  made it up immediately and solved a long time issue I was having  in minutes  absolutely awesome experience with this company I won't use anyone else. HIGHLY RECOMMEND THESE GUYS ! Thank you Marty you made a busy day a lot easier cheers !!!!!
My husband and I had the new crispy chicken and it was cooked perfectly. Not greasy. The mashed potatoes and seasoned rice made perfect additions

These guys were here to help when I got a nail in my tire, requiring a patch.  They did a good job, but they of course tried to sell me some tires, which I do not need at this time.  I was surprised that it took an hour to repair my tire, but in the situation, I was just happy that it could be done.  They also charged $45.00 to patch the tire, where I know some other tire shops will patch for free, in hopes of return business.  If I was in a bind I would go again, if I wasn't I would shop around.

The ambience of this place is super cool. If I had money I would buy a couple paintings on the walls. If it wasn't this crazy covid world I probably would have sat down and tried an appy and a drink. Instead we just took cakes home. The chocolate was amazing! The peach cheesecake was good but actually having peaches in it surprised me, I thought it would just be topping but I guess they actually do authentic cakes. The service was fast and friendly and I will be back when the world is back to normal!

I had the pleasure of being invited to dine here for a weekend brunch. There were 5 of us at the table. I believe we all ordered something different. Tasty, fresh, unique. Home run on all counts. Not one thing not looking divine. Smells - amazing. I ordered the steak and eggs. The sauce on the steak simple but super tasty. Over hard eggs done perfectly, exactly as I like.... never found done well, until now. Looking forward the returning for an evening repas. Dylan, keep up the excellent work. You were destined to do this. (To my nephew, thanks for your generosity- paying for our calories)
Perfect summer spot to kick back after a stroll through the picturesque neighborhood.
Have gone here (dine in) numerous  times  and have always really enjoyed it however we recently ordered takeout sushi and were sadly disappointed with the food .

The food here is absolutely amazing. I ordered the 6oz tenderloin and it was cooked to perfection, it was melt in your mouth almost like eating a piece of butter every bite. Definitely the best steak I have ever had. We ordered the Crispy Duck Confit, Bison Carpaccio and the Cauliflower to start and each one was absolute perfection. I would recommend this place to anybody on a nice date night or family night out.

We had an appointment in St. Albert so we stopped in to Swiss Chalet to try the Holiday Special, it was pretty good. They give you cranberry sauce and stuffing with your meal and a scratch ticket and Lindt chocolates (pictures). 
Service was great, our waitress was very sweet, and very prompt. Her name was Ngoc.

The service was amazing, we had two old furnaces and they were quoted and redone with a new single furnace and an A/C. Scott was great, came to the house exactly on time, took the time to chat about options and didn't feel like he was trying to upsell you, gave the straight talk about what we needed, not what he wanted to sell. Scott responded to emails quickly and we set up an appointment. Josh and Nolan were the install crew and did an awesome job- the install was very clean and neat, done quickly but the took the time to talk and help me understand the new system- they were professional, exactly on time with the install, and even did a bit extra with the rearranged ducting to make sure it looked nice and clean, just because its how they roll. Overall, could not have been happier with the job done- would recommend these guys any time!
I've never been let down. The food is outstanding and very reasonably priced. The staff are very courteous, hospitable, and friendly. Well done!!

Checked out Sushi Park tonight for their First day of business!  The staff were welcoming and friendly from the moment we stepped inside. 

The Hubs and I enjoyed the Tempura Udon immensely!  It had a fantastic broth with lots of sliced white onions thoroughly cooked to the point of sweetness.

Tofu Agedashi for a starter was okay but not as good as Yuzen down the trail.

We also tried two rolls from their specialty menu that were top notch!  House dynamite & the Crazy Roll (our fave) were gobbled up quickly and Id definitely order both again.

I appreciated that the water glasses were large in size but I would have appreciated a refill on our waters even more.  

After we finished eating, the dishes were left in front of us for 25 minutes until I waived someone down and asked for the bill.  And then another 10 minutes later, I went up to the counter to pay.

Hopefully these are just kinks in the road of peeps new to serving.

The food was a solid 4 stars but the service left room for improvement.  To their credit, everyone we spoke with was friendly.  There were some language barrier difficulties when I inquired what the "special" sauce was listed on the menu for maki roll we were considering.

Overall, pretty darn good first opening day experience.  We will definitely be back!

While there isn't many Japanese restaurants in St. Albert to choose from and whenever I'm at work and craving sushi this is where I'd order from. It's actually a pretty good decent place as price point is about the same with other places, and the taste and quality is pretty good as well. Overall, it could be better, but this totally satisfied my sushi cravings.

I have now been to sushi park twice, and already am looking forward to my next visit! Not only is the food amazing, fresh, and delicious, but the service here is well above almost anywhere I have been. The staff are very enthusiastic and friendly, and go the extra mile to make sure your experience is a good one. The last time I was in, my friend and I were given an extra dumpling so that we had an even amount to split, the sushi chef brought us over bbq salmon belly on the house, and then we were also offered ice cream on the house. Of course, I would never expect service quite like this every time I visited a restaurant, but we were definitely blown away. The first time I ate here, we weren't given all the extra food, but I would still happily give the restaurant a 5 star review based on that first visit as well. I would recommend anyone looking for a good sushi place to give Sushi Park a try!!
amazing sushi and so fast too - such a great environment too! must try. great family restaurant or date night!

Used the drive through to order chicken Caesar salad, chicken noodle soup, French fries & gravy. Was quick & I believe a fair price, the food tasted very good especially the gravy for the fries. The drive through was really handy! Will use again

I'm surprised by the lack of reviews... this was by far my best dinning experience in the area in quite a while!

We've already planning out our next few visits because we can't wait to try MORE on the menu.  And as I was enjoying my meal, I was so excited to write my review and share my experience with you all.

I was worried they would be busy on a Friday evening, so I made a reservation via OpenTable.  That wasn't necessary, as there really wasn't many people there.  But there were a few tables occupied in the dinning room.

We were greeted promptly as we entered and shown to our table right away.  I'll be honest.... I expected the interior to be kind of stuck up or snobby or something, but it was incredibly warm and welcoming.  The tables have high back chairs that are very comfortable.  And I was happy when the hostess offered to take my jacket and hang it for me.  As we started looking through the menu, our server stopped by to make some suggestions.  She was incredibly knowledgeable and thanks to her recommendations, I ordered something that I never would have otherwise.  My Arctic Char was delicious and the warm potato and asparagus salad went with it perfectly.

The star of the meal was definitely the avocado bruschetta appetizer.  It was so fresh and just delicious... I debated skipping dinner and just ordering more of that.

Our main reason for visiting was the Creme Brulee that we saw on facebook.  We're suckers for a good creme brulee, and this one was at the top of our list to try for a long time.  The raspberry is incredibly subtle, which is great because it didn't overpower the rest of the dish.   We also went for a slice of Key Lime pie which was so smooth and creamy.  The coconut in the crust made it really stand out.

I can't wait to go back.
We had a great experience dining in here- good food, even better service. We will be back!

Horribly upset at the cost increase. Why is it more for a chicken wrap than a quarter chicken dinner??? I feel like you are taking advantage of a bad situation. No longer impressed with this location as I once was
Awesome sushi, friendly staff and always fresh food. Have never had a bad meal or left unhappy.

I called in the morning to see if they could get my daughter's vehicle in for a much needed tire change. Albert who I spoke to was very accommodating and pleasant to deal with. He got her in that afternoon, even went as far as telling her to specifically ask for him. On arrival he got her car in right away and tires all changed out for an even better price than he quoted me on the phone. The mechanic also took the time to explain the worked needed on shocks but didn't force her or intimidate her (as some shops do). They even offered to call me about it. No pressure business as auto shops should be! Will for sure be back.. keep up the great work!!! Albert is a gem!!

Best sushi place in St.Albert hands down. Cute little shop and fantastic service every time we have pardoned this place. We live in north Edmonton so good sushi  is a rarity within a 20 minute drive and this place by far beats out all the places in the north end  and the best in St.Albert

I was treated to a birthday dinner at Riverbank Bistro recently and it was a delightful experience. This was the first time I dined at this restaurant, that sits on the banks of the Sturgeon River.   Apart from the great company,  the meal and service was of high quality.  I believe it is possible to sit outside with a view over looking the river however we dined inside.   The atmosphere of the dining room with its bright windows and rustic ambiance is low key with contemporary music playing softly in the background.  There are several menus to choose from including a Snowbird menu for those over 60 available on Tuesdays to Thursdays between 4pm and 6pm.  The Snowbird menu offers two course meals that include an entree and either soup or caesar salad.  The price is $24.00. The entree choices include fire grilled strip-loin, fire grilled salmon, herb roasted chicken and a vegetarian wellington.  The main menu has an array of choices including  seared salmon, Arctic Char, ancho dusted chicken pasta, venison flank steak, braised lamb, butter basted chicken, short ribs, and a number of other meat lover fav's.  Each entree is serve with uniquely prepared vegetables and  sauces.  The price range is between $24 and $33.  Appetizers range from avocado bruschetta to crispy pork belly with prices between $9 and $17.  They also have a brunch menu and a bar menu.  You can order off the bar menu also, if you are in the dining room.  They have a wine list with something for everyone.    
We had the seared salmon and a Cesar salad.  The salad was made from the the heart of the romaine and the dressing was delicious.  The salmon came laid  atop a tasty dollop of creamy and flavorful mashed potatoes bordered with sprigs of broccoli.    The salmon was baked to perfection, hot, not too dry and not uncooked.  The herbs used accentuated the flavor of the food without over powering it. I really enjoyed it.  We had the Wente cabernet sauvignon.  It went down so easily we had to have two.   
To summarize, this restaurant serves high quality food at a reasonable price while providing a relaxing atmosphere with pleasant and attentive service.

I've been to confections 3 times now - twice as a family treat, once to a private birthday party, and I've had their fancy cakes at parties!

Confections is a solid 4 - almost 5 star in my books! 

My daughter loves their fancy schmancy macarons for a treat, hubby likes their cake, and I was surprisingly surprised by their chocolate cupcakes at a private function - not too sweet still decadent yum! 

They also serve wine, beer, and cocktails with a ficus on local - Alley Kat beer and Hansen's Distillery liquors.  And of course there's coffee if that's more your thing!  They have a few appetizer like bites as well but really you need only come here for the sweets.  

The vibe is modern eclectic.  Currently there's a wall of portraits with an 80's splatter paint vibe featuring Freddie Mercury, Kurt Cobain, Jay-Z, Axl Rose, Jimi Hendrix & more.  There's also a fishy wooden particle board elephant above the fireplace - yeah, you read that right! 

Follow confections on social media to find out about deals of the day and upcoming kid, family, or adult classes - cakes and macarons!

Confections is a fabulous addition to the St. Albert sweets scene! 

See ya soon Confections, sweet you soon!
Haven't been back here since covid started but whenever I do go, I enjoy it a lot. They have amazing food and great portions. Service is fantastic as well!

Amazing service and delicious sushi and miso soup! 

I crave Sushi Park all the time.  Their salmon sashimi is out of this world fresh! I also absolutely love their scallop nigiri. Hands down my go-to sushi place north of the N Sask River.

The epitome of luxury in St. Albert. Each time I've been here the food has been perfectly prepared, absolutely delicious, and the service is phenomenal. I cannot recommend the Riverbank enough for a special night out, and my fiance and I can't wait to try brunch one day!

I was sadly disappointed in my inaugural visit to a restaurant I had heard good things about.  At just over $100 (including tip), the only dishes I enjoyed were salads - good dressings on both.  However, the rolls were just so-so, and the childrens meals were appalling - a tiny amount of meat and a ton of bean sprouts.  I really doubt many children want a whole plate of bean sprouts and cannot imagine why that's the offering for them - unless it's just because they are inexpensive and take no time for preparation.  But they were costly for a child's plate and I felt rather gipped, to be honest.  I would not return here under any circumstances.

Always love the food and service at Sushi Park. I almost didn't post a review because I would like to keep it all for myself. After some reflection however I realized that wouldn't be fair. Make sure you try Sushi Park I. St Albert.  Just leave a table for me.

This is by far the best sushi place I have ever eaten at.  I don't even like sushi, but I absolutely love the tuna sashimi and my husband has loved every type of sushi he has tried there thus far.  The only complaint I would give this place is that the restaurant is not big enough.  It is always packed. I suppose that really isn't much of an issue with the whole social distancing in place at the moment now....
I've eaten here as a special treat for anniversary. Lovely food and staff. Would recommend.
Great food, delicious chicken and stuffing. Dessert the lemon pie was . Will eat here again or do delivery next time.

I called in at 10 am to ask if they had space to re-repair a tire they had repaired a couple of weeks ago. Was told to bring it in right away and they would get me in.  2 hours later, still sitting and waiting to get in. If it wasn't them needing to fix their own repair, I would leave and not come back

i also asked about winter tires and the counter person was not very good at explaining options to me. Perhaps some training for these folks would help

I'm majorly overdue in giving this place a well deserved 5 star review! The quality of the food and service here is EXCELLENT! 

One thing I noticed that they don't have set bento box meals. Sometimes these are an easy default choice if you're not sure what to order. But often times bento box meals can be kind of boring. 

At Sushi Park there's a wide variety of delicious options for you to choose from. 

My favorite dishes here include but are not limited to the following:

1) Seafood salad. This dish is definitely for those who are fans of raw seafood (different types of raw fish) and don't get queasy when they see things like pieces of octopus tentacles. So good!

2) The toro (tuna belly) and the chopped scallop sushi. Fresh and delicious!

3) Chicken karaage. These crunchy chicken pieces are small and served on a bed of greens. Yummy!

4) Prawn tempura. Hot, crunchy, tasty and not too oily. 

I haven't met a dish I didn't like here. Even the ones I wasn't expecting to eat! A couple times I've been here, the chef has given a special dish on the house. All of these have been absolutely yummy! It's so fun and exciting to taste these surprise dishes! 

I definitely recommend coming here to eat!
Chris is the owner. He makes tasty and fresh sushi, however the parking space is behind the restaurant and limited. Otherwise everything is wonderful.

Amazing sushi! Always so fresh and flavorful! Staff is quick and pleasant. It's not a big place, so it does get busy sometimes. They are always fast though. I really like the Hot Night Roll. The yakisoba is so delicious if you don't want sushi. Great find in St Albert area.

Being in St. Albert, we don't have many real sushi options, which is unfortunate because my husband and I love sushi! We were craving Sushi one night, and a friend recommended this place! Don't be discouraged by the hole-in-the-wall appearance and location of this restaurant! 

This place is incredible! The food is delicious, and actually tastes like quality seafood, and the servers know what they are talking about when they are describing their food. We ordered a few different things to try, and were also served little small bites created by the chef at the beginning of our meal.

This location also has a patio for the couple of warm months we have!

This is a delightful little place in downtown St. Albert. For some weird reason, all the restaurants in the immediate area seem to close at 8pm but this little gem stays open until 10pm. Nice decor inside and the couple working (maybe a couple?) were very friendly and inviting. We learned that they have live music every few weeks, baking classes and they do custom cakes. We had a coffee and cake (I think it was just called 'fruit'). It was a white cake with some berries, vanilla buttercream and the most delicious icing that melted in my mouth. Nice atmosphere and great for a date night. We look forward to returning and trying more delicious deserts. Keep up the good work!

Every time I order, the food is immaculate. I love it. My favourite is definitely the volcano!! The staff are so friendly, when I walk in I'm always greeted, and when leaving every staff member says good bye. I appreciate this sushi restaurant out of all the ones I've ever been too. I will continue to support them.

I'm a huge lover of sushi and it is hard to find consistently good sushi in this city.   So I was very excited to get to check out Sushi Park after hearing some good reviews.

It is a small restaurant so if you are planning to go with a group of 5-6,  I would recommend calling a few days ahead to reserve a table.  I was very happy that they were able to do this for me since we had 5 of us going.  But I do love the welcoming feel of the place.  Side note, the bathrooms are very clean here.....my belief, a clean and well kept bathroom equals the same for the kitchen haha.

One thing I didn't see on the menu are those big orders where they offer a variety of sushi's (like those that come in those trays shaped like a boat), as my cousin and I wanted to share and try a bunch of different kinds.  We ended up ordering Night Rolls, Dragon Rolls, Rainbow and assorted sashimi.  All came out in a nice presentation and the rice was made just right (had some at other places where they either don't use the proper rice or make it where it falls apart).  My favorite was the Night Rolls, as i do like my spicy food.  I will definitely get that again.  Was also nice of them to bring out some complimentary salads before our meals.

The total for 4 dishes plus 2 beers was about $72, so adding gratuity, that is about average cost for going out for a good meal.  Service was good and they are very friendly here.  They don't have a huge selection of alcohol here (just Kokonee for domestic and a few Japanese beers and of course Sake), but that's OK, you come here for the sushi any ways.  

This place is definitely on my top 3 of sushi places now to go for my sushi fix and will be back to try other things on the menu in the future.

Second time eating at this amazing Bistro. The first time was great and the second time was just as amazing.  Wonderful atmosphere and staff.  Such a warm and welcoming venue.  The food is out of this world and down to earth.  The avocado bruschetta is my ultimate favourite appetizer.  We also tried the crispy cauliflower and it lives up to its name (crispy capers elevate this dish so much). When you are at a place like this you have to order a bottle of wine, and so we did. Great selection.  Our entrees were all delicious. Absolutely beautiful presentation and the staff are able to explain all the ingredients and make great recommendations.  My favourite dessert has to be the homemade key lime pie, close second was the berry crisp.  On an evening like tonight with temperatures below 25 the berry crisp warms you up.  

The chef came out to visit the tables which was a nice perk.  We will be returning here many more times.  Great way to spend an evening with friends and enjoy the most amazing food.

So loved eating here celebrating back home. Tried new dish mushy peas, loved the fish and chips, of course . Brought home some treats from their store, partridge berry jam, donair kits, and chicken haddie. Just a fun place with fun people.

3.5 - It's better than "a-ok", but short of "I'm a fan" (yelp, get a grip, and allow half marks).

The pub is tucked away in a little strip mall in Akinsdale. As this was my first trip, I was surprised at how spacious it is for its location, although almost half the space is taken up with the stage and dance floor leaving a limited amount of seating. The decor is rustic.

The bar staff were friendly. I didn't try any of the food, but I did look at the menu. It's your basic burger, fries, and wings menu that has only one vegetarian option (besides the fries): a "veggie" burger (the contents weren't listed). I doubt it is vegan (that is, fries and burger are probably cooked in the same oil and on the same flattop).

They have live entertainment four nights a week, which is awesome! The band last night was Train Wreck and they were very good!

The crowd was middle aged. This did not strike me as a place for young people. As I'm entering that older age group, I wasn't bothered.

I'm definitely going back. I liked it, but I will try another night....to see if the crowd changes. I'll let you know.

How can you not LOVE this place? It's a one stop shop! The staff are very friendly and helpful. I have done yoga here and also have had a massage....The change rooms, bathrooms, and service rooms are clean and beautiful and there is a very welcoming, homey feel the moment you walk into the spa. The yoga teachers are fabulous and the space is unique in that the rooms are in a half-sun shape rather than the plain old rectangle/square so you feel more part of the action. The clothes and other goods for sale are quite reasonably priced and very nice. Being here also gives you an excuse to check out the rest of the Enjoy Centre which is also very nice....So far, I have had nothing but good experiences here! :)

We had a meal at the St Albert location on Saturday evening. It was moderately busy and the service was good, efficient and friendly. The server was at our table within 5 minutes of arriving and we had our meal within 20 minutes of ordering. I had the fish and chips (cod). It was served hot but no better than average flavour. (I may have been spoiled forever by the delicious lightly fried cod I had several times during our trip to Newfoundland.) Hubby had the veal. Again average flavour and the veggies were over cooked and must have been served on a cold plate as they were only lukewarm halfway through his meal. A plus for the fries which were served hot and were not greasy. The restaurant is clean but could use a bit more room between the middle tables and those on the perimeter. The cutlery is wrapped in a very small napkin. A larger, better quality product would be appreciated. The confectionary with numerous products popular in the Maritimes is an interesting touch.

I knew I had a manifold leak and asked them to look for it. They spent 90 min and didn't find it. The fact that it was a hairline crack made it hard to locate. I had to take it to two other shops to figure out the location of the leak. 

It doesn't matter to me that Midas couldn't find the problem; to be fair, it was really really hard to locate. What really counts is that they told me they couldn't find it. I got a no-bullshit straight-forward answer and they didn't charge me for any of their time. I returned the favour by dropping off a case of beer for the boys in the shop. People are people, don't be a jerk and they'll treat you with respect.

I love this place. The owners are local and care about their customers. The therapists are all wonderful and take great care of their clients. The receptionists especially are just fabulous! Check out this beautiful space and see for yourself!

I came in on a Tuesday morning to get an oil change done, everything was great until it came time to pay.

My mom called to pay and said she was in the vehicle so she couldn't send them an email of her drivers license. The gentleman working there felt the NEED to start a conversation in the store with all 3 customers about how my mother shouldn't be talking on the phone while driving, and how she's dangerously driving. She was talking in a vehicle, not while driving..

 How unprofessional. Won't be returning.

Neighborhood pub with an excellent stage.  4 tv screens.   Pretty basic menu.  They have live music 4 days a week.  A dance floor.  A few slot machines. A pool table. Hot wings are home made sauce so beware!
They know their s**t, I wouldn't hesitate going here for a domestic car. They had no trouble getting to the battery to replace it, something that threw off the likes of Canadian Tire and Wal-Mart.
Great place for a typical Maritime fish and chip.  Light, golden batter and perfectly cooked fish.  We had the haddock and split a two piece, plenty of food

In one week we had two car break downs - Ugh... OMG!  The second one sounded like brake problems... My husband called around first thing in the morning and found that they would be able to help us today.  My husband HATES dealing with service people and despises calling them.  Anyway, after I had gotten to work I called to check on how it was going at Midas and my husband was "impressed" with the way they treated him and made him feel like it was a priority to get our brakes fixed the same day even though we had only called them that morning.

My husband called me to bring him home from Midas... so I darted out of work and picked him up.  About an hour later, I got a phone call that my husband had left the wrong keys at Midas and they couldn't get into the car... Oh my... what else was going to happen?  So I went back and took the keys to Midas on my lunch break.  This put them a few hours behind and they were understandably unable to have the brakes repaired prior to my husband going to work in the afternoon.

They called and gave my husband an update during the day and in the evening I swang by to pay the bill as my husband was still at work.  They were polite and courteous.  I had printed a coupon off that I had found online and upon presenting it they advised me that they had already applied the current discount - I really appreciate that kind of customer service.

I would highly recommend them to anyone looking to get their brakes repaired!

What a comical day - and of course an expensive one - but Midas made it a little more bearable.

*BONUS* Midas guarantees the brakes for life - if they wear out all you have to do is pay for the new brake pads and the service of installing/repairing is free!  Pretty cool!

Starter Caesar salad overdressed too many croutons very disappointing.
Fish and chips fish was way too thick batter so much oil yuck soggy yuck!!
Expected much more under delivered would not recommend,Sir Winston's top shelf on point.

Moving from Rhode Island USA to Alaska, had to stop by this location to ensure the vehicle could make it through Canada.  The people of Midas got be out of there in 45 minutes and provided me multiple options for fixes to the cars alignment. Trustworthy, efficient, and dedicated to customer service, would choose this location over all others in the area if you want a fair deal to the problems with your vehicle, this definitely restores my faith in the mechanic.

I went to get a pedicure at this spa. There were not many options for nail color...most of the colours on the sample swatch colors they gave me were marked with an X because they they didn't have the colors. The tech left the room and never came back after the top coat was added. she never mentioned a thing before she left. Just left the room. I decided after a little while that my nails were dry enough and made my way to the front.  The receptionist didn't seem to be happy...she said she wasn't trained on gift card entering (which is what I was paying with). I expected a better experience for the price.

Good service, good food. 

The only issue I have with this establishment is the price of the deep fried pickles. It's $10 for 5 pickles, which is kind of outrageous (I think).

Other restaurants are usually 8 or so.

Good food and loved the Newfie store items. I was really hoping to find crab on the menu however. 

Excellent flavouring on veggies as I am not a fan, but I ate mine all up. We split dessert and it was fresh and good! 

Our waitress wasn't the friendliest or most attentive, but others chipped in to help so felt we were attended to.

I love the massages with Mary she is good plus front staff are nice when i walk in they offer water before my appt.
Place is clean but the price is high as i looked at a pl today 90 mins is $100 so they need to bring them down

Friendly Service and Honest Dealings

34 Muir Dr, St. Albert, AB T8N 1G3

Dean Edmonton reviewed Dec 15, 2012

Quality Excellent

Had my car towed to St Albert Midas and dealt with James. They took it in the same day despite no appointment and they were busy. It needed a complete brake job all round, the rears were leaking fluid so likely what caused the rear tire to lock up.I looked over the old parts, definitely needed doing. Price charged was fair and reasonable for the work done, far less than a dealer would charge and on par with their competitiors. Their shop rate of $120 an hour is getting pretty steep, on par with even the Lexus dealer, but the overall price was better none the less. 

They did a full inspection while they had the car and despite the car having over 300,000 Klms they didn't try yo SELL me anything more. All the other items passed fine, as I knew they should.

I also saw how they dealt with and treated other clients while I waited to pick up my car. Straight up, honest and full disclosure even with a couple of clients who would have been easy to take. Actually told one he didn't need to spend as much as he though, could be done for far less. 

Nice to find an honest repair shop right off the bat, when you are new to town.

Just saw The Ramifications at LBs and they were fantastic!  LBs is a great venue to see a live band, get up and dance or just play pool.  

The service is friendly and the ladies always ensure your drinks are never empty.  Only downside is the food.  The nachos need more cheese and fixings and the wings need to be less cooked.  

We are planning another trip to LBs to see another band, so I would thoroughly recommend LBs for the music!
Good food. Authentic cuisine from the east coast. Good service. Friendly servers with a smile. Nice little east coast food and souvenir shop too.

wanted something different for my birthday and my sis suggested this place. so glad she did!  i love seafood and this place didn't disappoint. you must try pineapple crush and lime crush!  i had crab bits to start delish!  then seafood platter with deep fried scallops shrimp and a cod. a little bit of everything for $20!  then the mound of fresh potato cut fries!  huge portions! great east coast authentic place brought to western canada. great job. we will be back!

Went there with a friend for a massage and facial. While I had the massage my friend was having her first facial ever. Then in between treatments we meet in the relaxation room. I asked her how her facial was? She was impartial about it. She went on to tell me the esthetician left her alone in the room for what felt like a long time. Having been a esthetician myself I was shocked and told her that was not right. So when it was time for my facial I couldn't believe when I was left alone. I looked at the time and proceeded to wonder how long I would be left to lay there? 20 MINUTES!!!!! When she returned I was over it and let her know I just wanted to leave. I did not pay to lay with a mask on my face alone in a room I can do that at home. Plus my friend who was left alone was having her first facial, so what if she had a adverse reaction? She laid there wondering what is going on? But can you imagine if the esthetician was, ok see you in 20 MINUTES. SO IF YOUR LOOKING FOR A FACIAL WHERE YOU ARE NOT LEFT ALONE DONT GO HERE!!!!  Having been a esthetician and had many treatments at spas while you are masking the professional should be working on you messaging something unless it's a clinical treatment. I don't usually do YELP reviews but I was left speechless. Plus the esthetician did not even analyze our skin. She just asked both of us what our concerns were. I know mine because I know my skin type and used to work with EMINENCE but my friend is not a trained professional. So why is the professional going off what she says then leaving the room to get the necessary products and returning to start the treatment without once looking at her skin or even feeling it??? What are we paying for? Plus my friend thought she had oily skin and I let her her know that she does not. 
I must say though the massage we had by the therapist was wonderful. She had a great touch and it was very relaxing. I believe her name is Kimberly. She was great. The atmosphere was nice and relaxing. Too bad it was ruined by bad protocol for the FACIAL.

Friends from Newfie rejoice.. if you havent heard of The Atlantic Kitchen, then it's time for you to head out to either St Albert or Fort Sask to nosh on some killer fries, poutine, fried fish tongue and more! So much fried goodness... even fried pepperoni! And they carry rum tea and other tasties from out east. Dont miss the golden ginger ale that they ship over just for the holiday season! Friendly staff and family friendly is always a bonus!

I had the opportunity to visit Wellness Within several times this week during their fall schedule preview.

It is located in the lower level of the Enjoy Centre next to Amaranyth grocery store. 

The location is beautiful - stunning really!  I have shopped the upstairs many times as a gardening enthusiast but this past week was my first visit to the Wellness Within portion.

There are 2 yoga rooms - a sky room and earth room.

The sky room is a glorious round room surrounded by beautiful silks that remind  me of saris and sky lights above and a large window overlooking a field.

There are no mirrors in the room and the instructors encouraged us to focus on listening to our bodies.

The room is stocked with extra yoga mats, straps, blankets, yoga blocks, and foam squares (for sitting, etc.).  I've been to quite a few yoga studios and never seen one with this many accessories easily available - very inviting and welcoming.

There was also a complementary tea bar with several selections.

The washrooms and change rooms were spacious and beautiful.  

The Wellness Within offers other spa services and has a small boutique with earth friendly makeup and clothing.

As far as Yoga goes, this place is awesome!  The instructors I had were friendly, knowledgeable, and encouraging.

The current schedule offers many variations of Yoga including Hatha, Prenatal, Pramika, Sunrise, Kid's, Slow & Strong Flow, Deep Flow, Power Jam, Relax & Renew, Vinyasa, Akhandra, Nidra, Yin & Yang, and Therapeutic.  

They offer drop in classes, punch cards ranging from $17 to $11 a class as well as reasonable monthly unlimited memberships.  

My review is based upon the Yoga portion of Wellness Within - but the store looks absolutely beautiful as well!

I am so happy to finally have a place like The Atlantic Kitchen in St. Albert!
First impression - PACKED! It was so busy that my mom and I had to park in a different parking lot altogether. We lucked out, however, as 2 tables were being cleared right as we walked in. 
We seated ourselves by the window (a bit chilly on a cold day - I had to put my jacket back on) and enjoyed the view as well as the privacy being in the corner allowed us to have. The decor is simple and quaint (love the blue lights) and fun east-coast music plays all the time. 
We started with mussels in white wine sauce. No side plates were offered with the appetizer, which made for a messy start. We definitely devoured them still and absolutely had to keep the white wine sauce with us to add to our entrees (the staff kept trying to clear it off our table, though.)
Our entrees arrived fairly quickly after we finished the mussels. My mom's salmon was "okay" - nothing spectacular. She did, however, love her baked potato and vegetables.
I ordered the clam strips (also just "okay" and needed way more seafood sauce on the side) and the mashed potatoes with veggies.
Overall the meals were good, but the price tag is a bit high. The food is by no means fancy and seems easy to replicate at home, but in a way that homemade flair adds to the charm of The Atlantic Kitchen.

Gillian is amazing.  A real gem.  She knows how to keep it interesting.  Yoga can be boring and repetitive with the wrong instructor. Plus she is knowledgeable in both yoga and the science of the body.  Perfect combo.
You can tell she enjoys and is interested in what she does.  The studio is very comfortable.  We weren't happy with the downsize in space, but Gillian keeps us coming back.

Went a couple nights ago. Food was really good, fish was cooked perfectly and the tartar sauce is amazing! Fries are your true coastal fries of real potatoes (not the normal kind around here). Only reason it doesn't get 5 stars is because the pop is a pop can and a cup with ice, although that does allow them to serve both coke and Pepsi drinks. Altogether will definitely be going here again.
Very nice facility, supplies and ambiance.  Yoga instructor was excellent.  A nice treat to have tea available, and ceramic cup and could even bring tea into yoga room!

I'm really surprised that this place doesn't have any reviews on them thus far!

I've admired a girlfriend's gel nails for quite some time now, and after deciding I was going to go back to having gels I asked her where she went.  I called Gelous Nails to get an appointment, and due to them being SO busy, I was able to get in two weeks from when I called.

The staff are super friendly and accommodating.  They do a ton of different art designs and decals for your nails. They also have a hair salon (which I haven't tried).  The nail techs really take their time with your nails and do a beautiful job - they also have an instagram page - it looks like a lot of women come in with pics from pinterest and get them done up here :)

The only downfall is that they are SO busy all the time, it's hard to get an appointment.  So when you do, book your next fill before you leave.  

I've had a ton of complements on my nails and can't wait to go back to try another fun design :)
So relaxing. Had a relax body scrub and wrap and hot stone massage. The massage was the best one I have ever had and the wrap made my skin super soft. Defiantly recommend!

I just can't say enough things about this Midas location.  This review is an update to my original one posted in 2011 (also 5 stars).

Over the past 4 years, my husband and I had to bring our dying Ford Focus here more times than I'd like to recount before it finally bit the dust two weeks ago.

What I appreciate most about this Midas location is that they never made us feel stupid for not being "car" people, always took the time to explain and/or physically show us what needed to be done on the car, and always returned telephone calls promptly.  Additionally, they gave us options and explanations of what needed to be done ASAP or what could wait.  

What more could you ask for from a local repair shop?  We probably won't be back to this location for awhile as we've bitten the bullet and purchased a new vehicle that will be under warranty for some time now but we will most definitely continue to recommend and refer our friends and family to this Midas location.  

Two thumbs WAY up!

So we tried this place the other day, and I have to say- they served me the best fish and chips I've had in a loooong time. It was fairly steady when we arrived (of course, lunch time on Black Friday) but we still found the service a little on the slow side. Nonetheless, the decor was charming, the menu was varied, and all-in-all the atmosphere was very relaxed and cozy. We decided to order two different meals and share the dishes between us. A 2-piece fish and chips (cod) and the fish burger. Both meals were delicious, but my favorite was the fish and chips. Huge pieces of fish perfectly cooked, moist and flaky inside. The batter wasn't too heavy and cooked golden brown- a little on the oily side, but not enough to make a negative impact on me. The coleslaw was okay and the fries were good, but would not have been very good re-heated. 

We will definitely return to The Atlantic Kitchen, but probably not on a regular basis. The price isn't the best, but it isn't the worst either. Next time I'm looking for some fish and chips, this is where you'll find me.

This bar is a nice little gem in St. Albert I came across with some friends one night. It has a wholesome atmosphere to it and our service was very friendly!

I can vouch for the fries here: they're full bodied, golden and cooked nicely which makes them awesome! The wings are also pretty good and super cheap when you come in for the 50% deal on Wing Wednesday. Definitely check this place out if you're in the area!

My girlfriend and I went for pedicures while she was down visiting. She chose to come back to Gelous after we had such a fantastic pedicure there a year ago. WOW. What an awful experience we had this time around though. Started off with the one esthetician Caitlin talking non stop about herself.... the ENTIRE pedicure. Even when I tried ignoring her and chatting with my friend she just kept talking. To  the point where my friend just closed her eyes and the other esthetician just sat there quietly with this uncomfortable look on her face. Even when I stopped answering Caitlin just kept talking. Then when it came time to polish, she only had 10 colours to choose from, about 5 of those where different shades of red. So I chose a red and it looks like a child painted my toes. Some nails are not completely painted, some parts cheeky only got one coat and then the top coat that was used made the polish look dull, somewhere in between shinny and matte. 

Now for my friends experience. Everything was going great for her. Her esthetician's name started with an M (hard to pronounce and spell) during the pedicure and when leaving my friends only complaint was that the lotion for her feet was forgotten. But that's no big deal. She had these beautiful French tip gel toes. Now fast forward a day. My friend has a shower and the gel 'melts off' so her classy French tip pedicure is just a gooey mess. And she's headed home (7 hours) and cannot go get them fixed. 

So for $180-$200 total pedicures is absolutely ridiculous. We will not be coming back and wouldn't even talk the option to have this fixed. I totally understand that you pay a price for good clean service but this was far from that. What a waste of money and time.

I am giving a 1 star rating for quality vs cost. We had the cod and chips with gravy. There was nothing spectacular about the meal. The fries were a little over done and the fish was average. But with a $46 (for two meals) price tag it was definitely not worth it. I won't be back and wouldn't recommend it.
Just tried it in St Albert. Delicious and a ton of food. Will go back but maybe only order a 1 piece meal. Couldn't finish the two piece.

Being from Newfoundland, I was excited to hear of a place that might be able to deliver amazing "Newfie" style fish & chips. Sadly, we were very disappointed with our meal. 
We started with the calamari, while it tasted good the portion was very small for the $9 price. 
We both had the cod fish & chips. The fish was tasteless and the coleslaw was inedible. 
We mentioned the coleslaw to the waitress but we were not offered any kind of compensation. 
$17 for a 2-piece cod & chips and goes up from there for other types of fish. 
On a positive note, they have many Newfoundland products for sale.

I had been to Wellness Within when they were still in their west end location for massages so I thought I would try the spa at their new location. I wish I had made a different choice. The receptionist was very friendly and greeted me right away and the lady doing my pedicure came out and also greeted me right away which was a nice change. While she was filing my nails, I got a sharp pain in two of my toes and they stung pretty bad during the rest of the service. When I got home, I found that I had two rather large cuts on the tips of my big toe and toe right beside it. I had to bandage my very red and swollen toes for 3 days for three days before I could get my shoes on without them hurting. Thank goodness for polysporin so that they didn't get infected. I work a desk job so I sit at a desk all day and don't do any sports. I got my pedicure on Saturday morning and by Tuesday morning, 90% of the nail polish was gone off of one of my feet and every toe on my other foot was already chipped. I contacted the spa with concerns about my nail polish coming off so fast and to mention the cuts on my toes. That was a few days ago and I stil haven't received a response. For the price you pay for a pedicure, I'd expect the nailpolish to stay on longer (it usually lasts a couple months when I get other pedicures done elsewhere) or at least for the spa to call/email you back when you have concerns. Despite that the leg massage that I received was wonderful, I will never return to this spa and will not be recommending it to any of my friends. They obviously do not take e]client concerns seriously and I can go elsewhere and pay the same price and get way better service.

What a busy place! The wait staff were superb, so friendly and prompt. We had the muscles to start and they where fresh, cooked perfectly and so flavourful. We followed with cod fish and chips and the crab cakes. Amazing! I will be coming back and visiting Fort Sasks too!

A solid 3 stars.  Nothing wrong with that.

St. Albert is thrilled to have another fish & chip joint in town.  And they go far beyond that too, with lots of east coast offerings.

The set up is a little strange though.  You seat yourself, but as far as I can tell, they are always busy.  So you just kind of stand in a group at the door and wait for a table to become available.  Which was a little uncomfortable, but gave me a chance to awkwardly look at other people's food so I could decide what I wanted lol  There is a bit of space at the door, so I'm hoping that they are going to put in a hostess station eventually.
