Once a table opened up, we sat down and ordered as quickly as we could since it was obvious that other tables were waiting a long time.  The wait was almost excruciating.  And there was no music playing.  I'm guessing there was something wrong because every 15 minutes or so, a song would start and play for a minute or so, then it was gone again.  It made for a long, quiet wait.  Aside from the music issue, the atmosphere was good.  They have fit as many tables in as they could, without making it too crowded.  The servers were all really friendly.

They have a small selection of beer and wine on tap, as well as various pops (all in cans).  Along with the standard sodas, they also had a few extra Crush flavours that I think you can typically only get on the East Coast, or in specialty stores.

The menu was vast.  Loads to choose from.  We both went with the Cod and Chips, but I upgraded my side to the "newfie mess" poutine.  Which is the traditional gravy and cheese curds, along with ground beef and dressing.  It was okay, but I don't think I'll order it again.  Definitely not worth the $9.00 upcharge, even though you do get quite a bit of it.

The fish was flaky and the batter was crispy.  I can't say it was the best fish and chips that I've ever had, but it was good.  The fries were quite obviously hand cut (and if not, they faked it really well!)

Relaxing environment with an east coast feel because of the music in the background. I was disappointed in the flavour of the dressing (Newfoundland style which is breacrumbs, savoury and other spices).  The grilled cheese was also the smallest one I've ever had at a restaurant, definitely not worth spending $10 on. We did have great service and the waitress was very patient with our large party.
The staff was friendly and attentive and the Fish was cooked to perfection and homemade fry's Yummy!   The price was very reasonable and we will definitely be back
First time for Fish and Chips In ages.  Everything is hot and fresh.   Staff super friendly.  Home home made chips, and the fish batter is great.   Thank you Maritimers.

Long story short, I brought my car in because it was smelling hot.  They took me in that day, looked at my car, phoned me back, and proceeded to gently inform me that I had put too much oil in my car.  Embarrassed, I walked into their shop, they told me the fine details of the problem, and how they fixed it completely free of charge.  

Thank you Jason and crew for always being there and not charging me for my stupidity.

I will recommend Midas, St. Albert, to anybody who needs work done on their vehicle.  They can sit and read the paper while they wait, the coffee is always on.

Have been to this restaurant 3 times now. Friendly service, homecooked food and lots of it. They even serve Pie for desert. This place is REALLY busy for supper most nights and lined up out the door on weekends. Make a great Clam Choder, soups are all homemade, home made fresh cut fires, liver and onions done just right and NOT breaded. Good selection of Gluten friendly dishes, including will do fish un-breaded and pan fried so no cross contamination.

They also have a good selection of Newfie type foods and doodads for sale so you can stock up on stuff you can't easily find here.

Very gross, got the crab bites to start and didn't even taste like crab, tasted like nothing, then I got the shrimp and cod with rice and veggies. The best part of that was veggies and they didn't even taste good. Rice was gross and the fish was alright not the best! Aswell my mom got the Haddock and she said it was alright but was deed fried which made it worse. Don't think We will ever go back.

Unlike, other reviewers, I found the front desk reception staff very professional, polite and accommodating.

I have had generally good experiences with services I have received but what keeps me returning is I have been fortunate to find regular massage therapists that are a good fit.  I was about to abandon going to Wellness Within because my regular therapist had left (this has happened a couple times before).  I had a number of appointments that needed to be reassigned as a result and was tempted to simply go elsewhere.  Fortunately, before I did so, I decided to book with Caitlin.  She is a relatively new therapist but is solid.  I enjoy the relaxed environment Caitlin provides through her pleasant demeanour and a "lightness" she exudes that makes my session with her that much better.  I highly recommend others take advantage of her massage services.


5 stars for Caitlin and the reception staff.  A reduction of one star for  some other matters I will not elaborate on in detail at this time.

First visit, excellent fish and chips!I ordered the 2 piece halibut which was delicious with a light golden batter. The chips tasted homemade like the ones made from fresh potatoes. Good sized portions. Barbara, our server was pleasant and efficient. Will definitely be back!
Horrible place to eat. Cheap fish and limited selection. May as well go to McDonald's and get a fish sandwich.

The place was nice and clean. We ordered take out through skip the dishes. I was so excited because i havent had great fish and chips for a while so I went all out and ordered Halibut. The presentation wAs promising but when i had a bite of the fish, it was extremely dry. Chewy. I always go for halibut because i find that haddock is dry and stiff so, i am disappointed to have my halibut taste worse than haddock. We also ordered veal and that was good. The clams were ok. Maybe this is a one off... i'll have to try them again sometime.

Although the service was  great, sadly the food was not. Battered scallops were overdone, expensive for the portion, and tasteless. Same for our main courses. The fish and chips looked good but the batter was really bland, fish dry. The Hot roast beef sandwich was just okay with a side of soggy vegetables. We won't return.

I have not been to this location for a sit down meal yet but i have taken meals to enjoy at home. 
The portions are generous, the fish is fresh, flaky and the batter is perfect. 
Even on a busy Friday night, the waiting time was not bad. 

I look forward to our next meal there.

I personally like it better when my mussels aren't completely dried out on the top with the ones under the sauce the only moist ones. Also I like it when they have reached maturity and are full grown, and not dime sized.
Evan was very professional and knew his stuff. I've been coming here for 2 years and this was my first session with Evan, he will be my go to guy moving forward.

I recently had the opportunity to visit Wellness Within for a facial. I booked in for their signature facial, never having had one before. The girl I had perform the facial was amazing. She took the time to really figure out what products to use for my skin type and asked me lots of questions. I did t really know what to expect but she made sure to answer all my questions. The massage was great! My daughter and I will be back for pedicures. 
The spa was clean, inviting and all the staff seemed very friendly. I also didn't feel pressured to buy product after my facial like I was warned about from friends who have had facials at other places. 
I picked up a service menu on my way out and prices seem a little expensive but for the location and type of spa it is, maybe they're completely normal.

Well against my better judgment. My better half and myself decided to try this restaurant. My first impression after almost having my car hit by a half breed out port loser, you cut me off to steal my parking stall, was too get away from half breed losers whose parents are first cousins. After entering this place we found the same losing attitude from the staff and customers. We ordered the fish and chips. the fish was doughy and I firmly believe that the fish was a cheaper Pacific cod cut. GROSS. The fries were under cooked and slightly soggy. The gravey was luke warm and lumpy, just like my Nana used to make. My friend born and raised in small town Newfoundland was ashamed by her fellow newfies and told me that newfies are not like these ignorant backwards half breeds. So if you want to see the  real slimy under belly of what Newfies really are, just go have a meal at the Atlantic Kitchen, you will not be disappointed. If you want to have a real fish and chips meal, go to Brits on the south side. Far better food and attitude

I've been coming here for massages for the last 2 years.  I'm very happy with my masseuse Shauna and the staff at the counter checking me in.  

The massage rooms are cozy and relaxing and clean.  I also like the clothing that is sold here.  They also offer jewelry, lotions, oils, yoga equipment and clothes.  

Some morning the bakery bread makes the lobby of Wellness Within smell like fresh baked bread too.  You can always wander into the Enjoy Centre from Wellness and explore the rest of the place.

If you are going on a Friday or Saturday night, GO EARLY. We were a table of 3 and a half (my 2 year old is the half); took us about 7-10 minutes before a table cleared so we could take it.

Parking lot was flooded in about a foot and a bit of water but the medical building next door had an empty lot by about 5pm so that's ok. 

*YOU SEAT YOURSELF* (critical to know this before going in). There are high chairs available and colouring sheets available as well (and the kids menu was really quite versatile as my kiddo prefers hotdogs over anything else on the planet; also their seniors menu is for 60+ which is great).

The ambience is typical of a fish and chips place but I felt more at home with it cause of the East Coast feel (and merch at the back wall). 

Waitresses (although friendly) took a really long time to get to our table to take our order. 
It felt like no one was really in charge (and a bit disorganized) while waiting about 30-40 min for our food. 

Serving sizes were great. The fish and chips were more meaty than your average fish and chips which is also great and the batter was nice on it too. And food was nuclear hot when we got it (which is great). 
Pass on the coleslaw though (tasted super watery). 

Would've ordered dessert but because of the wait for the initial order and entree, couldn't wait any longer (we were there for over an hour).

Probably a weeknight kinda restaurant vs a weekend restaurant.

The front desk staff were very rude. Didn't even say greet me when I walked in the front door or just asked if I needed help with anything. Instead just barked at me that the rest of the building was closed till 10am. 

In no way would I pay for services from this place if the front desk staff can't be warm and welcoming.
A favourite go to for my family. Nice staff, east coast vibe and great fish and chips. Jiggs dinner. If you know what that is, go here for it. Best jiggs since your grandmas.

I first got gel nails just over 20 years ago and was hooked. However, there were years of trial and errors at various salons (and I was never satisfied with the quality of my fills). Eventually, I discovered Gelous Nails in St. Albert and have been a loyal customer for 10+ years since. I also get my pedicures done here too. Rhonda and her staff are top notch, from cleanliness to the latest nail trends and designs, you won't be disappointed. Bring in any idea you have and they are game! Fabulous salon. Book ahead because they are busy and for good reason; they're amazing at what they do. Highly recommend!

They have always done an absolutely fabulous job on my gel nails, sometimes it gets busy or hard to book in with your favorite tech, but you can book in with anyone and know your going to get a nice set! I've recieved gel nails, pedicures, lash extensions and a cut and colour from this business and have never once been disappointed!

I got my grad nails done here and I am very impressed with the job they did! I was a little pricy for the gel polish but I did add some sparkles and a different colour to my nails so that's why. In total it was about $42. Other than that it is a beautiful place and it seemed very clean.

I really wanted to like this place, the name really makes you feel like you will get a nice home cooked style of meal, the pleasant atmosphere and the seat yourself, and kind servers provided that, but the food we ordered did not convey the same note. My boyfriend and I came here and started with the calamari, it was a very small portion and overly fried and served with cocktail sauce. I had the mussels as a meal and there was hardly any sauce, very bland, and I had the clam chowder, which I'm sorry to say but I would of rather of ate a canned version, the soup had no flavour, definitely needed spices and salt. My boyfriend had the breaded cod and fries and enjoyed the fries, the cod was ok, and the coleslaw was nothing special, and I think that is what bothers me the most is just the lack of "special" in the meals. We have been to other fish and chip restaurants and this one falls behind. I liked that it had a little store aspect to it where you could buy seafood and spices and candy but unfortunately I would go to another restaurant while visiting St.Albert first.
Excellent massage service, friendly staff, easy to book online and change an appointment if needed. Email and text confirmations help ensure you never forget a booking.

I booked a pedicure with shellac polish and it was literally just my toe nails being shaped and painted and it cost over $60. Not too impressed. However the girl who did it was super nice and did a good job.
The worst fish and chips ever. Evolve some fucking taste buds and realize there are better places for any kind of food on the planet.

Yummy fish and chips and really friendly service. my favourite type of fries, could use a little more seasoning on the fries though so just ask for salt and pepper if getting it to go :) the tartar sauce was also really good. Fish was crunchy and fluffy, Will be going back for more!

I sat on this review for a while before writing it... letting my experience set in.  Overall, the experience was okay.  The staff at the front desk were friendly and the waiting area is nice.  The hallway leading back to where the services are performed is lovely.  Very calming and peaceful.

My issue comes in with my specific massage therapist.  I believe her name was Sarah.  She's talented, don't get me wrong, but some things she did were truly strange.  For instance, she squirted the lotion/oil directly onto my skin each time that she was reapplying.  It caused me to jump every time, which obviously took away from my relaxation.  She would also bump into my body parts, or the side of the table as she moved around.  

I've heard great things from other people about this place, so I'm sure I will return... but I will look for another massage therapist next time I book.
Such an excellent instructor (Roxanne) and excellent and relaxing studio !! Loved my restorative class and will be back again!

This is just a good, solid neighbourhood dive bar. Live music on weekends (always been cover bands when I stopped in but might be more), draft beer and good wings. Friendly staff, lots of regulars and all you would expect in a neighbourhood bar (pool table, juke box, etc). Most underrated wings in St. Albert too... Wednesday Wing Night is worth checking out. Agree with a previous reviewer that this is a true 3.5 star spot, nothing amazing but a fun spot...

I was given a gift card for my birthday. I have had pedicures in the past in the spa, but under a different company. I've always enjoyed the ambiance of the spa. Deven was wonderful, professional and accommodating to my last minute change for gel polish. I will be back again.

Came to Atlantic Kitchen with the family last night at about 630pm.  We waited for a good five minutes to be acknowledged by staff - admittedly they were slammed which is awesome but even a smile would have been welcomed.  There is no place to sit while waiting upon entering either. 

The atmosphere was bright and lively with Newfieesque music playing, lots of tables (no booth options here) and natural light. 

Upon being seated we waited another 15 minutes for water and to order.  They were out of my top choices of mussels, calamari, and onion rings (not house made). 

After another 45 minutes (restaurant 1/2 empty by now) we began to receive our food:

Bowl of Clam Chowder - $6.95 
Large and full of flavour.  It was more of a broth based soup and coming from the West Coast I think my preference leans towards cream based chowders.  

Kiddo Dino Nuggets (4) & fries - $6.95
Son gobbled up the fries and nuggets with a smile! 

Kiddo Grilled Cheese & Fries - $6.95
Daughter didn't care for the grilled cheese though I thought it was yummy!  Could be improved with cheese all the way to the crust rather than an 1" from the crust.  Daughter also gobbled up the fries! 

3 piece Haddock & Chips - $24.95
Hubby loved this! Nice large white firm flaked fish with the perfect batter 

3 piece Cod & Chips - $22.95
Gramma loved this, too!  Very similar to the Haddock but I'd say slightly less firm and more flaky. 

LARGE and tasty portions of fish and fries.  I could easily share a 3 piece with hubs and a side. 

And a table order of Mac 'n Cheese bites to share - $6.95.
Daughter loved these but they didn't wow me - tasted like processed cheese inside, almost Kraft Dinner like. 

The total bill was a dollar shy of $80 for 2 kiddo meals, 2 - 3 piece fish n chips, 1 Mac n cheese bite, and a bowl of chowder. 

I'd absolutely come back here when craving some fish 'n chips and Great Big Sea.  I'd split a 3 piece with hubs and order a side next time to keep the cost down. 

Their menu had several non Seafood items as well but when in Rome or in this case, NFLD! 

As a side, the vinegar bottles seemed to have a defect where they spilled all over and leaked out the sides even when we carefully checked that lids kids were screwed on tightly.

Even though it was enjoyable for me, my daughter Caitlin was with me and this was her 3rd time getting a massage and the girl that worked on her used only one hand throughout the whole massage. She was not pleased or impressed. I am not sure that I would come back.

Time to get stretchy St. Albert and friends! With the restrictions easing and in person classes opening up it was great to be able to get to Wellness Within for my first Hatha class in a long time. 

The studio was super clean, and they have personal washrooms/ change rooms to use. A lot of the things were cordon off like the bolsters ect but I am sure once able to do so these items will be able to use.  

The class was nice and felt very personal. They also offer spin classes and Barre so there is something for everyone but I haven't personally tried those out... yet.

Was not impressed small fish portions with large portion of soggy fries with coleslaw that seemed to be out of a commercial pale and as far as the establishment run down and outdated washrooms and very slow service not recommended art signed Red Lobster it's a lot better my opinion

We have been to the Atlantic Kitchen a few times now.  The fish and chips, with dressing and gravy is so good, although the last visit saw that the fish was pretty greasy.  Then again, its definitely not what you'd eat if you were dieting.  It was still delicious.  Nice that they have Newfie cold plate available for take out (or dine in) and Jiggs dinner, though I do think they are a bit steep in their pricing.  I know how much it costs to make a whole dinner. 
The staff is always pleasant though they tend to be short staffed during peak times, and the 'seat yourself' thing is kind of awkward.  If it is busy, you're left to stand at the door and wait.  No differentiation between the 'lobby' and the restaurant and no benches to wait on.  Would serve them better to have a hostess or a waiting area at least.  
The parking lot is difficult to access if you are travelling north on Hwy 2.  You have to circle back to get in, though that is through no fault of the restaurant.  The parking lot is also a bit of a disaster.
They have a very nice selection of Newfoundland treats and grocery items that you can't get in stores out here.  The decor is welcoming and the Newfoundland music is nice and not too loud. 
When we are looking for an nice, authentic, east coast meal.  This is the next best thing to cooking your own.

Lunch ends at 2 and we squeaked in at 1:30 on a weekday. Service was really friendly and our food came out quickly. I believe this was a pizza place and then a Chinese place, so the inside had red booths that have that sort of old school feel. It's very bright and clean though.

The Thai tea is good and not overly sweet - one of my biggest peeves. This one was just right, but had lots and lots of ice. 

We ordered three combos ($10.95 each) and added spring rolls and a soup. Everything came out at pretty much the same time. The soup had a lot of flavour but was lukewarm. There was one spear of broccoli, one mushroom and a lot of lemongrass. I'd probably skip this going forward. The spring rolls were hot and crispy, but a bit light on the filling. 

Our favourite was the lemongrass pad Thai. Very good texture, big portion and delicious flavour. The curry was creamy with a bit of heat and lots of pineapple and veg, but skimpy on protein. The stir fry was good, but nothing super exciting. Everything nailed it on flavour though, so I was very happy with that. We ended with the sticky rice and it was ok, but I like it better at other places where the rice wasn't as dry. 

Overall, we really liked it here. I would gladly come back and try more things - but I can't stop thinking about that pad Thai!!

The green curry is very fresh, flavourful and warming.
Try it with the chicken is my recommendation. Good service, clean restaurant and handy in downtown St. Albert!

Buster Bars:
1970's: 50% fudge.
1980's: 25% fudge.
1990's : 15% fudge.
2000's : 5% fudge.
Now: fudge practically non-existent...!
You guys may as well call it a dilly bar with 3 peanuts. You are ripping people off, destroying childhood memories and all in the name of corporate greed. You guys suck out loud and I hate you for it. I complained to corporate but they could care less..."Call consumer relations at 1-800-WE-DONT-CARE"....
Jam it, DQ.
They were closed at 8:33pm. There were people inside, but the doors were locked. This really sucks considering I just wanted some ice cream. But whatever. Guess I won't be returning ‍

I made reservations for 16 people. They had  set up the tables before we got there. Which was nice. We had 9 kids and 6 adults we all fit nicely in the tables provided. They gave us what seemed to be a newer waitress (which is fine everyone has to learn) she was friendly and tried her best. But when another birthday came  in she seemed to be less interested in us. When she brought out the pizza she sat one right in front of the youngest kid we had and said don't touch the pan it's very hot. Ummm not the best place to put the pizza when the rest of that table was adults. When we asked to pay for the food she asked us for our bill  which we never got. She came back 10-15 min later (keep in mind we had 9 kids with us waiting) with one out of the two bills. Then came back 5 min after that with the other bill. 
They supplied us with extra plates and plastic forks for our cake and a server to serve the cake we had brought with us. 
The pizza was good and it was a great price with the 5$ deal. Another issue was it was 4.99 a pitcher of pop. But the glasses they give the kids are about half of the pitcher per glass. And they don't offer refills for the pitchers. So we had to either order glasses around 3$ each so they could have refills or 5$ a pitcher for one glass a kid. Not overly impressed. Maybe it be better to offer a 2.50 refill price for the pitchers of pop. I have gave it 3 stars cause the pizza was good and arrived hot. The waitress was friendly but not great with big groups. We seemed to have a waste of stuff she gave way to many straws napkins and plastic forks.but I guess it's better then not enough. She also seemed overly nervous about serving a big crowd.
Have been back multiple times and it's been great every single time.  We've tried at least 20 different dishes and all have been great.
Great hotel and staff. Very clean. Great location. Breakfast is excellent. I would not stay anywhere else but BW in St. Albert.

I was not given a discount with my diamond membership. The room only had a shower, no bath tub. The TV  kept loosing signal and resetting to channel 1. The cheap desk chair had a weak back support ( not adjustable), I had to stick another chair between bed and back of office chair to support my back to prevent from falling backwards. Not impressed with this Best Western.

I will usually choose Best Western when traveling and as I needed a place to land for almost a week, and the location was perfect with the St Albert location (Best Western Inn At St Albert), it was my first choice. It was great! I was in a 1-bedroom suite so the bedroom was off the hallway with the living room, mini-kitchen and bathroom all between. This kept the noise down so much that it felt as though I was alone on my floor! Very quiet! I made use of the pool area a couple of times and while others came and went it wasn't overly crowded. I also used the treadmill in the fitness center which seemed to be well equipped. The breakfast buffet (included) served some hot selections every day and did have wonderful coffee available all day long. All in all, I would absolutely stay at this Best Western anytime I need to return to the area.

Wow, St. Albert is finally getting more ethnic and diversified in its restaurant options ('bout time). A new spot, Songkran Thai, opened in the spot that formerly housed SixnSeven (and apparently, this was a carwash back in the day). It's located right across the street from Sushi Park and The Cajun House.

First trip, we came on a Friday for lunch and HOLY CRAP, it was beyond busy. I couldn't believe how packed it was. We got there right at noon and didn't get our food till almost an hour later. Yikes.

The lunch combo is an incredibly good deal. There's 26 options and all are priced at $10.95. You can also add a spring rolls, soup, salad or fried egg for an extra $1.00.

Trip #1
- Red curry (C2) ($10.95) - curry was addictively good.
- Pineapple fried rice (41) ($10.95) - good amount of cashews and pineapple. Nice wok hei to it.
- Pad thai tom yam (L15) ($10.95) - I like how they served the lime and crushed peanuts separately - smart in case someone is allergic. Noodles were tasty with the tom yam coming through prominently.

Trip #2
We decided to give them a try at dinner. I met up with J and C on a Monday evening.

- Thai iced tea ($3.95) - I've ordered one every time that I've gone. Good.
- Gold bag (#10) ($6.00) - light and cripy but not much filling. Not as good as the ones at Million Thai.
- Spicy glass noodle salad (#14) ($13.95) - nice acidity. Didn't find it too spicy.
- Green curry (#26) ($14.95) - green curry was as good as the red one.
- Crab fried rice (#42) ($15.95) - this was fantastic. The crab was incredibly flavourful. I kept on going back for more.
- Lemon grass stir fry (#58) ($14.95) - we added beef to this dish. Lemongrass was very aromatic but this dish is pretty standard fare.
- Coconut rice (#61) ($7.00) - one portion size is $3.50 so we ordered two to share with our meal. Fragrant.

I can't wait to come back and try more things! First place in a long time where food and price have matched, especially for Thai cuisine.

OMG! I waited 30 minutes in line for a blizzard that wasn't even mixed properly. Staff was very rude to me, place was packed with screaming kids who were running everywhere... I couldn't wait to get out of there. 
I recommend Dairy Queen, just NOT this location. Been here 3 times and all 3 times its been brutal. I won't even come back for a 4th visit.
Paid 15 f**king dollars for a portion smaller and less tastier than Thai express . I wanted to support a local business but I am terribly disappointed.
Nobody in my house ever says no to coming here for ice cream!  Great young staff overseen by friendly management.
The food is always hot, fast, and delicious. I crave the yellow curry so much in between visits! The service is always great as well.

This place must be a gold mine in the summer. The line up is always crazy, hell it is half the winter time too! But it is good. I mean yes it is a chain so it is the same as most but they just do it right. The blizzards are always good. They have one of my favourite burgers. The Swiss mushroom. And DQ well they just have the best poutine hands down. Kudos on trying to expand into potato skins but they are just too greasy....

This was the first of four Best Western Hotels we stayed in last week in Alberta. This was probably the newest and best layed out of them all.  

We were warmly greeted at the front desk by Darlene.  The lobby is relatively small but that leaves room for more important areas, like the breakfast room.  While the included breakfast is pretty standard fare, the room was large enough to accomodate many guests with an overflow room nearby. 

There is only one slow elevator servicing the four storey hotel.  There were many families with children at the hotel while we were there so lots in the pool, which we never used.

The rooms were typical of Best Western Plus standards, were very clean and well maintained.  Beds were quite comfy.

If I had one complaint, it was that the WiFi was miserable. The first day it worked fine but rarely after. The story we heard constanly was that IT was looking into it.  But that was our experience in all four of the Best Westerns in which we stayed.

There is a premium coffee machine with coffee for purchase in the hall by the elevator, we never tried it. While there isn't a restaurant in the hotel, there's plenty places to eat within walking distance, Tim Hortons & Wendy's right next door and a mall across the road.

$10.95 for a lunch combo!

'Nuff said!

I've tried their Pad Thai, Spicy Pad Thai, Green Curry, Panang Curry, Basil Stiry Fry and they were all full of flavour and well prepared.

I've also tried their duck curry from the dinner menu - also yummy!

Service is quick, friendly and efficient. I ordered take out both times there so can't comment on in-house table service but I suspect it's equally lovely.

What a great addition to the St. Albert food scene.

I was super disappointed with my pad Thai. It had absolutely no flavour. It was dry and had one sprig of cilantro and two pieces of scallion with some bean sprouts. There was no egg or tofu in it and the chicken was old leftovers thrown into it.  Not worth it, especially for $15
Really amazing food.  We tried several dishes and enjoyed them all.   We'll be back:)
Service horrible had to get are own cutlery and ask for drinks we went to try the buffet but they would not bring new food out so disappointing never will I even come here again

I booked this hotel online. I selected the option for pet and chose a family room. I followed up with a phone call to verify that our reservation was good for a pet. The answer was yes. After driving 8 hours to get there, we were tired and ready to go to bed. We were told at the desk that the room was not pet friendly. They only have certain rooms that allow pets and ours was not one. The clerk said it "happens a lot with online and phone" reservations. Not good. We had 3 small children and a dog. It took us until 10p to find a room that would accommodate us. The clerk was very nice and friendly. He helped us call other hotels and printed directions once we found a place. Not happy with Best Western but the staff was friendly...hence the 3 stars.

food is good. Good selection on menu. My only issue is that they are extremely unorganized and the wait times are long. We always call our order in and show up at the time they say it will be done and then still have to wait 20-30 mins which is very poor in my opinion. This has happened a few times now and we will probably not order here anymore.

First time here - so glad we tried it out. Everything we had was great. The appetizers and curry dishes were delicious. Nice variety of flavours in the dishes we had. Amazing variety to choose from on the menu and the server was friendly and helpful. Will definitely be back again!

So we had to return, of course!!  Made reservations for a Saturday night for a larger party, and the table was nicely set and ready for us immediately.  It was a treat to order LOTS of food this time (with the excuse that our guests needed to try everything we loved before and more) and it just kept coming and coming, each dish more delicious than the last.   The curry remains my favourite and I suspect I will always need to order it, but coming very close to the top of my list was the gingered veggies.  Oh my gosh, perfection!  A great variety of veggies with just the right amount of ginger.  You can also include the meat (or tofu) of your choice, but honestly it was superb with just enjoying each vegetable for itself.  Also tried the calamari, green onion cakes, teriyaki beef, pad noodles, and we scraped the serving dishes clean.  Can't rave enough about this place  :-)

The clinic is very professional, withe great service, kid-friendly and thorough exams.  Dr. Amy is very friendly and knowledgeable individual. Very happy that my entire family had the annual exam there and purchased 3 pairs of glasses. The selection of frames is very nice, especially for hard to find kid-frames. And they are a part of the provincial program for free pair of glasses for a kindergarten attending child, yet another plus!

What a find! Hadn't eaten anywhere in downtown St. Albert in years, bug so glad we decided to give this place a try. Impressive selection of lunch specials for 10.95 - add 1$ more for 2 simple but tasty spring rolls, some tom yam soup, or a salad to start. As others have noted, the coconut rice is a must! I had the pandang curry which had a nice heat to it and loads of flavor from the coconut milk and lemon grass base. 
Service was quick and attentive. 
Deep friend banana and mango/coconut sesserts were okay, but not great for 6$ a piece. 
We will absolutely be headed back for lunch or dinner next time we are in town. 
W

What can I say...

We went to the St Albert DQ and ordered three Blizzards, a Julius, a slush drink with ice cream, and a milk shake.  First it took over 25 minutes  to get our order, then it was wrong, the orders were all made wrong, the incorrect orders and the wrong sizes.  They then served the Blizzards without turning them upside down, and blew us off when they were questioned about it.  Even tbe drinks were wrong.  After twenty-five minutes and $27 we left with the wrong orders (just to escape) but not before paying an extra dollar to get one of the Blizzards served in the correct size.  

I'm disgusted, ten staff in the restaurant and three working, and  those ones were screwing up non-stop.

I don't think I'll be back.

Great food but pricy to return regularly. Our bill was 179.00 for 4 of us. That was before tip. The beer was 7.00 a bottle. Tom yum was great and pad Thai. I just wish the prices were not overpriced. The decor could use an update. Maybe I will give it another try and other less expensive items off the menu. I was so excited to have a Thai place in St. Albert
Can't wait to come back and try some meals! We ate till we had to roll out of the door. Fast friendly service and delicious food! My now go to Asian cuisine. So much food and such great flavours!

WONDERFUL FOOD AND SERVICE! I love everything there and I can't wait to take my family there with me next time!

There mango sticky rice is the best thing in existence !

We are from out of town and decided to try this place based on the Yelp reviews. We were not disappointed! The curries were fantastic and the place is very clean. Don't be fooled by the exterior of the building, this is a top notch place to eat Thai food! You can park in the front and back and enter the building from either side.

We stopped in with the family today.  After a short wait, the staff from the delivery side informed us that their waitress never showed up so we could not be served.  Boston Pizza here we come.  Do they really only hire one waitress?    Guess Notley with 15 dollar wage hike is taken a toll on all of us

Excellent food! We had the fried rice, pad Thai,spring rolls, and curry beef and it was easily as good as other Thai restaurants I have been to. Good quantity and very good price. Nice ambiance and excellent service. We will definitely go back.

I've only ever ordered curry (various types), so my review is based on that. The coconut rice offered with the dishes is fantastic and moist, as well as the vegetables taste fresh and cooked to the right texture. The food that boasts the "spicy" label could be overall spicier, as they seem to tone down the heat. I love to see that the restaurant is always full to the brim of happy customers.

The worst I can't believe I paid $56 for this. I got 2 supreme and one cheese there was so little toppings on these pizzas I thought it was a joke. The cheese didn't even cover half the pizzas. Never again will I buy pizza from this place it was the most expensive with the least amount of toppings that I have ever seen. Just terrible, don't waste your time or money. If I had time I would be going there to demand my money back. Disgusting. These people are crooks

Natasha is WONDERFUL! First time getting glasses and she walked me through everything!!! Only issue is, since I'm all new at the glasses, I didn't know prices could range so much. I was led out of my exam and told to pick out frames. Didn't really know I could go somewhere else. After some research, their prices were a bit higher than other places but the personal touch and direct billing makes up for it. Thank you Natasha!!!

I showed up at this hotel at 2am on a friday, tired, annoyed and I had been lost for an hour beforhand.  I was near tears because all the hotels i went to were either full or too pricey.  The woman at the front desk could obviously sense my stress and she helped me book a room for that weekend at a significantly lower price plus helped me when it came to the deposit because I didnt have a credit card on me.  I will def go back to this hotel if i'm back in St. Albert.

Not bad at all!

My cousin brought us out for dinner tonight- he raves about this place. He's a huge fan of the yellow and red curry. 

The appetizers we ordered were mostly fried foods- golden bags, and what looked like little samosas. They were pretty good. 

I had to go for pad Thai because it's my favorite Thai dish. It was super tasty and enough to feed me 3 times over! I would probably order it with shrimp instead of chicken if I got it again though. 

The service was decent- some servers were friendlier than others. Great at filling up our drinks.

Food was delicious, however I wasn't a huge fan of the Spicy Pad Thai. First off, it didn't have a single hint of spice which i found weird, since their were 2 different Pad Thai's on the menu: One regular and one spicy. Perhaps ours was wrong, I am just not sure. Secondly, It just had a strange taste to it that I couldn't figure out. It wasn't our favorite Pad Thai that's for sure. 

However, the panang curry made up for it as it was amazing and full of flavor!! Went great with the coconut rice, and green onion cakes were on point as well! 

They definitely needed more wait staff as well, as there was only one girl running the front end and she looked like she had her hands full as it got pretty busy, with dine-in eaters and people coming in for take out. Service from her was still pretty great, all things considered. 

I will certainly be back to try more food as I love Thai food!!

This location serves up the standard Dairy Queen treats you can find anywhere in the city.  What I like most about this location is the size - it may be the largest seating area I've seen in a Dairy Queen in the Edmonton Area which is a plus for my family when I want to tuck my noisy toddler into a corner booth so as to not disrupt all the other diners with every word of her conversation like, "Mommy, I need to go poop now!"

This location also has an Orange Julius combo in it for those of you wanting a sweet drink.  

On my last visit here there was a wedding party who stopped in on the way to their reception after photos for Dilly Bars - quite the site!

I'm giving this restaurant a 2 star because staff was very nice however food was not worth the price 
The platter for $18.99 was over cooked tiny pieces left over from lunch rush it literally tasted like it was re- deep-fried. The pad Thai was mediocre and I should have went to Thai Express. I dislike spending 65$ for lunch at a Thai place that I leave un-satisfied .

I stayed here for nearly a month on business and had everything I could have wanted. After a long day of work the hot tub, pool and workout room were fabulous. 

The staff were always pleasant and professional. From what radio station to tune to, to getting the most from my stay by signing up for Best Western Rewards. Thank you Ryan.

I appreciated the patience and helpfulness of Mike (did I get your name right?) when using the business centre!

When I had any kind of issue the pleasant smile and welcoming attitude, of both Samar and Samantha, made me feel at home and everything was dealt with promptly. Farah's cheerful demeanor was also refreshing! 

From Fred carrying out my luggage to the cleaning staff, Jen, Luisa and J Manzano they were always there when you needed them.

Mijong and the kitchen-dining staff were very kind and prompt to see to every need.

Thank you all for making a home away from home for me!

Came in here yesterday for a last minute eye exam. Not only were they willing to fit me in, Dr. Mistry took the extra time to address my concerns with my vision and was willing to let me know which tests were unnecessary unlike other clinics. It was nice to have an honest organization and professionalism. The staff all took the time to talk to me and help me out even searching what I had concerns about. All topped off by the magic they did when they had exactly the hugo boss frame I had wanted in the color that I really wanted which I hadn't been able to find at many other eye glass locations. These guys are a phenomenal and amazing when it comes to keep you happy. Thank you!

Can't believe I neglected to review this place after my visit last year - it's one of the best eye exams I've ever had, and believe me I've had close to a hundred!  First the staff helped me through a series of tests, all lined up with a chair on wheels to work your way down the line - couldn't have been easier or quicker.  Then Dr. Mistry took time to thoroughly explain everything to me, allieviate my concerns, and help me plan for the future.  I would recommend him to everyone of all ages, as the grandkids also thought he was fabulous.  

A note about parking - don't worry about trying to find a spot on the downtown street to parallel park -- his office backs onto the huge public (free) parking lot for the library, Arden, etc, so you can choose a spot just in back of him, easy peasy.

Showed up at 8:30 pm to have supper at the Diner , there was one couple at a table and the whole place  was empty. Waited couple minutes till someone showed up to tell us that food will probably take an hour at least because the kitchen is busy. How do you sustain business when you turn away customers, like all customers!!! 
Way to go Pizza Hut !!
The staff are very nice and the food is amazing here! My favourite Thai place between St. Albert and Edmonton.
Wonderful, clean, lovely real food. Being the long lost of Anthony I can only say go there as you wont be dissapointed. Man is it good to eat real food!!!!!

The coffee shop at the hotel is a regular place for a lot of seniors and I sure enjoy it too. Where else can you get coffee, soup, main meal and a small desert for $13? The food quality is extremely good. The soup is home made. The parking lot is always well sanded which I like as well as lots of parking.

Had yet another very good experience at St Albert Optometrist Clinic with Dr. Mistry. 

My son woke up overnight with a sty so bad his eye was swollen shut. 

We had gone to walk in clinic the night before when the school had called with it bring red (they were thinking pink eye).  Walk in clinic had said warm compresses and it should settle.  

So when he awoke the next morning with a swollen shut eye, I was quite worried. 

I suddenly remembered Dr. Mistry telling me at an eye exam that we should always see an eye doctor for eye injuries or infections.  So I quickly phoned up St. Albert Optometry and they were able to get us in within the hour. 

We were lucky the Dr. Mistry was there and again he was fabulous.  Patient and caring for my very nervous son who didn't want his eye touched.  Dr. Mistry discusses my son's health history and gave me several options for treatment.  He also discussed with my son how this wasn't his fault but that playing hockey in a sweaty germy helmet can certainly add to the likelihood for getting a sty and the importance of bathing after hockey (Yay doc - I hope this works because trying to get a 7 year old to bathe after hockey can be tough). 

Anyone, four days later and my son's eye is looking almost good as new.  

Thank you Dr. Mistry for always being informative, patient, and caring.
Disgusting experience tonight.  Our family take-out dinner was ruined when we found several long hairs in our pizza. Everyone lost their appetites. Won't be going back here.

Named "The Ice Cream House" by our toddler, this is a favourite summer treat for Gramma and Me outings.   The food is always up to expected standards and the staff is amazingly patient with wee ones who can't make quick decisions.

Kudos for a place that provides large, soft napkins at every table for comfortable face cleaning and efficient mop-ups of spills.

The seating area is large enough that singles with a newspaper to peruse can do it in relative peace and safety from noisy children.  The exception to that is any hot afternoon when it's full of energy and even has line-ups to wait through.  In that case, just leave it to families and find your quiet spot elsewhere, or else come to enjoy watching happy faces smeared with soft freeze  :-)

Love the community involvement as well - Dairy Queen feels good AND tastes good!

What I expect from a Best Western. 

Modern clean decor and rooms. 

The pool was crystal clear. 

The breakfast was about the best you get for a free meal at a hotel. The dinning area was quite nice. 

The hotel was near capacity and the breakfast was packed. But the two ladies working the breakfast kept everything full, tables cleaned and cleared. 

We would stay here again.

Are. You. Kidding. Me.

Finally, a Thai restaurant that I can glow about! 
Normally, I don't go arse over tea kettle for a new restaurant, but Songkran is the exception. 

I have missed good quality Thai food at a decent price in the greater Edmonton area. Granted, there is good Thai in this town, but they're usually overpriced, second rate or a combination of both. 

Songkran Thai Restaurant is located on St. Anne street in St. Albert, just west of St. Albert Trail in the old Six N Seven location. 

The trophy wife and I (with the trophy boy in tow) stopped in just minutes after their doors opened for the first time. After admiring the simple yet lovely decor, we were seated at a booth were the lunch menus also doubled as place mats. The color pictures and descriptions of the dishes were delightful and helped up decide on what to try for lunch. 

We opted for panang curry, a basil stir fry and pineapple fried rice, with the mango sticky rice for dessert. Long story short, everything that we ordered was nothing short of AMAZING! All of the lunch combos came with your choice of steamed or coconut rice (we chose coconut) with beef, pork, chicken or tofu. We chose chicken with the panang, tofu with the basil stir fry and the boy wanted beef with the pineapple rice. I cannot reiterate enough how delicious each and every dish was. At a $10.95 price tag for lunch combos, we were beside ourselves with excitement at the flavours and the value of our meal. 

Our server Mimsong (I hope I got her name right) was so unbelievably friendly and knowledgeable. If she wasn't sure of one of our many questions (and I mean many!) she repeatedly took the time to go back and asked someone who could answer.

If you enjoy high quality traditional Thai food, good prices and fantastic service, then run (don't walk!) to Songkran! You will not be disappointed!

Hey sweetie... what's the babysitters' number do we can go back?

One year in and Songkran is still going strong. 

This has quickly become one of our favorite Thai restaurants!

Prices have increased here since my review one year ago, however.  When they opened one year ago lunch combos were $10.95.  They are now $12.95 for veggie; $13.95 for tofu, beef, chicken, or pork; and $14.95 for shrimp.  

They've expanded their menu with many more lunch options and of course dinner continues to be a rocking full menu. 

Faves for me are red curry chicken, green curry chicken, and spicy herbal tofu.  

Hubs faves are PadThai Tom Yum chicken and Pad See Eew chicken.  

There's additional parking out back and reservations are always recommended!

Two Thumbs Way up!

I visited this place while on a date with my girlfriend. The atmosphere was alright, and the service was good, and the food was delicious. We started off with the veggie spring rolls and I moved onto to Pad Woon Sen. Decent portions for the price. I recommend this place for a meal with friends, family or solo.

A delightful Thai restaurant with a bright and well decorated interior. Parking is abit difficult in the front of the building as it is small. The menu has many selections from stirfries, soups and numerous noodle dishes. There are alcoholic drinks and the menu also has a dessert section. We choose 3 separate dishes, pad Thai, cashew stirfry and a glass noodle dish. Each dish was freshly made with a good balance of vegetables and enormous portions. The service was delightful, quick and very helpful. My last visit was very successful as the curries were flavorful, so I was expecting the same this time. This time the bold flavours were gone. The herbs, fresh chillis and deep flavours of the meat were missing in all our dishes. This is so DISAPPOINTING and unfortunately, this will be our last visit.
First time here and we will definitely be back.  Excellent quality and very accommodating with outer nut allergy.

Songkran continues to be our go to local fave! 

I feel so lucky that hubs and I were able to sneak in a lunch date at Songkran on my birthday last month before the COVID-19 pandemic hit.

Our 17 year Anniversary was this past week in the midst of these very scary times.  So what did we do?  We picked up Songkran to go!

Now, of course my plating wasn't as pretty but man oh man did it bring Joy to our hearts and yummies to our tummy!

Faves:  Panang curry with chicken and coconut rice, Spicy herbal with tofu and coconut rice, AND mango and coconut sticky rice for dessert. 

Until we can dine in again, we will continue to support local takeout here!  Oh and don't be shy to ask for recommendations or special requests like spicy! 

PS Their cleanliness is ALWAYS impeccable.  They had hand sanitizer and wipes available at the entrance and pin pad.
Great service and selection of food. I would go back and try other food.

Came to Songkran today for their grand opening!

We were their first customers and so excited!

Lunch combos include rice (white or coconut) and are only $10.95.  There were 26 combos!!! You can also add on veggie spring roll, veggie Tom yam soup, house salad, or a fried egg for $1 each. 

The dinner menu is extensive and hubby even found his fave - Pad See Ew!  We will def be back for dinner time!

The restaurant itself is gorgeous and had both booths and tables. 

Parking available out front or in the back.

Today we tried:

C4 Panang Curry with chicken
C6 Basil Stir Fry with tofu
41 Pineapple Fried rice with beef 

We added a spring roll and a house salad for $1 each. 

We also just had to try the mango sticky rice even though we were already stuffed! 

Everything was FREAKING FABULOUS. Great variety of veggies with every dish and so dang fresh.

Our server, Mimsong, was knowledgeable, attentive, and just perfect.  

She even brought out one of the owners, Kanye, for us to meet!

Kanya started two restaurants with her husband in Edmonton before (Thai Flavours) but sold the restaurants three years ago when they moved to Fort Mac.

Boy oh boy, am I ever glad Kanya missed running an authentic Thai restaurant,  moved back and decided to open up shop in our new neck of the woods!  

Lunch specials are available everyday of the week for just $10.95 and you get to choose your protein!

I literally cannot wait to come back!

Check out this Gazette article to learn more: http://www.stalbertgazette.com/article/New-restaurant-offers-taste-of-Thai-20170208

PS - BEST Thai I've had since moving to Canada from Seattle!

Finally got to try Songkran Thai yesterday after a few feeble attempts previously. Took a fellow Yelpers sage advice and tried the incredible $10.95 lunch special. Heather and I met on our lunch breaks, I tried the Green Curry on coconut rice and she had the Pad Thai Tom Yam. Both were made fresh and were flavourful and delicious. We added two spring rolls (good, not stand out) and a starter Tom Yam Vegetable Soup which I found tasty but a bit sweet. 

We will be trying this again with a group of friends for dinner in the next month or so and look forward to exploring the dinner menu. A great addition to the St. Albert food scene!

I enjoy the atmosphere at this Thai restaurant. The staff is very friendly and service is quick. I asked for a recommended soup and it was delicious. If you need help ordering or want a special request they will make it for you. The food is authentic and fresh. I enjoyed the chicken wing appetizer a lot and anything curry is awesome!  The menu has a lot of choices, but is separated into different categories to make it easier.

Surprised. 

Clean. Good staff. Good amenities. Breakfast is ok. Room was clean. Very simple. Bed was ok. Parking was ok. Everything worked. Cookies were good. Coffee was terrible. 

I would not hesitate to return.

We've stayed at this best western multiple times and have never had a complaint.  The hot tub and pool are nice for the kids to burn off some energy,  and I love the large breakfast room, plenty of space. The coffee is delicious and the waffles are a hit with the kids. The rooms are clean and spacious and the pillows are comfortable.
On one visit I accidentally spilled just poured hot coffee on my three year old. The woman who was working in the breakfast room whisked her up immediately brought her to a sink in the back and ran cold water on her arm. I'm extremely Thankful for her quick thinking and actions.

My family went back for a blizzards, we were so extremely happy to see that everything was cleaned up! Our blizzards were delicious and we had a nice time out of the house. 

Thank you for taking the time to not only read my review, respond to it but also to take action & have this cleaned up right away.

I ordered 3 dishes and all of them are pretty bad. Normally I wouldn't write a review but this one needs to be done. 

1. Crab fried rice - looks totally different from the menu picture and the crab doesn't even taste like crab. Not very sure if it's real crabmeat.

2. Beef noodle soup - The meat is hard to chew and the soup barely has taste. 

3. Pad Pong Ka Ree - The taste is totally mediocre and that's only dish dish that's kinda okay.

Stayed here for two nights, one night on my own for a night out of the house to catch my breath from being a mom & wife and the next with my husband & children. We had a blast in the pool, it was really nice having the entire space to ourselves to be loud & just play. My kids loved it & have been asking to go back. 
The front desk staff were so friendly & welcoming. Looking forward to another local getaway.

We got take out (due to COVID19) and the restaurant had a very good pickup system in place. Loved that! We ordered the Pad Thai, Green Curry, Salad Rolls and Green Onion Cale. Turns out that was enough for supper and also lunch the next day. Definitely one of the best Thai meals I've had around the north side. Very friendly staff too. Will definitely be back.

While I really enjoy Dairy Queen and their food tends to be near the top for my fast food preferences I find myself very disappointed in this particular location. With the new shut down and all the covid restrictions to eat outside is often the best choice, the amount of garbage & lack of cleanliness on and around the picnic tables is just gross. I don't like to nitpick and I'm not certain who is responsible for cleaning this area but as the patron I'm fairly certain it is above my pay grade but here I find myself out for dinner and still cleaning. Can't say I will be rushing back to eat at this location.

The whole fam jam continues to have excellent care at St. Albert Optometrists' Clinic. 

They now carry a wider array of frames with Lifestyle packages including frames and lenses under $200!  Of course they continue to carry boutique brands such as Kate Spade, Gucci, Ray Ban, and Dolce & Gabbana.  And they carry Oakley and Maui Jim sunglasses.  

I love that they can get you in quickly for eye emergencies such as infection or injuries for a thorough exam.  

The kiddo play section has the cutest bendy Harry Potter glasses for dress up fun! 

My 11 year old is super excited to come for her first contact lens fitting and lesson later this week.  And I thank the Gods that they will teach her while I drink a cup of joe.

I didn't realize before that an eye exam after a concussion is a good idea as there are specialized tests the optometrist can do.

Extremely pleased with the ability to get my daughter in quickly (2 days) when she was suddenly experiencing headaches.

We saw a lovely optician who was great with my talkative, squirmy, and and inquisitive daughter (I'm sorry I didn't get her name). 

And then the second portion with Dr. Rajan Mistry was lovely.  He had excellent demeanor and was more than patient with my daughter.  I deny entirely confident in his exam and really appreciated the time he took to show me scans of my daughter's eyes. 

He's having her fine reviewed by a Retina specialist just to double check given the sudden onset of debilitating headaches.  He really made both my daughter and I feel at ease and confident in his assessment and recommendations. 

They offer a pretty fabulous eye glass program where if your kiddo's prescription changes in 16 months they get new lens' as well as full warranty on the frames/lens' from any damage - no questions asked. 

As with most boutique optical locations, you will find boutique prices here.  

I will highly recommend Dr. Mistry to all of my family and friends.

I normally enjoy coming to this DQ from time to time but last night, the girlfriend and I were in the mood for a couple blizzards. Of course as per usual we walk in because the drive thru is always busier than just walking in. Once we were inside and ordered our blizzards, we noticed 2 people, unsure if they were employees or not but they weren't wearing the DQ attire. Shortly after we noticed a dog wondering around in the back as well. Now I am a dog lover, but to me a dog being in the back where food is prepped does not seem very hygienic and proffessional. For that particular reason, I will no longer be going to that DQ.

Oh my gosh - fabulous Thai food right here in St Albert only minutes from my house - I'm in heaven!

The food is GREAT and so reasonable - lunch combos (more than 2 dozen to choose from) are only $10.95 and include a big scoop of steamed or coconut rice, with your choice of meats or tofu.  Spring rolls, soup, salad or a fried egg can be added for a dollar more.  This has got to be the best lunch in town!

The dinner menu is also extensive, with lots of appetizer choices to start you out.

Wonderful service, cheerful and clean interior, terrific food, good prices - what more could you ask for?  I'll be back for sure!

(My personal recommendation is the yellow curry with chicken and a satisfying array of veggies)

Ordered 3 combo meals and for all 3 asked for onion rings instead of fries and all 3 orders were only 1/2 full. Paid extra money for them at least fill up the containers all the way. The grill burger was the size of a slider. There is a girl in there who has hair to her butt. It should be in a hairnet or at least a bun. It's long enough to get in your food.

In St Albert for some reason, and this is what we chose.  
Located close to downtown St A, and it was easy to walk in on a Thursday and get a spot.  Seated promptly and served quickly by a friendly attentive waitress.  My wife and I ordered the green onion cakes, spring rolls, pad Thai and a beef red curry.  

Food came out fast and hot but it was all a bit bland and boring flavour wise.  Mild spice and it all just tasted like 1 or 2 things were missed when assembling the food from the recipe.  Fish sauce? Sugar?  Meh.

So I get it's New Years eve and all, but when you order a pizza at 6:07pm and it arrives to your door an hour and a half later, that's a problem. The delivery driver seemed nice enough saying something about no one wanting to work on New Years. The pizza was cold and had to be heated in the oven. It wasn't cut all the way through so we had to recut it. The 5 cheese stuffed crust looked like a Delissio thin crust frozen pizza. Even with the $10 daily special it's not worth it. The best part though was that when I tried to submit feedback on their website, the link was turned off or it wouldn't let you enter a postal code through your mobile device. I would not recommend pizza from this location unless you like being disappointed.
